questions.question:
The owner of a gun store had been doing business with a hunter for many years. The hunter entered the gun store and spoke to the owner about purchasing a new hunting rifle on credit. The hunter disclosed that he intended to use the rifle on a turkey-hunting trip that weekend even though it was two weeks before turkey-hunting season began. The hunter left with the rifle after signing a written agreement to pay for the rifle in 12 monthly installments.
The rifle functioned well on the hunter's trip, during which a friend advised the hunter that he could avoid paying for the rifle because the contract was illegal. The hunter took the friend's advice and never paid any installments.
If the store owner sues for breach of contract, will he be likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the store owner failed to disaffirm the contract's illegal purpose before giving the hunter possession of the rifle.
choices.b: No, because the store owner knew that the hunter intended to use the rifle for an illegal purpose.
choices.c: Yes, because a contract to sell a rifle is not, in and of itself, illegal.
choices.d: Yes, because the store owner substantially performed and did not sell the rifle in order to further the hunter's illegal purpose.

data.questionStem:
Q81061

The owner of a gun store had been doing business with a hunter for many years. The hunter entered the gun store and spoke to the owner about purchasing a new hunting rifle on credit. The hunter disclosed that he intended to use the rifle on an upcoming hunting trip even though he did not have a current hunting license as required by state law. The hunter left with the rifle after signing a written agreement to pay for the rifle in 12 monthly installments.

The rifle functioned well on the hunter's trip, during which a friend advised the hunter that he could avoid paying for the rifle because the contract was illegal. The hunter took the friend's advice and never paid any installments.

If the store owner sues for breach of contract, will he be likely to prevail?

一家枪店的老板与一名猎人有多年的生意往来。该猎人进入枪店，与老板商议以赊账方式购买一支新的猎枪。猎人透露，尽管他没有州法律所要求的有效狩猎许可证，但他仍打算在即将到来的狩猎旅行中使用这支步枪。猎人签署了一份分12期按月付款的书面协议后，带着步枪离开了。

步枪在猎人的狩猎旅行中性能良好，期间一位朋友建议猎人，由于合同非法，他可以避免支付步枪的费用。猎人听从了朋友的建议，从未支付任何分期付款。

如果店主以违约为由提起诉讼，他是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the store owner failed to disaffirm the contract's illegal purpose before giving the hunter possession of the rifle.
不会，因为店主在将步枪交给猎人占有之前，未能否定合同的非法目的。

B. No, because the store owner knew that the hunter intended to use the rifle for an illegal purpose.
不会，因为店主知道猎人打算将步枪用于非法目的。

C. Yes, because neither the store owner nor the hunter was contractually obligated to engage in illegal conduct.
会，因为合同并未规定店主或猎人有义务从事非法行为。

D. Yes, because the store owner did not act to further the hunter's illegal purpose and there was no threat of grave social harm.
会，因为店主没有采取行动助长猎人的非法目的，并且不存在严重的社会危害威胁。
data.explanation:
Recovery for breach of illegal contract


Expectation damages
(full value of lost performance)
  • Party justifiably ignorant of illegality†
  • Party substantially performed & lacked illegal purpose
  • Contract separable into legal / illegal parts or Contract illegal due to violation of licensing requirement designed only to raise revenue
Restitution damages
(reasonable value of benefit conferred)
  • Party justifiably ignorant of illegality
  • Party less culpable than other party or Party withdrew before illegal purpose achieved & did not engage in serious misconduct
Recovery on this basis is barred if other party is also justifiably ignorant.

An illegal contract arises when one or both parties' purpose, formation, or performance is against the law. These contracts are usually void, and there is no recovery for breach. However, an exception arises if one party lacked an illegal purpose and substantially performed under the contract. That party may recover expectation damages for breach - even if he/she knew of the other party's illegal purpose.† This is true unless :
  • the performing party took action to further the other party's illegal purpose or
  • the illegal purpose involves grave social harm (eg, threat to human life).
Here, the contract was illegal because the hunter's purpose was to use the rifle to hunt without a required license. However, the store owner substantially performed by giving the hunter the rifle and had no illegal purpose of his own. And though the store owner knew of the hunter's illegal purpose, the store owner took no action to further it - eg, had he helped the hunter obtain a counterfeit license. Additionally, hunting without a license does not involve grave social harm. Therefore, the store owner will likely prevail in a breach-of-contract suit (Choice D).

†If the performing party was unaware of the other party's illegal purpose, then no further analysis is necessary.

(Choice A) The store owner did not need to disaffirm the contract's illegal purpose - eg, by telling the hunter not to use the rifle on the upcoming hunting trip. It is enough that the store owner did not act to further the hunter's illegal purpose and there was no threat of grave social harm.

(Choice C) The contract did not obligate either party to engage in illegal conduct since rifle sales are legal (absent statutory restrictions - not seen here). But the contract is still illegal because the hunter intended to use the rifle for an illegal purpose.

Educational objective: Illegal contracts are usually void and there is no recovery for breach. However, a party who substantially performed and lacked an illegal purpose may recover - even if he/she knew of the other party's illegal purpose - unless (1) the performing party took action to further that illegal purpose or (2) the purpose involves grave social harm.

选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 19%，C选项 39%，D选项 37%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

对非法合同违约的救济


期待性损害赔偿
（已损失履行的全部价值）
  • 当事人有正当理由不知其非法性†
  • 当事人已实质性履行且无非法目的
  • 合同可分离为合法/非法部分 或 合同因违反仅为增加收入而设的许可证要求而非法
恢复原状损害赔偿
（所赋予利益的合理价值）
  • 当事人有正当理由不知其非法性
  • 当事人比另一方过错更小 或 当事人在非法目的实现前退出且未从事严重不当行为
如果另一方也有正当理由不知情，则不得以此为基础获得救济。

当一方或双方的目的、订立或履行违反法律时，即构成非法合同。这些合同通常是无效的，对于违约行为不提供任何救济。然而，如果一方没有非法目的并已根据合同实质性履行，则存在例外。该方当事人可以就违约行为获得期待性损害赔偿——即使他/她知道另一方的非法目的。† 此规则成立，除非：
  • 履行方采取了行动助长另一方的非法目的 或
  • 该非法目的涉及严重的社会危害（例如，对人类生命的威胁）。
在本案中，合同是非法的，因为猎人的目的是在没有所需许可证的情况下使用步枪进行狩猎。然而，店主通过将步枪交给猎人而实质性地履行了合同，并且其自身没有非法目的。而且，尽管店主知道猎人的非法目的，但他没有采取任何行动来助长它——例如，他没有帮助猎人获得伪造的许可证。此外，无证狩猎不涉及严重的社会危害。因此，店主很可能在违约诉讼中胜诉（选项D）。

†如果履行方不知道另一方的非法目的，则无需进一步分析。

（选项A）店主无需否定合同的非法目的——例如，告诉猎人不要在即将到来的狩猎旅行中使用步枪。只要店主没有采取行动助长猎人的非法目的，并且没有严重的社会危害威胁，就足够了。

（选项C）合同并未规定任何一方有义务从事非法的行为，因为步枪销售是合法的（在没有法定限制的情况下——此处未见）。但该合同仍然是非法的，因为猎人意图将步枪用于非法的目的。

教学目的：非法合同通常是无效的，对于违约行为不提供任何救济。然而，已实质性履行且无非法目的的一方当事人可以获得救济——即使他/她知道另一方的非法目的——除非（1）履行方采取行动助长该非法目的，或（2）该目的涉及严重的社会危害。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 182 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining the effect of performance under a contract when the other party's purpose is illegal).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Illegality Defense
合同法：非法性抗辩
💡 核心法律规则 (The Rule)
通常情况下，如果合同的目的非法，合同是无效的 (Void)。但是，如果只有一方意图将标的物用于非法目的，而另一方仅仅是知情 (Mere Knowledge)，规则会有所不同。
根据《合同法重述（第二次）》§ 182，卖方即使知道买方的非法目的，仍可强制执行合同，除非：
  1. 卖方采取了行动助长 (Further) 该非法目的；或者
  2. 该非法目的涉及严重的社会危害 (Grave Social Harm)。
⚖️ 案情分析 (Application)

在本案中，店主出售步枪本身是合法的商业行为。

1. 助长行为 (Furtherance): 店主仅仅是卖枪，没有帮助猎人伪造证件，也没有协助其逃避检查。因此，店主没有“助长”非法行为。

2. 严重社会危害 (Grave Social Harm): 猎人的非法行为是“无证狩猎”。这属于行政违规（Regulatory Offense），通常不被视为涉及道德败坏或严重威胁人类生命的重罪（如买枪杀人）。

✅ 正确答案：选项 D

会胜诉，因为店主没有采取行动助长猎人的非法目的，并且不存在严重的社会危害威胁。

既然店主已经实质性履行了合同（交付了步枪），且上述两个例外情况（助长非法目的、严重社会危害）均不成立，法院不会因为猎人的非法意图而剥夺店主获得付款的权利。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (Failure to disaffirm): 法律并不要求卖方必须“否定”或劝阻买方的非法目的才能使合同有效。只要不积极参与即可。
选项 B (Mere knowledge): 这是最强的干扰项。仅仅“知道”对方的非法意图（Mere Knowledge）通常不足以使合同无效，除非涉及重罪或严重道德败坏。
选项 C (No obligation to illegal conduct): 虽然合同本身没有要求非法行为，但这并不是理由。如果非法目的足够严重（例如买枪是为了谋杀），即使合同条款表面合法，合同也可能因公共政策而无效。选项 D 的理由更精准。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧 在处理 Illegality (非法性) 问题时，请区分两个层级：
  • 本身非法 (Illegal per se): 合同标的本身就是非法的（如雇凶杀人、贩毒）。这种合同永远无效。
  • 目的非法 (Illegal purpose): 标的合法（如卖枪、租房），但一方打算用于非法用途。此时要看另一方是否参与 (Participated) 或该罪行是否极其严重 (Heinous)。如果仅仅是知情且罪行轻微，合同通常有效。

questions.question:
A farmer who wanted to sell her land received a letter from a developer that stated, "I will pay you $1,100 an acre for your land." The farmer's letter of reply stated, "I accept your offer." Unbeknownst to the farmer, the developer had intended to offer only $1,000 per acre but had mistakenly typed "$1,100." As both parties knew, comparable land in the vicinity had been selling at prices between $1,000 and $1,200 per acre.
Which of the following states the probable legal consequences of the correspondence between the parties?

choices.a: There is a contract formed at a price of $1,000 per acre.
choices.b: There is a contract formed at a price of $1,100 per acre.
choices.c: There is no contract, because the parties attached materially different meanings to the price term.
choices.d: There is no enforceable contract, because the developer is entitled to rescission due to a mutual mistake as to a basic assumption of the contract.

data.questionStem:
Q81035

A farmer who wanted to sell her land received a letter from a developer that stated, "I will pay you $1,100 an acre for your land." The farmer's letter of reply stated, "I accept your offer." Unbeknownst to the farmer, the developer had intended to offer only $1,000 per acre but had mistakenly typed "$1,100." As both parties knew, comparable land in the vicinity had been selling at prices between $1,000 and $1,200 per acre.

Which of the following states the probable legal consequences of the correspondence between the parties?

一位想出售其土地的农场主收到了一位开发商的来信，信中写道：“我将以每英亩1100美元的价格购买您的土地。”农场主回信说：“我接受您的要约。”农场主不知道的是，开发商本意是只出价每英亩1000美元，但错误地打成了“1100美元”。双方都知道，附近类似土地的售价在每英亩1000美元到1200美元之间。

下列哪一项陈述了双方通信可能产生的法律后果？
options:
A. There is a contract formed at a price of $1,000 per acre.
合同成立，价格为每英亩1000美元。

B. There is a contract formed at a price of $1,100 per acre.
合同成立，价格为每英亩1100美元。

C. There is no contract, because the parties attached materially different meanings to the price term.
合同不成立，因为双方对价格条款有重大的不同理解。

D. There is no enforceable contract, because the developer is entitled to rescission due to a mutual mistake as to a basic assumption of the contract.
不存在可强制执行的合同，因为开发商有权因对合同一项基本假定的共同错误而撤销合同。
data.explanation:
A valid contract is generally formed when a mutual agreement is supported by adequate consideration, such as when the developer offered to pay $1,100 an acre for the farmer's land and the farmer accepted. Although the developer intended to offer only $1,000, his unilateral mistake is not grounds to avoid the contract unless:
  • the mistake would make enforcement of the contract unconscionable (eg, due to a substantial difference between contract price and actual value) or
  • the nonmistaken party (ie, the farmer) caused, or knew or had reason to know of, the mistake.


Here, the developer's mistake would not make enforcement of the contract unconscionable since the developer stands to lose just $100 per acre. The farmer did not cause the mistake and had no reason to know of it since comparable land in the vicinity had been selling at prices between $1,000 and $1,200 per acre. As a result, a valid contract was formed at a price of $1,100 per acre (Choice A).

(Choice C) A misunderstanding occurs when the parties attach different meanings to the same material term (eg, price). Here, the mistakenly typed "$1,100" did not create a misunderstanding since "$1,100" has just one meaning. But if it had, the misunderstanding would have prevented the formation of a contract.

(Choice D) There was no mutual mistake here since only the developer (not the farmer) was mistaken as to the contract price.

Educational objective: Unilateral mistake is not grounds to avoid a contract unless (1) the mistake would make enforcement of the contract unconscionable or (2) the nonmistaken party caused, or knew or had reason to know of, the mistake.



选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 74%（正确选项），C选项 6%，D选项 15%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当一项共同协议得到充分的对价支持时，一份有效合同通常即告成立，例如本案中开发商要约以每英亩1100美元的价格购买农场主的土地，且农场主接受了该要约。尽管开发商本意只出价1000美元，但其单方错误并不足以构成撤销合同的理由，除非：
  • 该错误将导致合同的强制执行变得不合情理（例如，由于合同价格与实际价值之间存在巨大差异）或
  • 无错误一方（即农场主）导致了该错误，或知道、或有理由知道该错误的存在。


在本案中，开发商的错误不会导致合同的强制执行变得不合情理，因为开发商每英亩只损失100美元。农场主并未导致该错误，也没有理由知道该错误的存在，因为附近类似土地的售价在每英亩1000美元到1200美元之间。因此，一份价格为每英亩1100美元的有效合同成立了（选项B）。

（选项C）当事人对同一重要条款（如价格）有不同理解时，就会产生误解。在本案中，错误键入的“1100美元”并未造成误解，因为“1100美元”只有一个含义。但如果造成了误解，该误解将阻碍合同的成立。

（选项D）本案中不存在共同错误，因为只有开发商（而非农场主）对合同价格存在错误。

教学目标：单方错误不能作为撤销合同的理由，除非（1）该错误将导致合同的强制执行变得不合情理，或（2）无错误一方导致了该错误，或知道、或有理由知道该错误的存在。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 153 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when unilateral mistake makes a contract voidable).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Mistake & Formation

结论与答案

本题的正确答案是 B。

合同以书面形式的 $1,100/英亩 成立。尽管开发商内心意图是 $1,000，但根据合同法的客观理论，其书面要约对无辜的受要约人（农场主）具有约束力。

核心考点：单方错误

本题考察的是合同法中的 单方错误 (Unilateral Mistake)。

一般规则：
如果只有一方在合同条款上犯了错误（例如打字错误），该错误通常不能作为撤销合同的理由。合同将按照客观表现出来的条款（Objective Manifestation）执行。

例外情况 (Exceptions)： 只有在以下两种情况之一发生时，单方错误才可以导致合同可撤销 (Voidable)：
  1. 显失公平 (Unconscionability)： 强制执行该错误会导致结果极其不公；或者
  2. 对方知情 (Reason to Know)： 另一方（未犯错方）知道该错误，或者有理由知道该错误（例如价格好得离谱）。

本案分析：

  • 开发商打错了价格（$1,100 而非 $1,000），这是单方错误。
  • 关键事实： 市场价格在 $1,000 到 $1,200 之间。
  • 因此，$1,100 的报价完全在合理范围内。农场主没有理由知道 (Had no reason to know) 这是一个错误。
  • 每英亩 $100 的差价也不足以构成“显失公平”。

结论：合同有效，且必须按书面价格执行。

为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A 错误：
法院不会根据一方的主观意图 (Subjective Intent) 来重写合同，除非有证据表明双方原本达成了该意图（即共同错误）。这里农场主并不知道开发商想出 $1,000。

选项 C 错误：
这不属于误解 (Misunderstanding)。误解通常发生在术语有歧义时（例如著名的 Raffles v. Wichelhaus "Peerless" 案，两艘船都叫 Peerless）。这里 "$1,100" 这个词没有歧义，意思非常明确。

选项 D 错误：
这不属于共同错误 (Mutual Mistake)。共同错误要求双方都对同一个基本事实有错误的信念（例如双方都以为这头牛不孕，但其实它怀孕了）。本案中，只有开发商搞错了价格，农场主没有错。

MBE 考试技巧

遇到“价格写错”类的题目，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 看差价： 错误价格是否与市场价相差巨大？
    • 如果差价巨大（如卖法拉利只要 $10），对方属于 "Snapping up the offer"（捡漏），合同通常不可强制执行。
    • 如果差价合理（如本题），对方属于 "Good faith reliance"（善意信赖），合同有效。
  2. 分清单方/共同： 是只有一方搞错了，还是双方都基于一个错误的假设？
  3. 坚持客观理论： 除非有欺诈或知情，否则写下来的就是算数的。
MBE Contracts Review | 2025 Edition

questions.question:
An innkeeper, who had no previous experience in the motel or commercial laundry business and who knew nothing about the trade usages of either business, bought a motel and signed an agreement with a laundry company for the motel's laundry services. The agreement was for a term of one year and provided for "daily service at $500 a week." From their conversations during negotiation, the laundry company owner knew that the innkeeper expected laundry services seven days a week. When the laundry company refused to pick up the motel's laundry on two successive Sundays and indicated that it would never do so, the innkeeper canceled the agreement.
The laundry company sued the innkeeper for breach of contract. At trial, clear evidence was introduced to show that in the commercial laundry business "daily service" did not include service on Sundays.
Is the laundry company likely to succeed in its action?

choices.a: No, because the laundry company knew the meaning the innkeeper attached to "daily service," and therefore the innkeeper's meaning will control.
choices.b: No, because the parties attached materially different meanings to "daily service," and therefore no contract was formed.
choices.c: Yes, because the parol evidence rule will not permit the innkeeper to prove the meaning he attached to "daily service."
choices.d: Yes, because the trade usage will control the interpretation of "daily service."

data.questionStem:
Q81040

An innkeeper, who had no previous experience in the motel or commercial laundry business and who knew nothing about the trade usages of either business, bought a motel and signed an agreement with a laundry company for the motel's laundry services. The agreement was for a term of one year and provided for "daily service at $500 a week." From their conversations during negotiation, the laundry company owner knew that the innkeeper expected laundry services seven days a week. When the laundry company refused to pick up the motel's laundry on two successive Sundays and indicated that it would never do so, the innkeeper canceled the agreement.

The laundry company sued the innkeeper for breach of contract. At trial, clear evidence was introduced to show that in the commercial laundry business "daily service" did not include service on Sundays.

Is the laundry company likely to succeed in its action?

一位旅店老板，其先前在汽车旅馆或商业洗衣业务方面没有任何经验，也对这两个行业的行业惯例一无所知，他购买了一家汽车旅馆，并与一家洗衣公司就该旅馆的洗衣服务签订了一份协议。该协议为期一年，规定了“每日服务，每周500美元”。从他们谈判期间的对话中，洗衣公司老板知道旅店老板期望每周七天的洗衣服务。当洗衣公司连续两个星期日拒绝收取汽车旅馆的待洗衣物，并表示永远不会在星期日提供服务时，旅店老板解除了该协议。

洗衣公司以违约为由起诉了该旅店老板。在庭审中，有明确证据被提交，证明在商业洗衣行业中，“每日服务”不包括星期日的服务。

洗衣公司在此诉讼中是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the laundry company knew the meaning the innkeeper attached to "daily service," and therefore the innkeeper's meaning will control.
不会，因为洗衣公司知道旅店老板赋予“每日服务”的含义，因此应以旅店老板的理解为准。

B. No, because the parties attached materially different meanings to "daily service," and therefore no contract was formed.
不会，因为双方对“每日服务”赋予了实质上不同的含义，因此合同并未成立。

C. Yes, because the parol evidence rule will not permit the innkeeper to prove the meaning he attached to "daily service."
会，因为口头证据规则不允许旅店老板证明他赋予“每日服务”的含义。

D. Yes, because the trade usage will control the interpretation of "daily service."
会，因为行业惯例将决定“每日服务”的解释。
data.explanation:
A misunderstanding occurs when the parties to a contract attach different meanings to the same term. If the misunderstanding involves a material term , most often there is no contract because there is no meeting of the minds. But if one party knows or has reason to know about the misunderstanding, then a valid contract will be formed based on the meaning of the term as understood by the unknowing party.

Here, the laundry company agreed to provide "daily service" to the innkeeper's motel. The innkeeper included Sundays in "daily service" but the laundry company - per trade usage in the commercial laundry business - did not, so the parties attached different meanings to the term. Since the laundry company knew that the innkeeper expected laundry services seven days a week, including Sundays, the innkeeper's understanding of "daily service" will control. Therefore, the laundry company is unlikely to succeed (Choice B).

(Choice C) The parol evidence rule generally bars evidence of a prior oral or written agreement to modify or contradict the terms of a final written agreement. However, parol evidence is admissible to establish an ambiguous term - eg, when, as here, a term is subject to a misunderstanding.

(Choice D) Trade usage can be used to show that a word or phrase has a particular meaning - eg, that "daily service" does not include Sundays in the commercial laundry business. But trade usage will not control when, as here, a party knows that the other party attaches a different meaning to the term.

Educational objective: When one party to a contract knows or has reason to know that the other party attaches a different meaning to a material term, then the unknowing party's meaning of the term will control.



选项正确率统计：A选项 77%（正确选项），B选项 9%，C选项 1%，D选项 11%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当合同双方对同一术语赋予不同含义时，便产生了误解。如果该误解涉及实质性条款，那么由于双方意思表示不一致，合同通常不成立。但是，如果一方知道或有理由知道存在误解，那么将根据不知情一方对该术语的理解来成立一份有效合同。

在本案中，洗衣公司同意为旅店老板的汽车旅馆提供“每日服务”。旅店老板认为“每日服务”包括星期日，但根据商业洗衣行业的行业惯例，洗衣公司不这么认为，因此双方对该术语赋予了不同的含义。由于洗衣公司知道旅店老板期望每周七天的洗衣服务，包括星期日，因此应以旅店老板对“每日服务”的理解为准。因此，洗衣公司不太可能胜诉（选项B）。

（选项C）口头证据规则通常排除用先前的口头或书面协议来修改或否定最终书面协议条款的证据。然而，口头证据在用于澄清模糊术语时是可采纳的——例如，像本案这样，一个术语存在误解的情况。

（选项D）行业惯例可以用来证明一个词或短语具有特定含义——例如，在商业洗衣行业中“每日服务”不包括星期日。但是，当一方知道另一方对该术语赋予了不同含义时，如本案所示，行业惯例将不起决定性作用。

教学目标：当合同一方知道或有理由知道另一方对某一实质性条款赋予了不同含义时，应以不知情一方对该术语的理解为准。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 201 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (whose meaning prevails when a misunderstanding occurs).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Interpretation & Misunderstanding
核心考点：合同解释与误解

当双方对合同条款产生误解（Misunderstanding）时，如果一方知道（Knows）或有理由知道（Has reason to know）另一方的理解，而另一方对此不知情，则合同以不知情一方的理解为准成立。

参考来源：Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 201

案情逻辑推演
1
争议条款："Daily service"（每日服务）。
2
双方理解不一致：
旅店老板（Innkeeper）：理解为 7 天/周。
洗衣公司（Laundry Co.）：理解为 6 天/周（基于行业惯例 Trade Usage）。
3
关键事实（Key Fact）：
洗衣公司在谈判中知道旅店老板期望的是 7 天服务。而旅店老板是新手，不知道行业惯例。
4
法律适用：
因为洗衣公司是“知情方”（Guilty Party），旅店老板是“不知情方”（Innocent Party），法律保护不知情方。
结论：合同按照旅店老板的理解（7天）成立。洗衣公司违约。
为什么选项 A 是正确的？

选项 A 准确陈述了规则：洗衣公司知道旅店老板赋予“每日服务”的含义。在这种情况下，知情方的沉默被视为对不知情方含义的默许。因此，合同不仅成立，而且是按照旅店老板的理解（包括周日）成立的。洗衣公司未提供周日服务，构成违约，故无法胜诉。

干扰项陷阱解析
选项 B (No Contract Formed) 错误原因： 只有当双方对重大条款有误解，且双方都不知道对方的含义时，才属于“没有合意”（No meeting of the minds），导致合同不成立。本题中一方知情，因此合同成立。
选项 C (Parol Evidence Rule) 错误原因： 口头证据规则（PER）禁止引入外部证据来改变书面合同。但 PER 永远允许引入证据来解释（Interpret）模糊术语或证明合同因误解而不成立。
选项 D (Trade Usage) 错误原因： 虽然行业惯例（Trade Usage）通常用于解释合同，但它不能凌驾于实际认知之上。如果一方明确知道另一方不了解行业惯例且有不同理解，行业惯例就不再适用。
MBE 考试技巧：
看到“行业惯例” vs “一方的具体认知”时，
具体的认知（Subjective Intent known to the other party）
通常优于客观的行业标准。

questions.question:
A music artist and a talent manager orally agreed that the manager would oversee the business aspects of the artist's career for five years in return for 15% of the artist's gross earnings. Both the artist and the manager had the right to terminate the agreement at any time. The manager received less than 15% of the artist's gross earnings during the first year and no commissions during the following six months. At that time, the artist called the manager to say that he was terminating their agreement.
The manager sued the artist for breach of contract, and the artist raised the statute of frauds as a defense.
Is the artist's statute of frauds defense likely to succeed?

choices.a: No, because both the artist and the manager had the right to terminate the agreement at any time.
choices.b: No, because the parties have partially performed the agreement.
choices.c: Yes, because neither party fully performed the agreement within the first year.
choices.d: Yes, because the parties' oral contract cannot be fully performed within one year.

data.questionStem:
Q81036

A music artist and a talent manager orally agreed that the manager would oversee the business aspects of the artist's career for five years in return for 15% of the artist's gross earnings. Both the artist and the manager had the right to terminate the agreement at any time. The manager received less than 15% of the artist's gross earnings during the first year and no commissions during the following six months. At that time, the artist called the manager to say that he was terminating their agreement.

The manager sued the artist for breach of contract, and the artist raised the statute of frauds as a defense.

Is the artist's statute of frauds defense likely to succeed?

一位音乐艺人与一名人才经理口头约定，由该经理负责监管艺人职业生涯的商业方面，为期五年，作为回报，经理将获得艺人总收入的15%。艺人和经理双方均有权随时终止该协议。在第一年，该经理收到的报酬少于艺人总收入的15%，而在接下来的六个月里没有收到任何佣金。那时，艺人致电经理，表示要终止他们的协议。

经理以违约为由起诉该艺人，而艺人则提出“防止欺诈法”(statute of frauds)作为抗辩理由。

该艺人以“防止欺诈法”提出的抗辩是否可能成功？
options:
A. No, because both the artist and the manager had the right to terminate the agreement at any time.
不会，因为艺人和经理均有权随时终止协议。

B. No, because part performance removed the parties' agreement from the statute of frauds.
不会，因为部分履行使双方的协议不受“防止欺诈法”的约束。

C. Yes, because neither the artist nor the manager fully performed the agreement within the first year.
会，因为在第一年内，艺人和经理均未完全履行协议。

D. Yes, because the one-year provision of the statute prevents enforcement of the parties' promises.
会，因为“防止欺诈法”的一年期条款阻碍了双方承诺的执行。
data.explanation:
One-year provision of statute of frauds


RuleContracts whose terms make it impossible for any party to fully perform within one year
ApplicabilityExcludes contracts of uncertain duration (eg, lifetime contracts)
Effect of performancePart performance - does not remove contract from statute, but restitution available for reasonable value of performance rendered
Full performance - removes contract from statute, whether or not performance is completed within a year
Effect of option to terminate within a year†Majority rule - does not remove contract from statute, because termination is not performance
Minority rule - removes contract from statute, because duration of contract is uncertain
†Jurisdictions agree that where only the plaintiff has the option to terminate, the statute of frauds applies.

A contract falls within the one-year provision of the statute of frauds - and must therefore be in writing to be enforceable - if its terms make it impossible for any party to fully perform within one year of its making.† However, jurisdictions are split as to whether both parties' option to terminate the contract within a year removes it from the statute:
  • Minority rule - the option to terminate removes the contract from the statute, because the duration of the agreement is uncertain
  • Majority rule - the option to terminate does not remove the contract from the statute, because the agreement may not be fully performed before its termination
Here, the parties' oral agreement that the manager would oversee the business aspects of the artist's career for five years is unenforceable under the one-year provision of the statute of frauds. This is true under the majority rule even though both parties had the option to terminate the agreement at any time. Accordingly, the artist's statute of frauds defense will likely succeed (Choice A).

†The writing must be signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought and state with reasonable certainty the essential terms of the deal.

(Choice B) Part performance does not remove a contract from the one-year provision of the statute of frauds. But it may entitle a party (eg, the manager) to restitution for the reasonable value of the performance rendered, which is usually the contract value for that performance.

(Choice C) Full performance by one party removes a contract from the statute's one-year provision - regardless of whether the performance is completed within a year of the contract's making. Therefore, the fact that neither party fully performed within the first year is of no consequence here.

Educational objective: The one-year provision of the statute of frauds applies to a contract whose terms make it impossible for any party to fully perform within one year. However, the parties' option to terminate the contract within a year does not remove it from the statute under the majority rule.

选项正确率统计：A选项 26%，B选项 31%，C选项 9%，D选项 31%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

防止欺诈法的一年期条款


规则合同条款致使任何一方都不可能在一年内完全履行的合同
适用性不包括存续期不确定的合同（例如，终身合同）
履行的效力部分履行 - 不能使合同免受法规约束，但可就已提供履行的合理价值获得返还
完全履行 - 使合同免受法规约束，无论履行是否在一年内完成
一年内终止选择权的效力†多数派规则 - 不能使合同免受法规约束，因为终止并非履行
少数派规则 - 使合同免受法规约束，因为合同的存续期不确定
†各司法管辖区一致认为，当仅有原告方拥有终止选择权时，“防止欺诈法”适用。

如果一个合同的条款使其任何一方都不可能在订立后一年内完全履行，则该合同属于“防止欺诈法”(statute of frauds)一年期条款的管辖范围——因此必须以书面形式订立方可强制执行。† 然而，关于双方均拥有在一年内终止合同的选择权是否能使合同免受该法规约束，各司法管辖区存在分歧：
  • 少数派规则 - 终止选择权能使合同免受法规约束，因为协议的存续期不确定
  • 多数派规则 - 终止选择权不能使合同免受法规约束，因为在终止前，协议可能未被完全履行
在本案中，双方口头约定由经理监管艺人职业生涯的商业方面，为期五年，根据“防止欺诈法”的一年期条款，该约定不可强制执行。根据多数派规则，尽管双方均有权随时终止协议，此结论依然成立。因此，该艺人以“防止欺诈法”提出的抗辩很可能会成功（选项A）。

†书面文件必须由被要求执行的一方签署，并以合理的确定性陈述交易的基本条款。

（选项B）部分履行不能使合同免于“防止欺诈法”一年期条款的约束。但这可能使一方（例如，经理）有权就已提供履行的合理价值获得返还，该价值通常是该履行的合同价值。

（选项C）一方的完全履行可使合同免于该法规一年期条款的约束——无论该履行是否在合同订立后一年内完成。因此，双方在第一年内均未完全履行这一事实在此处无关紧要。

教学目标：“防止欺诈法”的一年期条款适用于其条款使得任何一方都不可能在一年内完全履行的合同。然而，根据多数派规则，双方在一年内终止合同的选择权并不能使合同免于该法规的约束。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 130 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (one-year provision of the statute of frauds).
  • 72 Am. Jur. 2d Statute of Frauds § 19 (2020) (explaining that the option to terminate a contract within a year does not remove the contract from the statute of frauds).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：防止欺诈法与一年期条款

正确答案：D
是的，因为“防止欺诈法”的一年期条款阻碍了双方承诺的执行。

本题考察的是合同法中防止欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds, SoF) 的核心考点之一：一年期条款 (One-Year Provision)。

1. 核心法律规则

一年期规则 (The One-Year Rule)

如果一份合同的条款使得任何一方都不可能 (Impossible) 在合同订立之日起的一年内完全履行 (Fully Perform)，则该合同必须采用书面形式才能强制执行。

Contracts that cannot be performed within one year must be in writing.

2. 案情分析

在本案中，合同的关键特征如下：

  • 形式：口头协议 (Oral Agreement)。
  • 期限：固定为期五年 (Five Years)。
  • 终止权：双方可随时终止 (Right to terminate at any time)。

由于合同明确规定期限为5年，从逻辑上讲，要“完全履行”这份为期5年的合同，必然需要超过1年的时间。因此，该合同落入 SoF 的管辖范围，必须书面签署才有效。

3. 难点辨析：终止权 vs. 履行

这是本题最大的陷阱（也是选项 A 错误的原因）。考生常会困惑：“既然可以随时终止，那不是可能在一年内结束吗？”

多数派规则 (Majority Rule)

在大多数司法管辖区（以及 MBE 考试标准）中：

终止 (Termination) ≠ 履行 (Performance)

如果一方在一年内行使终止权，合同虽然结束了，但这被视为合同被“切断”或“废止”，而不是合同被“履行”了。合同的本意是履行5年，任何短于5年的结果都不是“完全履行”。

因此，尽管有终止条款，该口头合同依然违反了 SoF，艺人可以成功提出抗辩，导致合同不可强制执行。

4. 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (错误)： 认为终止权使合同免受 SoF 约束。如上所述，这是少数派观点。MBE 通常测试多数派规则，即终止不等于履行。
选项 B (错误)： 认为“部分履行” (Part Performance) 可以例外。
考点警示： 在涉及土地买卖的合同中，部分履行可能例外；但在一年期条款下，部分履行通常不能使合同免受 SoF 约束。经理只能通过“不当得利” (Restitution / Quantum Meruit) 索要已工作部分的合理报酬，但不能依据合同索赔违约金。
选项 C (错误)： 提到第一年未完全履行。这与法律分析无关。关键在于合同订立时的条款是否允许在一年内完成，而不是实际发生了什么。

5. 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 中遇到口头合同题：

  1. 看期限：是固定期限（如 "for 2 years"）还是不确定期限（如 "for life"）？
  2. 固定期限 > 1年： 必须书面（即使有终止条款）。
  3. 不确定期限 / 终身： 不需要书面（因为理论上人可能在一年内去世，从而“完全履行”终身合同）。

questions.question:
For an agreed price of $20 million, a construction company contracted with a real estate developer to design and build on the developer's commercial plot a 15-story office building. In excavating for the foundation and underground utilities, the construction company encountered a massive layer of granite at a depth of 15 feet. By reasonable safety criteria, the building's foundation required a minimum excavation of 25 feet.
When the contract was made, neither the real estate developer nor the construction company was aware of the subsurface granite and neither party had hired a qualified expert to test for subsurface granite.
Claiming accurately that removal of enough granite to permit the construction as planned would cost the construction company an additional $3 million and a probable net loss on the contract of $2 million, the construction company refused to proceed with the work unless the real estate developer would promise to pay an additional $2.5 million for the completed building.
If the real estate developer refuses and sues the construction company for breach of contract, which of the following will the court probably decide?

choices.a: The construction company is excused, because the contract is voidable on account of the parties' mutual mistake concerning an essential underlying fact.
choices.b: The construction company is excused under the modern doctrine of supervening impossibility, which includes severe impracticability.
choices.c: The real estate developer prevails, because the construction company assumed the risk of encountering subsurface granite that was unknown to the real estate developer.
choices.d: The real estate developer prevails, unless subsurface granite was previously unknown anywhere in the vicinity of the real estate developer's construction site.

data.questionStem:
Q81049

For an agreed price of $20 million, a construction company contracted with a real estate developer to design and build on the developer's commercial plot a 15-story office building. In excavating for the foundation and underground utilities, the construction company encountered a massive layer of granite at a depth of 15 feet. By reasonable safety criteria, the building's foundation required a minimum excavation of 25 feet.

When the contract was made, neither the real estate developer nor the construction company was aware of the subsurface granite and neither party had hired a qualified expert to test for subsurface granite.

Claiming accurately that removal of enough granite to permit the construction as planned would cost the construction company an additional $3 million and a probable net loss on the contract of $2 million, the construction company refused to proceed with the work unless the real estate developer would promise to pay an additional $2.5 million for the completed building.

If the real estate developer refuses and sues the construction company for breach of contract, which of the following will the court probably decide?

一家建筑公司与一家房地产开发商签订合同，以2000万美元的约定价格在开发商的商业地块上设计并建造一栋15层的办公楼。在为地基和地下设施进行挖掘时，建筑公司在15英尺深处遇到了一块巨大的花岗岩层。根据合理的安全标准，该建筑的地基需要至少挖掘25英尺。

签订合同时，房地产开发商和建筑公司都不知道地下有花岗岩，双方也都没有聘请合格的专家来检测地下花岗岩。

建筑公司准确地声称，为了按计划施工而移除足够的花岗岩将使其额外花费300万美元，并可能在合同上造成200万美元的净亏损。因此，建筑公司拒绝继续施工，除非房地产开发商承诺为完工的建筑额外支付250万美元。

如果房地产开发商拒绝并以违约为由起诉建筑公司，法院可能会做出以下哪项判决？
options:
A. The construction company is excused, because the contract is voidable on account of the parties' mutual mistake concerning an essential underlying fact.
建筑公司被免除责任，因为合同因双方对一项关键基础事实存在共同错误而可被撤销。

B. The construction company is excused under the modern doctrine of supervening impossibility, which includes severe impracticability.
根据现代的后发不能（supervening impossibility）原则，建筑公司被免除责任，该原则包括了履行困难（severe impracticability）。

C. The real estate developer prevails, because the construction company assumed the risk of encountering subsurface granite that was unknown to the real estate developer.
房地产开发商胜诉，因为建筑公司承担了遇到房地产开发商所不知晓的地下花岗岩的风险。

D. The real estate developer prevails, unless subsurface granite was previously unknown anywhere in the vicinity of the real estate developer's construction site.
房地产开发商胜诉，除非在该房地产开发商建筑工地附近的任何地方，以前都不知道有地下花岗岩的存在。
data.explanation:
When party assumes risk of mistake


ExpressContract allocates risk to party
Conscious ignoranceParty enters contract despite conscious ignorance of facts related to mistake
AdjudicationCourt allocates risk to party because reasonable under circumstances
When both parties enter a contract based on the same mistake (ie, mutual mistake), the contract is voidable by an adversely affected party if:
  • the mistake relates to a basic assumption of the contract
  • the mistake materially affects the agreed-upon exchange of performances (ie, the adversely affected party cannot fairly be required to carry it out) and
  • the adversely affected party did not assume the risk of the mistake.

Here, when the contract was made, neither party knew that there was a massive layer of granite 15 feet below the surface. That mutual mistake related to a basic assumption of the contract since the building's foundation required a minimum excavation of 25 feet. And it materially affected the agreed-upon exchange since removing the granite would cost the construction company $3 million and likely cause a net loss of $2 million. However, the court will probably decide that the construction company assumed the risk of encountering the subsurface granite because:
  • there is a foreseeable risk of encountering subsurface granite in excavation projects like this one and
  • as a professional builder, the construction company should have been aware of this risk and so acted unreasonably by failing to hire a qualified expert to test for subsurface granite (Choice D).

Therefore, the real estate developer will likely prevail in a breach-of-contract suit against the construction company (Choice A).

(Choice B) As with mutual mistake, the doctrine of impossibility does not apply where the adversely affected party assumed the risk of the event that rendered performance impossible or severely impracticable (here, encountering subsurface granite).

Educational objective: Mutual mistake renders a contract voidable by the adversely affected party when (1) the mistake relates to a basic assumption of the contract, (2) the mistake materially affects the agreed-upon exchange of performances, and (3) the adversely affected party did not assume the risk of the mistake.

选项正确率统计：A选项 29%，B选项 14%，C选项 33%（正确选项），D选项 22%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

一方承担错误风险的情形


明示约定合同将风险分配给一方
有意识的不知一方在有意识地不知晓与错误相关事实的情况下签订合同
法院裁定法院根据具体情况将风险分配给一方是合理的
当合同双方基于同一错误（即共同错误）签订合同时，如果满足以下条件，受不利影响的一方可以撤销该合同：
  • 该错误与合同的基本假定有关
  • 该错误对约定的对待给付交换产生重大影响（即，不能公平地要求受不利影响的一方履行合同）并且
  • 受不利影响的一方并未承担该错误的风险。

在本案中，签订合同时，双方都不知道地表下15英尺处有巨大的花岗岩层。这一共同错误与合同的一项基本假定有关，因为建筑地基要求至少挖掘25英尺。并且，它对约定的对待给付产生了重大影响，因为移除花岗岩将使建筑公司花费300万美元，并可能导致200万美元的净亏损。然而，法院很可能会裁定，建筑公司承担了遇到地下花岗岩的风险，因为：
  • 在此类挖掘项目中，遇到地下花岗岩是一种可预见的风险，并且
  • 作为专业的建筑商，建筑公司本应意识到这种风险，但其未能聘请合格的专家来检测地下花岗岩，其行为是不合理的（选项D）。

因此，房地产开发商很可能在对建筑公司的违约诉讼中胜诉（选项A）。

（选项B）与共同错误一样，在受不利影响的一方已承担致使履行不能或履行极为困难的事件（此处指遇到地下花岗岩）的风险时，履行不能（impossibility）原则不适用。

教学目标：当(1) 错误与合同的基本假定有关，(2) 错误对约定的对待给付交换产生重大影响，且 (3) 受不利影响的一方并未承担该错误的风险时，该共同错误可使合同被受不利影响的一方撤销。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 153 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (one party's mistake makes contract voidable).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 154 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when party bears risk of mistake).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Mistake & Risk Allocation

正确答案

选项 C (Choice C)

房地产开发商胜诉，因为建筑公司承担了遇到地下花岗岩的风险。

核心考点：共同错误与风险承担

本题考察的是合同法中的共同错误 (Mutual Mistake) 抗辩及其例外情况。

根据《合同法重述（第二次）》§ 152，如果双方对合同的基本事实存在共同错误，受损方可以撤销合同 (Voidable)，但必须同时满足以下三个条件：
  1. 错误涉及合同的基本假设 (Basic assumption)；
  2. 错误对双方的交换产生了重大影响 (Material effect)；
  3. 受损方并未承担该错误的风险 (Did not bear the risk of the mistake)。

本题的关键在于第3点：风险承担 (Assumption of Risk)。

深度解析：为什么建筑商输了？

虽然双方都不知道地下有花岗岩（共同错误），且移除成本高昂（重大影响），但法院通常判定建筑商 (Builder) 承担不可预见土壤状况的风险。

法律逻辑如下：

  • 专业知识 (Expertise)： 建筑公司被视为该领域的专家。相比于开发商，建筑商更有能力去测试土壤或预见挖掘风险。
  • 固定价格合同 (Fixed-Price Contract)： 当建筑商同意以固定价格（2000万美元）建造特定建筑时，本质上是在承诺：“无论遇到什么困难，我都会在这个价格下完成工作。”
  • 合理的风险分配 (Reasonable Allocation)： 除非合同中有具体的“现场条件差异条款” (Differing Site Conditions Clause)，否则普通法默认将自然条件的风险分配给承诺施工的一方。

因此，建筑商属于《合同法重述》§ 154 中规定的“法院认为根据具体情况将风险分配给该方是合理的”情形。

为什么其他选项是错误的？

❌ 选项 A (Mutual Mistake)
虽然存在共同错误，但如上所述，建筑商承担了风险，因此不能以共同错误为由撤销合同。

❌ 选项 B (Impossibility/Impracticability)
履行不能 (Impossibility) 或 履行困难 (Impracticability) 通常要求情况极其极端（如战争、禁运、标的物灭失）。仅仅是成本增加（即使是增加300万美元）通常不足以构成“履行困难”，除非成本增加到了足以改变合同性质的程度。更重要的是，如果一方承担了风险，也不能引用此抗辩。

❌ 选项 D (Vicinity Knowledge)
这是一个干扰项。即使附近从未发现过花岗岩，作为承包商，未进行土壤测试就签订固定价格合同，依然被视为承担了该特定地块地下状况的风险。

💡 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip) 在涉及建筑合同 (Construction Contracts) 的题目中，如果遇到“未预见的地下状况”导致成本增加：

默认规则是：建筑商承担风险 (Builder bears the risk)。

除非：
  1. 合同中有明确的免责条款；
  2. 由于自然灾害导致已建成的部分被毁（这是另一个考点）；
  3. 业主隐瞒了已知信息（欺诈）。
单纯的“由于地质坚硬导致挖掘变贵”，建筑商必须硬着头皮干，不能加钱。

questions.question:
A contractor was supervising a crew of subcontractors during a house renovation. The contractor saw one of the subcontractors, a carpenter, steal a watch from the house. The contractor said nothing about the theft, and the crew finished the work and left.
Several weeks later, the contractor was hired to renovate another house. The contractor called the carpenter and said that he would need the carpenter to do this job for 25% less than his previous rate. The reduced rate reflected the market value of the work, but the carpenter refused. The contractor then told the carpenter that he had seen the carpenter steal the watch and that he would notify the police if the carpenter did not agree to the contractor's terms. The carpenter agreed to do the work for the lower rate.
The carpenter never showed up to perform any work at the second house.
If the contractor sues the carpenter for breach of contract, will the contractor be likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the contractor did not notify the police immediately after he saw the carpenter steal the watch.
choices.b: No, because the contractor threatened to notify the police that the carpenter had stolen the watch.
choices.c: Yes, because the contractor's proposed rate, which reflected the fair market value of the carpenter's work, was not unconscionable.
choices.d: Yes, because the contractor was legally authorized to notify the police that the carpenter had stolen the watch.

一名承包商在一次房屋翻新工程中监督一组分包商。该承包商看到其中一名分包商，一个木匠，从房子里偷了一块手表。承包商对这起盗窃行为只字未提，工人们完成了工作并离开了。

几周后，该承包商受雇翻新另一栋房子。承包商打电话给那个木匠，说他需要木匠来做这项工作，但报酬要比之前的费率低25%。这个降低后的费率反映了该工作的市场价值，但木匠拒绝了。然后，承包商告诉木匠，他曾看到木匠偷手表，如果木匠不同意他的条款，他就会报警。木匠同意以较低的费率进行这项工作。

木匠从未出现在第二栋房子里履行任何工作。

如果承包商以违约为由起诉木匠，承包商是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the contractor did not notify the police immediately after he saw the carpenter steal the watch.
否，因为承包商在看到木匠偷手表后没有立即报警。

B. No, because the contractor threatened to notify the police that the carpenter had stolen the watch.
否，因为承包商威胁要报警称木匠偷了手表。

C. Yes, because the contractor's proposed rate, which reflected the fair market value of the carpenter's work, was not unconscionable.
是，因为承包商提出的费率反映了木匠工作的公平市场价值，并且并非不合情理。

D. Yes, because the contractor was legally authorized to notify the police that the carpenter had stolen the watch.
是，因为承包商在法律上有权报警称木匠偷了手表。
data.explanation:
Improper threats


Always improperImproper if resulting terms are unfair
  • Threat to commit crime or tort
  • Threat of criminal prosecution
  • Threat of civil litigation made in bad faith
  • Threat that breaches contractual duty of good faith & fair dealing
  • Threatened act would harm recipient & not significantly benefit threatening party
  • Threat's effectiveness significantly increased by threatening party's prior unfair dealing
  • Threatened act would otherwise constitute use of power for illegitimate ends
Some threats made during contract negotiations are proper - eg, threats to walk away if an offer is rejected. But the following threats are always improper:
  • Threats to commit a crime or a tort
  • Threats of criminal prosecution, even if the person threatened committed the crime
  • Threats of civil litigation made in bad faith
  • Threats that breach the duty of good faith and fair dealing under an existing contract with the recipient


A contract is voidable on duress grounds if either party's assent was induced by an improper threat that left the recipient with no reasonable alternative but to assent.

Here, the contractor made an improper threat of criminal prosecution when he said that he would notify the police that the carpenter had stolen a watch. This induced the carpenter to accept the contractor's terms, as evidenced by the carpenter's initial rejection of the lower rate. And since the carpenter actually stole the watch, he had no reasonable alternative but to assent to avoid prosecution. Therefore, the contract is voidable due to duress, and the contractor is unlikely to prevail.

(Choice A) The contractor had no duty to notify the police that the carpenter stole the watch. Therefore, had the contractor refrained from making an improper threat, his failure to notify the police immediately would not prevent him from prevailing in a breach-of-contract suit.

(Choice C) A contract may be unenforceable based on unconscionability if its terms were so unfair to one party that no reasonable person would have agreed to it (not seen here). But a contract whose terms are not unconscionable may still be unenforceable on duress grounds.

(Choice D) The contractor was legally authorized to notify the police about the theft. But this did not give the contractor the right to use the criminal justice system as leverage in his contract negotiation with the carpenter.

Educational objective: A contract is voidable due to duress if either party's assent was induced by an improper threat (eg, threat of criminal prosecution) that left the recipient with no reasonable alternative but to assent.

选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 80%（正确选项），C选项 13%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

不正当威胁


始终构成不正当若导致条款不公，则构成不正当
  • 威胁实施犯罪或侵权行为
  • 威胁进行刑事起诉
  • 恶意提起民事诉讼的威胁
  • 违反善意与公平交易之合同义务的威胁
  • 被威胁的行为将损害相对方且不会为威胁方带来重大利益
  • 因威胁方先前的非公平交易行为，威胁的有效性被显著增强
  • 被威胁的行为在其他方面构成不正当目的之权力滥用
合同谈判中的某些威胁是正当的——例如，在要约被拒时威胁退出谈判。但以下威胁则始终构成不正当：
  • 威胁实施犯罪或侵权行为
  • 威胁进行刑事起诉，即使被威胁者确实犯了罪
  • 恶意提起民事诉讼的威胁
  • 违反与相对方现有合同项下的善意与公平交易义务的威胁


如果一方当事人的同意是由不正当威胁所引诱，而该威胁使相对方除了同意之外别无合理选择，则该合同可因胁迫而被撤销。

在本案中，承包商声称他将报警称木匠偷了手表，此举构成了不正当的刑事起诉威胁。这诱使木匠接受了承包商的条款，木匠最初拒绝较低费率即是证明。并且，由于木匠确实偷了手表，他为避免被起诉，除了同意别无合理选择。因此，该合同因胁迫而可被撤销，承包商不大可能胜诉。

(选项 A) 承包商没有义务就木匠偷窃手表一事报警。因此，假如承包商没有作出不正当威胁，他未立即报警的行为，并不会阻碍其在违约诉讼中胜诉。

(选项 C) 如果合同的条款对一方当事人极不公平，以至于任何理性人都不会同意（本案并非如此），则该合同可因不合情理而不可执行。但是，一个条款本身并非不合情理的合同，仍可因胁迫而不可执行。

(选项 D) 承包商在法律上有权就盗窃一事报警。但这并未赋予承包商利用刑事司法系统作为其与木匠进行合同谈判筹码的权利。

教学目标：如果一方当事人的同意是由不正当威胁（例如，刑事起诉的威胁）所引诱，而该威胁使相对方除了同意之外别无合理选择，则该合同可因胁迫而被撤销。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 175 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when duress by threat makes a contract voidable).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 176 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (improper threats).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：合同抗辩事由

核心结论：承包商不会胜诉。因为他利用报警（刑事起诉）作为威胁手段迫使木匠签订合同，这构成了胁迫 (Duress)，使得合同可被撤销。

⚖️ 法律规则：不正当威胁

Improper Threat (不正当威胁)

根据《合同法重述（第二次）》§ 176，如果一方的同意 (Assent) 是由不正当威胁诱导的，且受害方没有合理的替代方案，则合同因胁迫而可撤销 (Voidable)。

以下威胁始终被视为“不正当”：

  • 威胁实施犯罪或侵权行为 (Crime or Tort)。
  • 威胁进行刑事起诉 (Criminal Prosecution)。
  • 恶意提起民事诉讼的威胁。

🔍 案情分析逻辑

1
威胁的性质：承包商威胁说，如果木匠不接受降价 25%，他就会报警（揭发盗窃）。这属于以刑事起诉为要挟。
2
法律效力：无论木匠是否真的偷了东西，利用刑事司法系统作为谈判筹码来获取私人合同利益（更低的价格），在合同法上都是不正当威胁。
3
因果关系：木匠最初拒绝了降价，但在受到威胁后同意了。这证明威胁诱导了同意 (Induced Assent)。
4
结论：合同因胁迫 (Duress) 而成立，木匠作为受害方有权撤销合同。既然合同可撤销，承包商就无法强制执行，因此败诉。

🚫 易错点辨析

关于选项 C (市场价值)
错误原因：即使合同条款本身是公平的（反映了市场价值），或者并非“显失公平 (Unconscionable)”，只要同意的过程存在胁迫，合同依然不可执行。胁迫关注的是同意的自愿性，而非交易结果的公平性。
关于选项 D (报警的权利)
错误原因：承包商确实有权报警（这是合法的），但他没有权利利用报警作为威胁来迫使对方签订合同。
关键区别：直接报警 = 合法；威胁报警以换取合同利益 = 不正当威胁。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 合同法题目中，如果你看到一方说：“如果你不签这个合同/不降价，我就去告发你犯罪/报警抓你。”

👉 直接判定为胁迫 (Duress)。

不要被以下事实干扰：

  • 受害者真的犯了罪（这不重要）。
  • 提出的合同价格很公道（这也不重要）。

During an ice storm, a man's car slipped down an embankment and became lodged against a large tree. The man called a towing company and told the company's manager that the car was 100 feet down the embankment. "That's lucky," said the manager, "because our winch only goes 100 feet." After the manager and the man agreed on a price, an employee of the company attempted to reach the car but could not because the car turned out to be 120 feet down the embankment.
Is the towing company's performance excused on the grounds of mistake?

choices.a: No, because both parties were uncertain about the distance.
choices.b: No, because the towing company assumed the risk by the manager's failure to examine the distance himself.
choices.c: Yes, because at the time of contracting, both parties were mistaken about a basic assumption on which the contract was based.
choices.d: Yes, because the agreement did not allocate the risk of mistake to either party.

Q81801 During an ice storm, a man's car slipped down an embankment and became lodged against a large tree. The man called a towing company and told the company's manager that the car was 100 feet down the embankment. "That's lucky," said the manager, "because our winch only goes 100 feet." After the manager and the man agreed on a price, an employee of the company attempted to reach the car but could not because the car turned out to be 120 feet down the embankment.

Is the towing company's performance excused on the grounds of mistake? 在一场冰暴中，一名男子的车滑下路堤，卡在了一棵大树上。该男子致电一家拖车公司，并告知公司经理，车在路堤下方100英尺处。经理说：“那太幸运了，因为我们的绞车只能伸到100英尺。”在该男子与经理商定价格后，公司的一名员工试图去拖车，但未能成功，因为后来发现车在路堤下方120英尺处。

拖车公司的履约义务是否能以错误为由予以免除？
options:
A. No, because both parties were uncertain about the distance.
不可以，因为双方都不确定距离。

B. No, because the towing company assumed the risk by the manager's failure to examine the distance himself.
不可以，因为拖车公司因其经理未能亲自检查距离而承担了风险。

C. Yes, because at the time of contracting, both parties were mistaken about a basic assumption on which the contract was based.
可以，因为在订立合同时，双方对合同所依据的一项基本假定存在错误认识。

D. Yes, because the agreement did not allocate the risk of mistake to either party.
可以，因为协议未将错误的风险分配给任何一方。

When party assumes risk of mistake


ExpressContract allocates risk to party
Conscious
ignorance		Party enters contract despite conscious ignorance of facts related to
mistake
AdjudicationCourt allocates risk to party because reasonable under
circumstances
When both parties enter a contract based on the same mistake (ie, mutual mistake), the contract is voidable by the adversely affected party if:
  • the mistake relates to a basic assumption of the contract
  • the mistake materially affects the agreed-upon exchange of performances (ie, the adversely affected party cannot fairly be required to carry it out) and
  • the adversely affected party does not assume the risk of the mistake.


Here, both parties entered the agreement based on the erroneous belief that the man's car was 100 feet down the embankment (Choice A). That mistake relates to a basic assumption of the contract since the towing company's winch only goes 100 feet. And it materially affects the agreed-upon exchange because the towing company cannot be expected to tow a car that its winch cannot reach. Therefore, the towing company's performance will be excused because it also did not assume the risk of the mistake—ie:
  • the agreement did not expressly allocate the risk of the mistake to the towing company
  • there is no indication that the towing company knew that the man's car was probably more than 100 feet down the embankment and contracted to tow it anyway and
  • it would not be reasonable for a court to allocate the risk of the mistake to the towing company when its winch cannot even reach the car (Choice D).


(Choice B) A party's failure to know or discover facts before entering into a contract (eg, the manager's failure to examine the distance himself) does not prevent the party from avoiding the contract.

Educational objective: The adversely affected party can avoid a contract on the grounds of mutual mistake if (1) the mistake relates to a basic assumption of the contract, (2) the mistake materially affects the agreed exchange of performances, and (3) the adversely affected party does not assume the risk of the mistake.

当事人承担错误风险的情形


明示合同将风险分配给当事人
故意
不知		当事人尽管故意不知与错误相关的事实仍订立
合同
裁决法院因在当时情况下属合理而将风险分配给
当事人
当合同双方基于相同的错误（即共同错误）订立合同时，如果出现以下情况，受不利影响的一方可以撤销该合同：
  • 该错误与合同的基本假定有关
  • 该错误对约定的交换履行有重大影响（即，不能公平地要求受不利影响的一方履行合同）并且
  • 受不利影响的一方没有承担该错误的风险。


在本案中，双方都是基于该男子的车在路堤下方100英尺处的错误认识而达成协议的（选项A）。该错误与合同的一项基本假定有关，因为拖车公司的绞车只能伸到100英尺。而且，该错误对约定的交换履行有重大影响，因为不能指望拖车公司去拖一辆其绞车无法触及的汽车。因此，拖车公司的履约义务将被免除，因为它也没有承担错误的风险——即：
  • 协议没有将错误的风险明示分配给拖车公司
  • 没有迹象表明拖车公司知道该男子的车可能在路堤下方超过100英尺，却仍然签约拖车并且
  • 在拖车公司的绞车甚至无法触及汽车的情况下，由法院将错误的风险分配给拖车公司是不合理的（选项D）。


(选项B) 一方在订立合同前未能知晓或发现事实（例如，经理未能亲自检查距离），并不妨碍该方撤销合同。

教学目标： 受不利影响的一方可以基于共同错误为由撤销合同，条件是：（1）该错误与合同的一项基本假定有关；（2）该错误对约定的交换履行有重大影响；以及（3）受不利影响的一方没有承担该错误的风险。

References


  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 152 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when mutual
    mistake makes a contract voidable).

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 154 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when a party bears
    the risk of a mistake).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Mutual Mistake
⚖️ 核心规则：共同错误 (Mutual Mistake)

根据《合同法重述（第二版）》§ 152，当双方基于共同错误订立合同时，受不利影响的一方可以撤销合同（Voidable），需满足以下三个条件：

  • 错误涉及合同的基本假定 (Basic assumption)。
  • 错误对约定的交换履行产生重大影响 (Material effect)。
  • 受不利影响方未承担该错误的风险 (Did not assume the risk)。
🔍 本案分析

本题考察的是合同法中的免责事由 (Excuse of Performance)。

1. 共同错误的存在：
车主说车在100英尺处，拖车经理也基于此认为能拖上来。事实上车在120英尺处。双方在签约时对这一核心事实都存在错误认识。

2. 基本假定与重大影响：
经理明确表示“绞车只能伸到100英尺”，说明距离是合同能否履行的基本假定。120英尺的实际距离导致拖车公司根本无法完成工作，这对履行产生了重大影响。

3. 风险分配 (Risk Allocation)：
这是本题的关键（也是排除干扰项B的理由）。合同没有明文规定谁承担距离错误的风险。拖车公司依赖了车主的陈述，这种依赖是合理的，并不构成“自愿承担风险”。

✅ 正确答案 C 的逻辑：
因为双方对距离这一基本事实存在共同错误，且该错误导致合同目的落空，同时拖车公司并未承担此风险，因此其履约义务被免除。
🚫 易错项辨析

选项 B 错误 (The Trap)
考点：疏忽 vs. 承担风险
很多考生会认为经理没有亲自去测量就是“承担了风险”。但在合同法中，一般的疏忽 (Ordinary Negligence) 并不妨碍一方因错误而撤销合同。只有当一方处于“有意识的无知” (Conscious Ignorance) 状态——即明知自己由于信息不足而仍决定签约时，才视为承担了风险。本案中，经理是基于车主提供的具体数字（100英尺）而确信，并非“明知不知而为之”。

选项 A 错误
双方并非“不确定”(Uncertain)，而是确信了一个“错误的事实”。如果是“不确定”却依然签约，那才属于承担了风险。

💡 考试技巧：
在 MBE 考试中，遇到“Mistake”题目，首先判断是单方还是共同错误。如果是共同错误，重点检查受损方是否“承担了风险”（如合同条款分配或故意忽略不确定性）。

questions.question:
A ski-shop operator, in a telephone conversation with a glove manufacturer, ordered 12 pairs of vortex-lined ski gloves at the list price of $600 per dozen "for delivery in 30 days." The glove manufacturer orally accepted the offer and immediately faxed to the ski-shop operator this signed memo: "Confirming our agreement today for your purchase of a dozen pairs of vortex-lined ski gloves for $600, the shipment will be delivered in 30 days." Although the ski-shop operator received and read the manufacturer's message within minutes after its dispatch, she changed her mind three weeks later about the purchase and rejected the conforming shipment when it timely arrived.
On learning of the rejection, does the manufacturer have a cause of action against the ski-shop operator for breach of contract?

choices.a: No, because the ski-shop operator neither paid for nor accepted any of the goods tendered.
choices.b: No, because the ski-shop operator never signed a writing evidencing a contract with the manufacturer.
choices.c: Yes, because the gloves were identified in the contract and tendered to the ski-shop operator.
choices.d: Yes, because the manufacturer's faxed memo to the ski-shop operator was sufficient to make the agreement enforceable.

A ski-shop operator, in a telephone conversation with a glove manufacturer, ordered 12 pairs of vortex-lined ski gloves at the list price of $600 per dozen "for delivery in 30 days." The glove manufacturer orally accepted the offer and immediately faxed to the ski-shop operator this signed memo: "Confirming our agreement today for your purchase of a dozen pairs of vortex-lined ski gloves for $600, the shipment will be delivered in 30 days." Although the ski-shop operator received and read the manufacturer's message within minutes after its dispatch, she changed her mind three weeks later about the purchase and rejected the conforming shipment when it timely arrived.

On learning of the rejection, does the manufacturer have a cause of action against the ski-shop operator for breach of contract?

一位滑雪用品店经营者在与手套制造商的电话交谈中，以每打600美元的标价订购了12双vortex内衬滑雪手套，并要求“30天内交货”。手套制造商口头接受了该要约，并立即向该滑雪用品店经营者传真了一份经其签署的备忘录：“兹确认我们今日达成的协议，您以600美元的价格购买一打vortex内衬滑雪手套，货物将在30天内送达。”尽管该滑雪用品店经营者在制造商发出信息后的几分钟内便收到并阅读了此备忘录，但她在三周后改变了主意，并在符合合同约定的货物按时送达时予以拒收。

在得知拒收后，该制造商是否对滑雪用品店经营者有以违约为由的诉因？
options:
A. No, because the ski-shop operator neither paid for nor accepted any of the goods tendered.
否，因为滑雪用品店经营者既未付款，也未接受任何已交付的货物。

B. No, because the ski-shop operator never signed a writing evidencing a contract with the manufacturer.
否，因为滑雪用品店经营者从未签署任何能证明与制造商存在合同的书面文件。

C. Yes, because the gloves were identified in the contract and tendered to the ski-shop operator.
是，因为手套已在合同中被特定化，并已交付给滑雪用品店经营者。

D. Yes, because the manufacturer's faxed memo to the ski-shop operator was sufficient to make the agreement enforceable.
是，因为制造商传真给滑雪用品店经营者的备忘录足以使该协议具有可执行性。
data.explanation:
Statute of frauds requirements


Physical or electronic document(s) containing reasonable basis to believe contract was formed (eg, receipt, check, emails) AND
Writingat common law - identifies parties, subject matter, consideration, time & nature of performance
under UCC - lists quantity of goods (contract enforceable only up to written quantity)
SignatureGeneral rule - handwritten signature from, or other mark identifying, party to be charged (eg, letterhead, electronic signature, initials)
Merchant exception - between merchants, written confirmation that satisfies statute of frauds as to sender will bind both parties if no written objection within 10 days
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code
Under the statute of frauds, a contract for the sale of goods of $500 or more is only enforceable if it is in a writing signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought. The UCC relaxes these requirements in transactions between merchants so that the statute of frauds is met as to both parties if one party sends a written confirmation and the recipient does not object in writing within 10 days. The written confirmation must:
  • provide a reasonable basis to believe a contract was formed (eg, memo confirming the order)
  • contain the quantity of the goods or a means to determine it (eg, 12 pairs of vortex-lined ski gloves)
  • and contain a signature or other identification sufficient to bind the sender (eg, sender's fax number)

Here, the manufacturer faxed the ski-shop operator a memo confirming the order for 12 pairs of vortex-lined ski gloves, which the ski-shop operator did not object to until three weeks later (ie, after the 10-day deadline). Since the fax number will identify the manufacturer as the sender, the memo will be sufficient to bind both parties - even without the ski-shop-operator's signature (Choice B). Therefore, the manufacturer has a cause of action for breach of contract.

(Choice A) There are three exceptions to the UCC statute of frauds, one of which applies when some amount of payment or goods was received and accepted (not seen here). But since the parties here are merchants, the manufacturer's memo created an enforceable agreement.

(Choice C) The gloves did not need to be tendered to the ski-shop operator to create an enforceable contract. The written confirmation merely needed to evidence the merchants' agreement and identify the quantity of the goods.

Educational objective: Under the UCC, a transaction between merchants satisfies the statute of frauds as to both parties if (1) one party sends a written confirmation that satisfies the statute of frauds and (2) the other party does not object in writing within 10 days.

选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 5%，C选项 8%，D选项 83%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

防止欺诈法要求


包含合理依据相信合同已成立的实体或电子文件（例如，收据、支票、电子邮件）并且
书面文件在普通法下 - 标明当事人、标的物、对价、履行的时间和性质
在UCC下 - 列明货物数量（合同的可执行性仅限于书面所载数量）
签名一般规则 - 来自被诉方的手写签名或其他识别标记（例如，信头、电子签名、姓名首字母缩写）
商人例外 - 在商人之间，满足防止欺诈法对发件人要求的书面确认，如果在10天内没有书面异议，则对双方均有约束力
UCC = 《统一商法典》(Uniform Commercial Code)
根据防止欺诈法 (statute of frauds)，价值500美元或以上的货物销售合同，只有在由被要求履行义务的一方签署的书面文件中订立，才具有可执行性。UCC放宽了商人之间交易的这些要求，因此，如果一方发送书面确认函，而接收方未在10天内以书面形式提出异议，则防止欺诈法的要求对双方均已满足。该书面确认函必须：
  • 提供合理依据让人相信合同已成立（例如，确认订单的备忘录）
  • 包含货物数量或确定数量的方法（例如，12双vortex内衬滑雪手套）
  • 并且包含足以约束发件人的签名或其他身份标识（例如，发件人的传真号码）

在本案中，制造商向滑雪用品店经营者传真了一份备忘录，确认了12双vortex内衬滑雪手套的订单，而滑雪用品店经营者直到三周后（即超过10天期限）才提出异议。由于传真号码可以识别制造商为发件人，该备忘录足以约束双方——即使没有滑雪用品店经营者的签名（选项B）。因此，制造商有以违约为由的诉因。

（选项A） UCC防止欺诈法有三个例外情况，其中之一适用于部分款项或货物已被接收和接受的情况（本案中未出现）。但由于本案当事人均为商人，制造商的备忘录构成了一份可执行的协议。

（选项C） 无需将手套交付给滑雪用品店经营者即可构成可执行的合同。书面确认函仅需证明商人们已达成协议，并指明货物的数量。

教学目标： 根据UCC，在商人之间的交易中，如果（1）一方发送了满足防止欺诈法的书面确认函，并且（2）另一方在10天内未以书面形式提出异议，则防止欺诈法的要求对双方均已满足。

References

U.C.C. § 2-201 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (statute of frauds formal requirements).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：UCC 防止欺诈法

正确答案：D

本题的核心考点是《统一商法典》（UCC）下的防止欺诈法（Statute of Frauds），特别是针对商人（Merchants）之间的特殊规则。

1. 法律规则解析

基本原则：
根据 UCC § 2-201，价值 $500 或以上的货物销售合同，通常需要有被诉方（Party to be charged）签署的书面文件才能强制执行。
商人确认函例外 (Merchant's Confirmatory Memo Exception)：
在两个商人之间的交易中，如果满足以下条件，即使被诉方（本案中的滑雪店主）没有签字，合同依然有效：
  • 一方发送了书面确认函（Confirmatory Memo），且该函件足以约束发送方；
  • 接收方收到该函件并有理由知道其内容；
  • 接收方在收到后 10天内 未提出书面异议。

2. 案情分析图解

第 0 天
电话订购：滑雪店主订购 $600 手套（超过 $500，触发防止欺诈法）。
立即
制造商传真：发送确认备忘录。包含数量、价格，且有制造商签名（足以约束发送方）。
几分钟后
店主接收：店主收到并阅读了传真（满足“知情”要求）。
第 10 天截止
关键期限：店主未在此期限内提出书面异议。
第 21 天（三周后）
店主反悔：此时已超过 10 天异议期。根据 UCC 规则，该备忘录已自动成为对双方均有约束力的书面证据。

因此，选项 D 正确。制造商的传真备忘录满足了防止欺诈法的要求，使口头协议具有可执行性。

3. 为什么其他选项是错误的？

选项 A (未付款/未接受)：
虽然“部分履行”（Part Performance）是防止欺诈法的另一个例外，但本题中已有“商人确认函”这一例外适用，因此无需依赖付款或接受货物来证明合同存在。
选项 B (无签名)：
这是普通法下的抗辩理由。但在 UCC 商人规则下，接收方若未在 10 天内反对，其沉默被视为默认，无需其亲笔签名。
选项 C (特定化/交付)：
单纯的货物特定化（Identification）或交付（Tender）本身不足以克服防止欺诈法的书面要求。关键在于那份未被反驳的确认函。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧：
当你看到题目涉及：
  1. 口头合同 (Oral Contract)
  2. 货物金额 ≥ $500
  3. 双方都是商人 (Merchants)
  4. 一方发送了确认信/邮件/传真
立刻检查接收方是否在 10天内 提出了异议。如果没有，防止欺诈法（Statute of Frauds）即被满足，合同有效！

questions.question:
A woman prepared an accurate statement of her financial condition and submitted it with a loan application to a local bank with which she had done business for many years. Shortly thereafter, the woman's financial condition worsened significantly, but she failed to disclose this fact to the bank. Unaware of the woman's changed financial condition, the bank then agreed to lend money to the woman.
The bank later learned of the woman's true financial condition. The bank refused to honor its promise to lend money to the woman, contending that the parties' contract was voidable at the bank's option because of the woman's misrepresentation.
If the woman sues the bank for breach of contract, will the bank's misrepresentation defense likely succeed?

choices.a: No, because the woman did not make any subsequent affirmative misrepresentations about her financial condition.
choices.b: No, because the woman's representations were accurate at the time she submitted the loan application to the bank.
choices.c: Yes, because the woman had an obligation to correct her previous representations about her financial condition in order to prevent them from being fraudulent.
choices.d: Yes, because the woman had an obligation to tell the bank about her changed financial condition due to the longstanding relationship of trust and confidence between them.

data.questionStem:
Q81817 A woman prepared an accurate statement of her financial condition and submitted it with a loan application to a local bank with which she had done business for many years. Shortly thereafter, the woman's financial condition worsened significantly, but she failed to disclose this fact to the bank. Unaware of the woman's changed financial condition, the bank then agreed to lend money to the woman.

The bank later learned of the woman's true financial condition. The bank refused to honor its promise to lend money to the woman, contending that the parties' contract was voidable at the bank's option because of the woman's misrepresentation.

If the woman sues the bank for breach of contract, will the bank's misrepresentation defense likely succeed? 一名女子准备了一份准确的财务状况声明，并连同贷款申请一起提交给了与她有多年业务往来的当地银行。此后不久，该女子的财务状况严重恶化，但她未将此事实告知银行。银行在不了解该女子财务状况变化的情况下，同意向其贷款。 后来，银行得知了该女子的真实财务状况。银行拒绝履行向该女子贷款的承诺，并主张由于该女子的虚假陈述，双方的合同可由银行选择撤销。 如果该女子以违约为由起诉银行，银行的虚假陈述抗辩是否可能成功？
options:
A. No, because the woman did not make any subsequent affirmative misrepresentations about her financial condition.
不会，因为该女子事后没有就其财务状况作出任何主动的虚假陈述。

B. No, because the woman's representations were accurate at the time she submitted the loan application to the bank.
不会，因为该女子在向银行提交贷款申请时所作的陈述是准确的。

C. Yes, because the woman had an obligation to correct her previous representations about her financial condition in order to prevent them from being fraudulent.
会，因为该女子有义务更正其先前关于财务状况的陈述，以防止其构成欺诈。

D. Yes, because the woman had an obligation to tell the bank about her changed financial condition due to the longstanding relationship of trust and confidence between them.
会，因为基于双方之间长期的信任关系，该女子有义务告知银行其财务状况的变化。
data.explanation:
When disclosure is required to avoid misrepresentation


Previous assertion
  • Disclosure would prevent previous assertion from being a misrepresentation or fraudulent or material
Mistake about basic assumption
  • Disclosure would correct other party's mistake about basic assumption of contract

AND

  • Failure to disclose would constitute lack of good faith & fair dealing
Fiduciary relationship
  • Other party is entitled to know fact because of confidential/fiduciary relationship
Mistake about writing
  • Disclosure would correct other party's mistake about contents or effect of writing that embodies agreement
A misrepresentation is an untrue assertion of fact that makes a contract voidable by the adversely affected party when:
  • the misrepresentation is fraudulent (ie, made knowingly or recklessly with intent to induce the other party's assent to the contract) OR material (ie, likely to induce a reasonable person's assent)
  • the misrepresentation induced assent to the contract and
  • the adversely affected party justifiably relied on the misrepresentation.
Nondisclosure of a known fact is tantamount to an assertion that it does not exist if, among other things, the party not disclosing the fact knows that disclosure is necessary to prevent a previous assertion from being fraudulent.

Here, the woman's representations were accurate when she submitted the loan application to the bank. However, she had an obligation to correct her previous representations to prevent them from being fraudulent (Choice B). The woman failed to do so, and because the bank was unaware of her financial condition, it justifiably agreed to lend money to the woman. Therefore, the bank's misrepresentation defense will likely succeed.

(Choice A) The fact that the woman made no subsequent affirmative statements about her financial condition is irrelevant. Disclosure of her actual financial condition was still necessary to prevent her previous representations from being fraudulent.

(Choice D) The relationship between the woman and the bank is not a confidential or fiduciary relationship (eg, attorney-client relationship) that would obligate her to disclose this information to the bank.

为避免虚假陈述而需要披露信息的情形


先前的断言
  • 披露信息可以防止先前的断言构成虚假陈述或欺诈性或重大性陈述
对基本假设的错误认知
  • 披露信息可以纠正对方对合同基本假设的错误认知

并且

  • 不披露信息将构成违反诚信与公平交易原则
信托关系
  • 由于存在保密/信托关系，对方有权知晓事实
对书面文件的错误认知
  • 披露信息可以纠正对方对体现协议的书面文件的内容或效力的错误认知
虚假陈述是指对事实的不实断言，在以下情况下，受不利影响的一方可据此撤销合同：
  • 该虚假陈述是欺诈性的（即，明知或罔顾后果地作出，意图诱使对方同意合同）或重大的（即，可能诱使一个理性人同意）
  • 该虚假陈述诱使了对合同的同意并且
  • 受不利影响的一方正当地依赖了该虚假陈述。
在某些情况下，不披露已知事实等同于断言该事实不存在，其中包括不披露信息的一方知道，披露是防止先前的断言构成欺诈所必需的。

在本案中，该女子向银行提交贷款申请时所作的陈述是准确的。然而，她有义务更正其先前的陈述，以防止其构成欺诈（选项B）。该女子未能这样做，而银行由于不了解她的财务状况，正当地同意向她贷款。因此，银行的虚假陈述抗辩很可能会成功。

（选项A）该女子事后没有就其财务状况作出任何主动陈述，这一点无关紧要。披露她的实际财务状况对于防止她先前的陈述构成欺诈仍然是必要的。

（选项D）该女子与银行之间的关系并非一种保密或信托关系（例如，律师-客户关系），这种关系不会使她有义务向银行披露此信息。

Educational objective:
Nondisclosure is equivalent to an assertion that a fact does not exist if the party not
disclosing the fact knows that disclosure is necessary to prevent a previous assertion from
being fraudulent.

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 161 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when nondisclosure is a misrepresentation).

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 164 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when misrepresentation makes a contract voidable).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Misrepresentation & Nondisclosure
⚖️ 核心法律规则 (The Rule)

通常情况下，沉默不构成虚假陈述。但在特定情形下，不披露 (Nondisclosure) 等同于断言该事实不存在。

根据 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 161，如果一方知道披露事实是防止先前的断言构成欺诈或重大误导所必需的，则必须披露。

案情逻辑分析

本题考察的是合同法中关于“更正义务” (Duty to Correct) 的规则。

  1. 初始状态：女子提交贷款申请时，财务报表是准确的。
  2. 情况变更：在银行放款（合同成立）之前，她的财务状况严重恶化。
  3. 法律后果：虽然之前的陈述在当时是真的，但由于情况变化，该陈述在合同成立时已不再反映真实情况。如果她保持沉默，之前的陈述就变成了持续性的虚假陈述 (Continuing Misrepresentation)。
选项深度解析
正确答案 C

分析：这是对上述规则的直接应用。为了防止之前的陈述（财务报表）变成欺诈性的或误导性的，她有法律义务披露新的事实。

关键点：一旦之前的陈述不再真实，且对方仍依赖该陈述，沉默就构成了欺诈。

错误选项 B

分析：很多考生会误选此项。虽然申请当时是准确的，但合同法看重的是诱导合同成立时的信息真实性。如果在合同生效前事实发生变化，必须更新信息。

常见陷阱 D

分析：这是一个经典的 MBE 干扰项。选项 D 提到了“信任关系” (Relationship of trust)。

⚠️ MBE 警示：
虽然女子与银行有多年的业务往来，但在法律上，银行与客户通常不构成信托关系 (Fiduciary Relationship)。

如果是律师与客户、受托人与受益人，则有基于关系的披露义务。但普通的商业借贷关系是“公平交易” (Arm's-length transaction)，不存在基于关系的全面披露义务，除非涉及更正先前的陈述。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

当你在 MBE 合同法题目中看到：

  • 一方做出了陈述 (Statement made)
  • 事实发生了变化 (Facts changed)
  • 合同尚未最终签署 (Before contract formed)

➡️ 必须披露变化，否则构成虚假陈述，合同可撤销 (Voidable)。

questions.question:
The managing director of an investment firm orally offered to hire a foreign-exchange trader for a nine-month period at a salary identified only as "more than you're making now." The trader accepted the director's offer, began work immediately, and thereafter received a check for $8,000 each month. The monthly check exceeded his prior salary.
Two months after the trader started work at the firm, the director sent him this email: "I hereby offer to extend your position for an additional six months beyond the original nine-month term at the amount stated in your monthly paycheck. Please confirm. /s/ Director." The trader's reply email read: "I agree to work for six additional months."
After the trader had completed nine months with the firm, the director notified the trader that his services were no longer needed.
Is the trader likely to prevail in a breach of contract suit against the investment firm?

choices.a: No, because the parties did not specify salary with reasonable certainty.
choices.b: No, because the trader did not rely on the director's promise to his detriment.
choices.c: Yes, because the parties' emails satisfy the statute-of-frauds requirement.
choices.d: Yes, because the trader's employment was extended for less than one year.

Is the trader likely to prevail in a breach of contract suit against the investment firm?

一家投资公司的董事总经理口头要约（offer）聘用一名外汇交易员，为期九个月，薪资仅被描述为“比你现在挣得多”。该交易员接受了董事的要约，立即开始工作，此后每月收到一张8000美元的支票。该月度支票金额超过了他之前的薪水。

该交易员在该公司工作两个月后，董事给他发了一封电子邮件：“我在此要约，将您的职位在原九个月任期基础上再延长六个月，薪资金额为您月度工资支票上所载明的数额。请确认。/签名/董事。”该交易员的回复邮件写道：“我同意再多工作六个月。”

在该交易员为公司工作满九个月后，董事通知他不再需要其服务。

在针对该投资公司的违约（breach of contract）诉讼中，该交易员是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the parties did not specify salary with reasonable certainty.
不会，因为双方当事人没有以合理的确定性明确薪资。

B. No, because the trader did not rely on the director's promise to his detriment.
不会，因为该交易员没有因信赖董事的承诺而遭受不利。

C. Yes, because the parties' emails satisfy the statute-of-frauds requirement.
会，因为双方当事人的电子邮件满足了防止欺诈法（statute of frauds）的要求。

D. Yes, because the trader's employment was extended for less than one year.
会，因为该交易员的雇佣期延长了不到一年。
data.explanation:
Statute of frauds requirements


Physical or electronic document(s) containing reasonable basis to believe contract was formed (eg, receipt, check, emails) AND
Writingat common law - identifies parties, subject matter, consideration, time & nature of performance
under UCC - lists quantity of goods (contract enforceable only up to written quantity)
SignatureGeneral rule - handwritten signature from, or other mark identifying, party to be charged (eg, letterhead, electronic signature, initials)

Merchant exception - between merchants, written confirmation that satisfies statute of frauds as to sender will bind both parties if no written objection within 10 days
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

The following types of contracts (as entered or as modified) fall within the statute of frauds and must be in writing to be enforceable ( MY LEGS ):

  • M arriage - a contract made in consideration of marriage

  • Y ear - a contract that cannot be completed within one year

  • L and - a contract for the sale or transfer of an interest in real property

  • E xecutor - a contract to pay an estate's debt out of the executor's personal funds

  • G oods - a contract for the sale of goods for $500 or more

  • S uretyship - a contract to answer for the debt or duty of another


The writing must be signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought and state with reasonable certainty the essential terms of the deal - eg, length of employment and salary in an employment contract. The writing need not be formal, and the essential terms may be in multiple writings so long as one of the writings references the other(s).†

Here, the parties' nine-month oral employment agreement was enforceable without a writing. However, the parties subsequently agreed to extend the trader's employment for six additional months. Because the agreement as modified could not be completed within one year, it had to be in a writing that satisfies the statute of frauds (Choice D).

The parties' emails satisfy this requirement. They contain the director's electronic signature and state the essential terms of the deal with reasonable certainty - eg, they specify employment length and salary by reference to the trader's monthly paychecks (Choice A). Therefore, the trader will likely prevail.

†Even if the writing is lost or destroyed, it still satisfies the statute of frauds, and its prior existence can be proved by oral evidence.

(Choice B) The fact that the trader did not detrimentally rely on the director's promise (eg, by declining a job offer) would preclude him from enforcing the promise on promissory estoppel grounds. But the trader need not rely on promissory estoppel since the parties have a valid contract.

Educational objective: Contracts within the statute of frauds (MY LEGS) are unenforceable without a signed writing that states with reasonable certainty the essential terms of the deal. The essential terms may be in multiple writings so long as one of the writings references the other(s).

选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 6%，C选项 73%（正确选项），D选项 15%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

防止欺诈法（Statute of frauds）的要求


包含合理依据（例如，收据、支票、电子邮件）以相信合同已成立的实体或电子文件，并且
书面形式在普通法下 - 识别当事人、标的物、对价（consideration）、履行的时间和性质
在UCC下 - 列明货物数量（合同仅在书面数量内可强制执行）
签名一般规则 - 来自被诉方的手写签名或其他识别标记（例如，信头、电子签名、姓名首字母缩写）

商人例外 - 在商人之间，满足防止欺诈法的书面确认对发件人有效，如果收件方在10天内没有书面反对，则该确认对双方均有约束力
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

以下类型的合同（无论是订立时还是修改后）属于防止欺诈法（statute of frauds）的管辖范围，必须采用书面形式方可强制执行 ( MY LEGS 助记词):

  • M arriage (婚姻) - 因婚姻而订立的合同

  • Y ear (一年) - 不能在一年内完成的合同

  • L and (土地) - 涉及不动产权益出售或转让的合同

  • E xecutor (遗嘱执行人) - 承诺以遗嘱执行人的个人资金偿还遗产债务的合同

  • G oods (货物) - 价格为500美元或以上的货物销售合同

  • S uretyship (保证) - 为他人债务或义务作保的合同


该书面文件必须由寻求强制执行的一方所针对的当事人签署，并以合理的确定性陈述交易的基本条款——例如，在雇佣合同中，雇佣期限和薪资。该书面文件无需是正式的，并且基本条款可以存在于多个书面文件中，只要其中一份文件引用了其他文件即可。†

在本案中，双方当事人为期九个月的口头雇佣协议无需书面形式即可强制执行。然而，双方随后同意将交易员的雇佣期再延长六个月。因为经修改后的协议无法在一年内完成，所以它必须采用满足防止欺诈法（statute of frauds）的书面形式（选项D）。

双方当事人的电子邮件满足了这一要求。邮件中包含了董事的电子签名，并以合理的确定性陈述了交易的基本条款——例如，通过引用交易员的月度工资支票，明确了雇佣期限和薪资（选项A）。因此，该交易员很可能胜诉。

†即使书面文件丢失或被毁，它仍然满足防止欺诈法（statute of frauds）的要求，其先前的存在可以通过口头证据来证明。

（选项B）交易员并未因信赖董事的承诺而遭受不利（例如，拒绝其他工作要约），这一事实会使他无法以允诺禁反言（promissory estoppel）为由强制执行该承诺。但由于双方已存在有效合同，交易员无需依赖允诺禁反言。

教学目标：属于防止欺诈法（statute of frauds）范围（MY LEGS）的合同，如果没有一份经签署且以合理确定性陈述了交易基本条款的书面文件，则是不可强制执行的。基本条款可以存在于多个书面文件中，只要其中一份文件引用了其他文件即可。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 131 - 32 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (writing requirement for statute of frauds).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Statute of Frauds (防止欺诈法)

📚 核心考点：防止欺诈法 (SoF)

本题考察的是防止欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds) 在合同修改 (Modification) 中的应用。

根据普通法，某些特定类型的合同必须有书面形式 (Writing) 并由被诉方签署 (Signed by the party to be charged) 才能强制执行。记忆口诀为 MY LEGS：

Marriage
婚姻相关
Year
超过一年
Land
土地权益
Executor
遗嘱执行人
Goods
货物($500+)
Suretyship
保证/担保
✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 C)

结论： 交易员会胜诉，因为双方的电子邮件满足了防止欺诈法的要求。

1. 为什么需要书面形式？

最初的9个月口头合同是有效的，因为它可以在一年内完成。但是，双方在第2个月进行了修改 (Modification)，延长了6个月。

  • 计算时间： 从修改之时（第2个月）算起，剩余履行期为 7个月（原合同剩余）+ 6个月（延长期）= 13个月。
  • 规则： 如果修改后的合同无法在修改之日起一年内 (One Year) 完成，则该修改必须满足 SoF 要求。

2. 电子邮件是否满足要求？

满足。SoF 对“书面”的要求很宽松：

  • 签名： 董事的电子邮件末尾有 "/s/ Director"，这构成了有效的电子签名。
  • 基本条款： 邮件明确了延长期限（6个月）和薪资（参照月度支票）。
  • 多份文件引用： 法律允许通过引用 (Incorporation by Reference) 将多份文件结合起来。邮件中提到的“月度工资支票”使得薪资条款变得确定（Certain）。
❌ 干扰项排除

选项 A (错误)： 关于薪资不确定。
虽然邮件没有写明具体金额，但它引用了“月度工资支票”。在合同法中，如果条款可以通过参照客观存在的外部文件或标准来确定，即视为具有合理的确定性 (Reasonable Certainty)。

选项 B (错误)： 关于信赖利益。
这指的是允诺禁反言 (Promissory Estoppel)。这是一个“备胎”理论，仅在没有有效合同（例如不满足 SoF）时使用。既然这里已经满足了 SoF 形成了有效合同，就不需要证明“不利信赖” (Detrimental Reliance)。

选项 D (错误)： 关于延长期不到一年。
这是一个典型的陷阱。判断是否适用“一年规则”，不是看延长的部分是否超过一年，而是看修改后的整个合同从修改之日起，是否能在一年内履行完毕。本案中，从修改日到结束日超过了12个月。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理 Statute of Frauds 问题时，遵循以下步骤：

  1. 判断合同类型是否落入 MY LEGS 范畴。
  2. 如果是修改 (Modification)，看修改后的合同是否落入 SoF（特别是时间计算，要从修改日重新开始算）。
  3. 寻找是否有满足要求的书面材料 (Writing)。记住：多封邮件、支票、备忘录只要能关联起来，都可以算作书面证据。

questions.question:
In financial straits and needing $4,000 immediately, a nephew asked his uncle for a $4,000 loan. The uncle said that he would lend the money to the nephew only if the nephew's mother would "guarantee" the loan. At the nephew's suggestion, the uncle then telephoned the nephew's mother, told her about the loan, and asked if she would guarantee it. She replied, "Yes. Lend my son the $4,000, and I'll repay it if he doesn't." The uncle then lent $4,000 to the nephew, and the nephew orally agreed to repay that amount in six weeks. The next day, the nephew's mother wrote to him and concluded her letter with the words, "Son, I was happy to do you a favor by promising your uncle I would repay your six-week $4,000 loan if you don't. /s/ Mother." Neither the nephew nor his mother repaid the loan when it came due, and the uncle sued the mother for breach of contract. In that action, the mother raised the statute of frauds as her only defense.
Will the mother's statute-of-frauds defense likely be successful?

choices.a: No, because the amount of the loan was less than $5,000.
choices.b: No, because the mother's letter satisfies the statute-of-frauds requirement.
choices.c: Yes, because the mother's promise to the uncle was oral.
choices.d: Yes, because the nephew's promise to the uncle was oral.
