In financial straits and needing $4,000 immediately, a nephew asked his uncle for a $4,000 loan. The uncle said that he would lend the money to the nephew only if the nephew's mother would "guarantee" the loan. At the nephew's suggestion, the uncle then telephoned the nephew's mother, told her about the loan, and asked if she would guarantee it. She replied, "Yes. Lend my son the $4,000, and I'll repay it if he doesn't." The uncle then lent $4,000 to the nephew, and the nephew orally agreed to repay that amount in six weeks. The next day, the nephew's mother wrote to him and concluded her letter with the words, "Son, I was happy to do you a favor by promising your uncle I would repay your six-week $4,000 loan if you don't. /s/ Mother." Neither the nephew nor his mother repaid the loan when it came due, and the uncle sued the mother for breach of contract. In that action, the mother raised the statute of frauds as her only defense.

Will the mother's statute-of-frauds defense likely be successful?

一名侄子因财务拮据，急需4000美元，向其叔叔请求一笔4000美元的贷款。叔叔表示，只有侄子的母亲为这笔贷款提供“担保”，他才会借钱给侄子。在侄子的建议下，叔叔随后致电侄子的母亲，告知她关于这笔贷款的事，并询问她是否愿意提供担保。她回答说：“好的。借给我儿子4000美元吧，如果他不还，我来偿还。”于是，叔叔将4000美元借给了侄子，侄子口头同意在六周内偿还该款项。第二天，侄子的母亲写信给他，信的结尾写道：“儿子，我很高兴能帮你这个忙，向你叔叔承诺，如果你不偿还你那为期六周的4000美元贷款，我来偿还。/签名/母亲。”贷款到期后，侄子和他的母亲都未偿还贷款，叔叔遂以违约为由起诉了母亲。在该诉讼中，母亲提出了statute of frauds作为其唯一抗辩理由。

母亲以statute of frauds为由的抗辩是否可能成功？
options:
A. No, because the amount of the loan was less than $5,000.
不会，因为贷款金额低于5000美元。

B. No, because the mother's letter satisfies the statute-of-frauds requirement.
不会，因为母亲的信件满足了statute of frauds的要求。

C. Yes, because the mother's promise to the uncle was oral.
会，因为母亲对叔叔的承诺是口头的。

D. Yes, because the nephew's promise to the uncle was oral.
会，因为侄子对叔叔的承诺是口头的。
data.explanation:
A suretyship is a promise to assume responsibility for a duty incurred by another (eg, the mother's promise to repay the loan if her son does not). Suretyships are generally subject to the statute of frauds and therefore are only enforceable if they are:

in a writing - ie, physical or electronic document(s) such as a receipt, check, or emails - containing a reasonable basis to believe that a contract was formed and signed through a handwritten signature or other identifying mark by the party against whom enforcement is sought.†

Here, the mother's letter satisfied the writing requirement because it evidenced her promise to repay the loan to the uncle. It also satisfied the signature requirement because her "/s/ Mother" notation on the letter identified her as the sender. As a result, the mother's statute-of-frauds defense will likely fail, and the uncle can use the letter to enforce the mother's promise to repay him.

†There is no requirement that the writing be addressed to a particular person.

(Choice A) The amount of the loan is not relevant in determining whether a suretyship is subject to the statute of frauds. The dollar amount is only relevant in determining whether a contract for the sale of goods ($500 or more) is subject to the UCC statute of frauds.

(Choice C) Although the mother's promise was oral, it was evidenced by a signed writing (ie, her letter to her son) that satisfied the statute of frauds.

(Choice D) The son's oral promise to repay the loan is enforceable without a writing because this type of contract is not subject to the statute of frauds. In contrast, the mother's suretyship agreement is subject to the statute.

Educational objective: Under the statute of frauds, a suretyship is enforceable if it is (1) in a writing - ie, physical or electronic document(s) - containing a reasonable basis to believe that a contract was formed and (2) signed via a handwritten signature or other identifying mark by the party against whom enforcement is sought.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 67%（正确选项），C选项 30%，D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

保证合同（suretyship）是指为他人（例如，本案中母亲承诺如果儿子不偿还贷款则由她来偿还）承担责任的承诺。保证合同通常受statute of frauds的约束，因此只有在满足以下条件时才可强制执行：

采用书面形式——即，实体或电子文件（如收据、支票或电子邮件），该文件包含可合理相信合同已成立的依据，并且经由被请求执行的一方†通过手写签名或其他识别标记签署。

在本案中，母亲的信件满足了书面形式的要求，因为它证明了她向叔叔作出的偿还贷款的承诺。该信件也满足了签名的要求，因为信上“/签名/母亲”的标记表明了她是发信人。因此，母亲以statute of frauds为由的抗辩很可能会失败，叔叔可以利用这封信来强制执行母亲向他偿还贷款的承诺。

†书面文件不要求必须寄送给特定的人。

(选项A) 在确定保证合同是否受statute of frauds约束时，贷款的金额是不相关的。金额仅在确定货物买卖合同（价值500美元或以上）是否受UCC的statute of frauds约束时才具有相关性。

(选项C) 尽管母亲的承诺是口头的，但有一份满足statute of frauds要求的经签署的书面文件（即她写给儿子的信）证明了该承诺。

(选项D) 儿子偿还贷款的口头承诺无需书面形式即可强制执行，因为这类合同不受statute of frauds的约束。相比之下，母亲的保证协议则受该法规的约束。

教学目标：根据statute of frauds，一项保证合同（suretyship）是可强制执行的，如果它 (1) 采用书面形式——即，实体或电子文件——包含可合理相信合同已成立的依据，并且 (2) 经由被请求执行的一方通过手写签名或其他识别标记签署。

UCC = 《统一商法典》（Uniform Commercial Code）

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 112 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (requirement of suretyship).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 116 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (main-purpose rule).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 136 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (time of memorandum).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Statute of Frauds
✅ 正确答案：选项 B

母亲的抗辩不会成功，因为她的信件满足了反欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds) 的书面要求。

⚖️ 核心法律原则

保证合同 (Suretyship) 属于反欺诈法管辖的范畴。要使保证合同具有强制执行力，必须满足以下条件：

  1. 必须有书面形式 (Writing)；
  2. 书面材料必须包含合同的基本条款；
  3. 必须由被请求履行义务的一方 (Party to be charged) 签署。

关键点：书面文件不需要是正式合同，也不需要寄给债权人（Creditor）。

🔍 案情深度解析

本题考察的是反欺诈法中关于“书面备忘录” (Memorandum) 的具体要求。

  • 口头承诺的效力： 母亲最初对叔叔的承诺是口头的。如果仅有这个口头承诺，根据反欺诈法，叔叔确实无法起诉，因为保证合同必须书面化。
  • 补救的书面证据： 母亲随后给儿子（债务人）写了一封信。信中明确承认了她对叔叔的承诺（"promising your uncle I would repay..."）。
  • 签名的有效性： 信件末尾的 "/s/ Mother" 构成了有效的签名。在法律上，任何旨在认证文件的符号都可以视为签名。
  • 接收对象无关紧要： 这是本题最大的考点。书面文件不需要交给债权人（叔叔）才有效。 只要是被告（母亲）签署的、承认合同存在的文件，即使是写给第三人（儿子）的，也可以作为满足反欺诈法的证据。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A (关于$5,000限额)：
这是混淆了普通法 (Common Law) 和统一商法典 (UCC)。UCC 中货物买卖 (Sale of Goods) 的反欺诈法门槛是 $500。本案是借贷担保，适用普通法，没有金额下限，任何金额的保证合同都需书面形式。
选项 C (关于口头承诺)：
虽然承诺最初是口头的，但随后的书面信件（Memorandum）已经“治愈”了这一缺陷。反欺诈法并不要求合同本身必须是书面的，只要求有书面证据证明合同存在。
选项 D (关于侄子的口头承诺)：
侄子借款属于主债务。除非借款期限超过一年（本案为6周），否则主债务合同通常不需要书面形式。更重要的是，本案起诉的是母亲（保证人），关注点应在于保证合同的形式要件。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在 MBE 中，如果题目涉及 Statute of Frauds，请务必检查是否存在任何形式的“书面记录”。日记、给第三方的信件、甚至是在餐巾纸上的涂鸦，只要包含核心条款并由被告签署，通常都能满足要求。

In an action for breach of contract by the seller against the buyer, what amount of damages will the seller likely recover?

一位买方，其在事实上和外观上均为未成年人，以100美元的约定价格从一位30岁的卖方处赊购并接收了一架望远镜。在达到法定成年年龄后不久，买方遇到了卖方并说：“很抱歉，在款项到期时我没有支付您那100美元的望远镜款项，但我发现它只值75美元。所以我现在承诺支付您75美元。”随后，买方撤销了她的承诺，并拒绝向卖方支付任何款项。

在卖方对买方提起的违约之诉中，卖方可能获得多少金额的损害赔偿？
options:
A. Nothing, because the buyer was a minor at the time of the original transaction.
无，因为在原始交易时，买方是未成年人。

B. Nothing, because there was no consideration for the promise made by the buyer after reaching majority.
无，因为买方在达到法定成年年龄后作出的承诺没有对价。
data.explanation:
An unmarried, unemancipated minor (ie, person under the age of 18) lacks capacity to enter a contract. This means that any contract the minor enters is voidable , so the minor can either:
  • void the contract before or soon after turning 18 by (1) disaffirming it through words or actions and (2) returning any still-existing benefit received under it or
  • ratify the contract after turning 18 by (1) failing to timely void the contract or (2) agreeing to be bound by it.


The contract becomes enforceable if the minor ratifies it. However, if the ratification is made by a promise to perform only part of the contract, enforcement is limited to that promise to partially perform.

Here, the buyer was a minor when she originally agreed to purchase a telescope from the seller for $100. Although the buyer had not paid the $100 when she reached the age of majority, she ratified the contract by retaining the telescope and promising to perform part of the contract by paying only $75. This made the contract enforceable - but only to the extent of the promise for partial performance. Therefore, the seller likely will only recover $75 (Choices A & D).

(Choice B) Certain promises are enforceable even without consideration. This includes a party's promise to perform a voidable duty (ie, ratification), so long as the new promise is not also voidable. Therefore, the buyer's promise to pay $75 made after reaching majority is enforceable without consideration.

Educational objective: A minor lacks capacity to contract, so the minor can choose to (1) void the contract before or soon after turning 18 or (2) ratify it after turning 18. If the contract is ratified by a promise to perform only part of the contract, enforcement is limited to that promise to partially perform.



选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 10%，C选项 55%（正确选项），D选项 27%

一个未婚、未获解放的未成年人（即18岁以下的人）缺乏订立合同的行为能力。这意味着该未成年人订立的任何合同是可撤销的，因此该未成年人可以选择：
  • 在年满18岁之前或之后不久，通过（1）以言语或行为否认合同，以及（2）返还根据合同收到的任何现存利益的方式，撤销该合同，或者
  • 在年满18岁后，通过（1）未能及时撤销合同，或（2）同意受其约束的方式，追认该合同。


如果未成年人追认了该合同，则该合同变得可强制执行。然而，如果追认是通过仅承诺履行合同部分内容作出的，则强制执行被限制在该部分履行的承诺范围内。

在本案中，当买方最初同意以100美元从卖方处购买望远镜时，她是一名未成年人。尽管在达到法定成年年龄时，买方尚未支付100美元，但她通过保留望远镜并承诺仅支付75美元来履行部分合同的方式，追认了该合同。这使得合同变得可强制执行——但仅限于部分履行的承诺范围。因此，卖方可能仅能获赔75美元（选项A和D）。

（选项B）某些承诺即使没有对价也是可强制执行的。这包括一方当事人履行可撤销义务的承诺（即追认），只要新的承诺本身不是可撤销的。因此，买方在达到法定成年年龄后作出的支付75美元的承诺，在没有对价的情况下也是可强制执行的。

教学目标：未成年人缺乏订立合同的行为能力，因此未成年人可以选择（1）在年满18岁之前或之后不久撤销合同，或（2）在年满18岁后追认合同。如果合同是通过仅承诺履行合同部分内容的方式被追认，则强制执行被限制在该部分履行的承诺范围内。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 14 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (incapacity based on infancy).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Capacity & Ratification
$75

卖方可能获得的赔偿金额

核心法律规则

1. 未成年人的缔约能力 (Capacity):
未成年人签订的合同通常是可撤销的 (Voidable)，而非无效 (Void)。

2. 追认 (Ratification):
当未成年人达到法定年龄 (Age of Majority) 后，可以通过言语或行为（如继续保留货物）追认合同。一旦追认，合同即变得可强制执行。

3. 追认的范围 (Scope):
如果追认表现为承诺履行合同的一部分，则强制执行力仅限于该承诺的部分。

第一步：原始合同状态

买方购买望远镜时是未成年人，因此该 100 美元的合同是可撤销的 (Voidable)。此时卖方无法强制执行。

第二步：成年后的行为

买方成年后，做出了一个新的承诺："I now promise to pay you $75."

这是一个明确的追认 (Ratification) 行为。虽然她本可以完全撤销合同并退还望远镜，但她选择了保留并承诺付款。

第三步：对价问题 (Consideration)

关键考点：买方成年后的新承诺是否需要新的对价？
不需要。

根据《合同法重述》(Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 85)，承诺履行一项因未成年而可撤销的义务（Antecedent Voidable Duty），无需新的对价 (Consideration) 即可强制执行。

选项深度解析
选项 C (正确) $75

买方成年后明确承诺支付 $75。虽然原始债务是 $100，但追认的效力受限于新承诺的具体条款。因此，法院将强制执行 $75 的承诺。

选项 A & B (错误) Nothing

错误原因：
A 忽略了成年后的追认行为。
B 错误地认为追认需要新对价（这是 MBE 常见的干扰项）。履行“道德义务”或“可撤销债务”的承诺是 Consideration 规则的著名例外。

选项 D (错误) $100

错误原因：如果买方只是默默保留望远镜而没有说话，这可能构成对原始 $100 合同的默示追认。但本案中，买方明确修改了条款（Expressly promised $75），因此责任仅限于她口头承诺的金额。

MBE Contracts Key Concept: Ratification of Voidable Contracts

questions.question:
A 16-year-old girl received $3,000 on her birthday to buy a car. Later that week, the girl noticed an old car parked in her neighbor's driveway. A sign posted on the car's windshield read: "For Sale! $5,000 O.B.O." The girl contacted the neighbor about purchasing the car for $5,000. He agreed to sell it to her for a $1,000 down payment and monthly payments of $75 until the car was paid off.
The girl made regular payments until she turned 18 years old. Soon after turning 18, the girl attempted to pay off the car. The neighbor rejected the girl's lump-sum payment, returned all of her prior payments, and took possession of the car.
If the girl sues the neighbor for breach of contract, will she be likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the girl was a minor when she agreed to buy the car, so the contract was void .
choices.b: No, because the neighbor voided the contract by returning the girl's prior payments.
choices.c: Yes, because the contract ceased to be voidable by either party once the girl turned 18 years old.
choices.d: Yes, because the girl ratified the contract after she reached the age of majority.

The girl made regular payments until she turned 18 years old. Soon after turning 18, the girl attempted to pay off the car. The neighbor rejected the girl's lump-sum payment, returned all of her prior payments, and took possession of the car.

If the girl sues the neighbor for breach of contract, will she be likely to prevail?

一名16岁女孩在生日时收到了3000美元用于购买一辆汽车。那周晚些时候，该女孩注意到一辆旧车停在她邻居的车道上。汽车挡风玻璃上贴着一个牌子，上面写着：“待售！5000美元，或提供最优报价（O.B.O.）。”女孩联系了邻居，商议以5000美元购买该车。他同意以1000美元的首付款，以及每月支付75美元的方式将车卖给她，直至付清全款。

该女孩定期付款，直到她年满18岁。年满18岁后不久，该女孩试图一次性付清购车款。邻居拒绝了女孩的一次性总付，退还了她之前所有的付款，并收回了汽车。

如果该女孩以违约为由起诉邻居，她是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the girl was a minor when she agreed to buy the car, so the contract was void .
不会，因为女孩同意购车时是未成年人，因此合同无效。

B. No, because the neighbor voided the contract by returning the girl's prior payments.
不会，因为邻居通过退还女孩之前的付款使合同无效。

C. Yes, because the contract ceased to be voidable by either party once the girl turned 18 years old.
会，因为一旦女孩年满18岁，任何一方都不能再撤销该合同。

D. Yes, because the girl ratified the contract after she reached the age of majority.
会，因为女孩在达到法定成年年龄后追认了该合同。
data.explanation:
Unmarried, unemancipated minors (ie, persons under the age of 18) lack capacity to contract because of their infancy. As a result, any contract entered by a minor is voidable by the minor.† This means that the minor can either:
  • void the contract before or soon after turning 18 by (1) disaffirming the contract through words or actions and (2) returning any still- existing benefit received under the contract or
  • ratify the contract after turning 18 by (1) failing to timely void the contract or (2) otherwise agreeing to be bound by it - eg, by attempting to render performance of or payment under the contract.
The contract becomes enforceable if the minor ratifies it.

Here, the girl was a 16-year-old minor when she contracted to buy the neighbor's car for $5,000. The neighbor tried to disaffirm the contract after the girl turned 18 by returning her prior payments and taking possession of the car. However, the contract was voidable only by the girl (Choices B & C). And since she ratified the contract soon after turning 18 by attempting to pay off the car, the contract was enforceable. Therefore, the girl will likely prevail in a suit against the neighbor for breach of contract.

†By statute in some jurisdictions, certain contracts entered by a minor (eg, student loan agreements, insurance contracts) are not voidable by the minor but instead are fully enforceable by the other contracting party.

(Choice A) A void contract is invalid upon creation. But a contract entered by a minor is merely voidable, meaning that it is valid until the minor takes steps to avoid it.

Educational objective: Minors lack capacity to contract, so a minor who enters a contract can either (1) void the contract before or soon after turning 18 or (2) ratify the contract after turning 18 - eg, by attempting to render performance of or payment under the contract.

未婚、未获解放的未成年人（即未满18周岁者）因其年幼而缺乏缔约能力。因此，由未成年人订立的任何合同均可由该未成年人撤销。† 这意味着未成年人可以选择：
  • 在年满18岁之前或之后不久，通过(1)以言语或行动否认合同，以及(2)返还在合同项下收到的任何现存利益的方式，撤销合同；或者
  • 在年满18岁后，通过(1)未能及时撤销合同，或(2)以其他方式同意受其约束——例如，试图履行合同或支付合同款项的方式，来追认合同。
如果未成年人追认合同，则该合同具有强制执行力。

在本案中，女孩在签约购买邻居价值5000美元的汽车时，是一名16岁的未成年人。邻居试图在女孩年满18岁后，通过退还她之前的付款并收回汽车的方式来否认合同。然而，该合同仅可由女孩撤销（选项B和C）。而且，由于她在年满18岁后不久，通过试图付清车款的方式追认了合同，因此该合同具有强制执行力。因此，在该女孩以违约为由起诉邻居的诉讼中，她很可能胜诉。

†在某些司法管辖区，根据成文法，未成年人订立的某些合同（例如，学生贷款协议、保险合同）不可由未成年人撤销，而是对另一方缔约人完全具有强制执行力。

（选项A）无效合同自成立时即无效。但由未成年人订立的合同仅为可撤销合同，意味着在未成年人采取措施避免履行合同之前，该合同是有效的。

教学目标：未成年人缺乏缔约能力，因此订立合同的未成年人可以(1)在年满18岁之前或之后不久撤销合同，或(2)在年满18岁后追认合同——例如，通过试图履行合同或支付合同款项的方式。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 14 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (incapacity based on infancy).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 85 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (promise to perform voidable duty).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Defenses to Enforceability
核心考点：未成年人缔约能力 (Infancy Doctrine)

在普通法下，未成年人（通常指18岁以下）缺乏完全的缔约能力。他们签署的合同通常是可撤销的 (Voidable)，而不是无效的 (Void)。

这意味着：

  • 未成年人有权选择履行或撤销合同。
  • 成年方（对方）无权撤销，必须受合同约束，除非未成年人主动撤销。
关键规则：追认 (Ratification)

当未成年人达到法定成年年龄（Age of Majority，通常为18岁）后，他们可以通过以下方式追认 (Ratify) 合同：

  1. 明示追认： 口头或书面同意继续受合同约束。
  2. 默示追认： 通过行为表现出继续履行合同的意愿（例如：继续付款、保留商品、试图清偿债务）。

一旦追认，合同即对双方具有完全的法律约束力，未成年人不能再以“签约时未成年”为由撤销合同。

本案逻辑推演
1
签约阶段：女孩16岁时签约。此时合同对她而言是可撤销的 (Voidable)，但对邻居是有效的。
2
成年后行为：女孩年满18岁后，试图一次性付清余款。这一行为构成了对合同的追认 (Ratification)。
3
邻居的违约：由于女孩已经追认，合同变得完全有效且不可撤销。邻居拒绝接受付款并收回汽车的行为构成了违约 (Breach of Contract)。
✅ 正确答案：选项 D

女孩会胜诉。因为她在达到法定成年年龄后，通过试图付清车款的行为追认 (Ratified) 了该合同。此时合同已完全生效，邻居无权单方面解约。

❌ 选项 A 错误： 未成年人签订的合同是可撤销 (Voidable)，而非自始无效 (Void)。如果是 Void，则合同从未存在过，但这里合同是存在的，只是未成年人有权退出。
❌ 选项 B 错误： 只有未成年人拥有撤销权 (Power of Avoidance)。成年的一方（邻居）不能利用对方的未成年身份来撤销合同。
❌ 选项 C 错误： 虽然结果（女孩胜诉）是对的，但理由不准确。仅仅“年满18岁”并不自动剥夺撤销权（未成年人成年后仍有一段合理时间可以撤销）。关键在于她采取了追认行为（试图付款）。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
看到“未成年人 (Minor)”考题时，首先判断合同状态是 Voidable。接着看未成年人成年后的行为：如果他们继续享受利益或付款，就是 Ratification（追认），合同即被锁定。

questions.question:
In order to raise revenue, a city required home-repair contractors who performed work within the city limits to pay a licensing fee to a city agency. A contractor who was unaware of the fee requirement agreed to perform home repairs for a city resident. After the contractor completed the work, the resident discovered that the contractor had not paid the licensing fee, and she refused to pay for the repairs, which were otherwise satisfactory.
If the contractor sues the resident for breach of contract, how is the court likely to rule?

choices.a: Although the contract violates the law and is void, the court will require the homeowner to pay the contractor the reasonable value of the work accepted.
choices.b: Although the contract violates the law, the court will find that public policy does not bar enforcement of the contract, because the purpose of the fee is merely to raise revenue.
choices.c: Because the contract violates the law and is void, the court will not enforce it.
choices.d: Because the purpose of the fee is merely to raise revenue, the court will find that the contract does not violate the law but will allow the contractor to recover his costs only.

If the contractor sues the resident for breach of contract, how is the court likely to rule? 为了增加财政收入，某市要求在该市范围内施工的家居维修承包商向市级机构支付一笔执照费。一名承包商不知道此项费用要求，同意为一位市里的居民进行家居维修。承包商完工后，该居民发现承包商没有支付执照费，因此拒绝支付维修费用，尽管维修工作在其他方面是令人满意的。 如果承包商以违约为由起诉该居民，法院可能会如何裁决？
options:
A. Although the contract violates the law and is void, the court will require the homeowner to pay the contractor the reasonable value of the work accepted.
虽然合同违法且无效，但法院将要求房主向承包商支付其已接受工作的合理价值。

B. Although the contract violates the law, the court will find that public policy does not bar enforcement of the contract, because the purpose of the fee is merely to raise revenue.
虽然合同违法，但法院会认定公共政策并不禁止执行该合同，因为该费用的目的仅仅是为了增加财政收入。

C. Because the contract violates the law and is void, the court will not enforce it.
因为合同违法且无效，法院将不会执行该合同。

D. Because the purpose of the fee is merely to raise revenue, the court will find that the contract does not violate the law but will allow the contractor to recover his costs only.
因为该费用的目的仅仅是为了增加财政收入，法院将认定该合同不违法，但只允许承包商收回其成本。
data.explanation:
Weighing public policy v. Interest in enforcing illegal contract


Public policyInterest in enforcing
  • Strength of policy as shown by legislature or courts
  • Likelihood nonenforcement will further policy
  • Seriousness and/or deliberateness of misconduct
  • Connection between misconduct & contract
  • Parties' justified expectations
  • Forfeiture that would result from nonenforcement
  • Special public interest in enforcement
Illegal contracts are generally void as against public policy. But if a contract is illegal solely because a party does not have a required license, then the enforceability of the contract depends on whether the purpose behind the licensing requirement is:
  • economic (eg, raise revenue) – in which case the contract is enforceable or
  • regulatory (eg, protect public health or safety) – in which case the contract is unenforceable if the public policy behind the requirement clearly outweighs the interest in enforcing the contract.


Here, the contract between the contractor and resident was illegal because the contractor had not paid the required licensing fee to the city agency. But since the purpose of this fee is merely to raise revenue for the city, the court will likely find that public policy does not bar enforcement of the contract.

(Choice A) Had the contract been void on public-policy grounds, then the court may have required the homeowner to pay restitution damages (ie, the reasonable value of the work accepted) to avoid unjust enrichment.

(Choice C) The contract does violate the law. But since the purpose of this fee is merely to raise revenue for the city, the court will likely find that public policy does not bar enforcement of the contract.

(Choice D) The contract does violate the law. But public policy does not bar its enforcement, and the contractor is entitled to recover the full contract price—not his costs only.

Educational objective: When a party does not have a required license, the enforceability of the contract depends on whether the purpose behind the requirement is (1) economic, in which case the contract is enforceable, or (2) regulatory, in which case it is unenforceable if the public policy behind the requirement clearly outweighs the interest in enforcement.

权衡公共政策与执行非法合同的利益


公共政策执行合同的利益
  • 立法机关或法院所显示的政策强度
  • 不执行合同会促进该政策的可能性
  • 不当行为的严重性和/或故意性
  • 不当行为与合同之间的联系
  • 当事方的合理预期
  • 不执行合同将导致的没收/丧失
  • 执行合同的特殊公共利益
非法合同通常因违反公共政策而无效。但是，如果合同违法仅仅是因为一方当事人没有必需的执照，那么合同的可执行性取决于执照要求背后的目的是：
  • 经济性（例如，增加财政收入）——在这种情况下，合同是可执行的，或者
  • 监管性（例如，保护公众健康或安全）——在这种情况下，如果要求背后的公共政策明显重于执行合同的利益，则合同是不可执行的。


在本案中，承包商和居民之间的合同是违法的，因为承包商没有向市级机构支付所要求的执照费。但由于该费用的目的仅仅是为该市增加财政收入，法院很可能会认定公共政策不禁止执行该合同。

（选项 A）如果合同因公共政策原因而无效，那么法院可能会要求房主支付恢复原状的损害赔偿（即，已接受工作的合理价值），以避免不当得利。

（选项 C）该合同确实违法。但由于该费用的目的仅仅是为该市增加财政收入，法院很可能会认定公共政策不禁止执行该合同。

（选项 D）该合同确实违法。但公共政策不禁止其执行，承包商有权收回全部合同价款，而不仅仅是其成本。

教学目的： 当一方当事人没有必需的执照时，合同的可执行性取决于执照要求背后的目的是（1）经济性的，这种情况下合同是可执行的，还是（2）监管性的，这种情况下如果要求背后的公共政策明显重于执行合同的利益，则合同是不可执行的。

References


  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 181 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when failure to comply with licensing requirement makes contract unenforceable).

MBE 合同法考点解析

Contracts: Illegality & Public Policy
✅ 正确答案：选项 B
⚖️ 核心考点：执照要求的目的

本题考察的是非法合同（Illegal Contracts）中的一个重要例外：当一方因未取得执照而违反法律时，合同是否可执行？这取决于该执照法律背后的立法目的。

根据《合同法重述（第二版）》§ 181 (Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 181)，我们需要区分两种类型的执照要求：

类型 监管性执照
(Regulatory)		 创收性执照
(Revenue-Raising)
目的 保护公众健康、安全或防止欺诈（如律师、医生、电工）。 仅仅为了给政府增加财政收入（如摆摊证、营业税登记）。
后果 无照方签订的合同通常无效 (Void)，不可执行。 合同通常可执行 (Enforceable)。
🔍 案情应用

在 MBE 考试中，必须仔细阅读题干对法律目的的描述。

  • 题目关键句： "In order to raise revenue..."（为了增加财政收入...）。
  • 分析： 题目明确指出该市要求承包商缴纳执照费的目的是为了创收 (Revenue)，而不是为了审核承包商的资质或保护公众安全。
  • 结论： 尽管承包商违反了市政法规（未缴费），但这并不影响合同的效力。法院会认为，公共政策（Public Policy）并不禁止执行此类合同。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？

选项 A 和 C 错误： 它们都错误地认为合同是“无效的” (Void)。只有当执照要求是监管性 (Regulatory) 的时候，合同才可能无效。

选项 D 错误： 该选项认为合同有效但只能收回成本。这是错误的。既然合同是完全可执行的 (Enforceable)，承包商就有权获得合同约定的价格 (Contract Price)，包括利润，而不仅仅是恢复原状 (Restitution) 的成本。

💡MBE 考试技巧：
遇到“无照经营”类的题目，第一步永远是寻找题干中关于“执照目的”的线索。

如果题目提到 "competency"（能力）、"skill"（技能）或 "protect the public"（保护公众），那是监管性的，合同通常无效。

如果题目提到 "raise revenue"（增加收入）或 "tax"（税收），那是创收性的，合同通常有效。

questions.question:
A man who wanted to sell his home executed a written listing agreement with a real estate broker. The agreement was signed by both parties and gave the broker the exclusive right to sell the home for 60 days. It also gave her the right to receive a commission for up to 30 days after the exclusivity period had terminated if the home sold to a buyer with whom the broker had negotiated during the exclusivity period. A clause in the agreement provided that any modifications must be in writing.
Two weeks later, the parties orally agreed to extend the exclusivity period by 60 days (for a total of 120 days). The 120-day exclusivity period ended without a sale. Twenty days later, a buyer with whom the broker had negotiated while the exclusivity period was still in force offered to purchase the home. The man accepted the offer and concluded the sale but refused to pay the broker a commission.
If the broker sues the man for breach of contract, will she be likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the parties waived the right to modify the written agreement.
choices.b: No, because the parol evidence rule will prevent proof of the parties' oral agreement.
choices.c: Yes, because the original agreement is not subject to the statute of frauds.
choices.d: Yes, because the parties' oral agreement was an effective modification of their written agreement.

一名想出售其房屋的男子与一名房地产经纪人签订了一份书面委托销售协议。该协议由双方签署，并授予经纪人在60天内独家销售该房屋的权利。协议还规定，如果在独家销售期结束后30天内，房屋出售给经纪人在独家销售期内曾进行过谈判的买家，经纪人有权收取佣金。协议中的一项条款规定，任何修改都必须以书面形式进行。

两周后，双方口头同意将独家销售期延长60天（总计120天）。120天的独家销售期结束时，房屋并未售出。二十天后，一名经纪人在独家销售期内曾与之谈判过的买家要约购买该房屋。该男子接受了要约并完成了交易，但拒绝向经纪人支付佣金。

如果经纪人以违约为由起诉该男子，她是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because new consideration was required to effectively modify the original agreement.
不会，因为有效修改原始协议需要新的对价。

B. No, because the parol evidence rule will prevent proof of the parties' oral agreement.
不会，因为口头证据规则（parol evidence rule）将阻止对双方口头协议的证明。

C. Yes, because the original agreement is not subject to the statute of frauds.
会，因为原始协议不受《欺诈法》（statute of frauds）的约束。

D. Yes, because the parties' oral agreement was an effective modification of their written agreement.
会，因为双方的口头协议是对其书面协议的有效修改。
data.explanation:
"No oral modification" (NOM) clause


Common law
(contracts for services or real estate)		NOM clause enforceable only if modification must be in writing under statute of frauds
UCC
(contracts for sale of goods)
  • All parties are merchants - NOM clause always enforceable
  • > 1 party is nonmerchant - NOM clause in merchant's form must be separately signed by nonmerchant(s) to be enforceable
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

At common law, a prior written contract can be modified by a subsequent oral agreement unless the modified contract falls within the statute of frauds. This is true even if the written contract contains a "no oral modification" (NOM) clause purporting to require that any modification be in writing. That is because of the common-law principle that the parties to a contract should not be deterred from changing their minds. However, any modification (oral or written) must still be supported by consideration to be enforceable.

Here, the parties orally agreed to extend the exclusivity period by 60 days. Although the written agreement contained a NOM clause, the modified exclusivity period did not need to be evidenced by a writing since no statute of frauds provision applies.† And since there was consideration - 60 more days of exclusivity in exchange for 60 more days of service - the parties' oral agreement effectively modified their written agreement (Choice A).

The terms of the modified contract are found partly in the original written agreement and partly in the modifying oral agreement. As a result, the broker had the right to receive a commission for up to 30 days after the 120-day exclusivity period had ended if the home sold to a buyer with whom she had negotiated during that period - which it did. Therefore, the broker will likely prevail.

†Contracts to pay a real estate broker a commission ordinarily fall outside the land-contract provision of the statute of frauds. Some jurisdictions have added a provision to their statute of frauds requiring such contracts to be in writing, but that is not the case here.

(Choice B) The parol evidence rule generally prevents proof of prior or contemporaneous agreements that modify or contradict the terms of a written contract. But this rule does not prevent proof of subsequent agreements between the parties - eg, the oral agreement entered after the written listing agreement was executed.

(Choice C) The agreement to pay the real estate broker a commission is not subject to the statute of frauds. Nevertheless, the broker can only prevail if the oral modification agreement also falls outside of the statute of frauds.

Educational objective: Common law ignores "no oral modification" clauses and allows written contracts to be modified by subsequent oral agreements unless the modified contract falls within the statute of frauds.

选项正确率统计：A选项 41%，B选项 15%，C选项 5%，D选项 38%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

“禁止口头修改”（NOM）条款


普通法（Common law）
（服务或房地产合同）		仅当根据《欺诈法》（statute of frauds），修改必须以书面形式进行时，“禁止口头修改”条款才可强制执行
UCC
（货物买卖合同）
  • 各方均为商人 - “禁止口头修改”条款始终可强制执行
  • > 1方为非商人 - 商人格式合同中的“禁止口头修改”条款必须由非商人方单独签署方可强制执行
UCC = 《统一商法典》（Uniform Commercial Code）。

在普通法（common law）中，先前的书面合同可以通过后续的口头协议进行修改，除非修改后的合同属于《欺诈法》（statute of frauds）的管辖范围。即使书面合同中包含“禁止口头修改”（NOM）条款，声称要求任何修改都必须以书面形式进行，上述规定依然成立。这是因为普通法有一项原则，即不应阻止合同各方改变主意。然而，任何修改（无论是口头还是书面）仍需有对价支持方可强制执行。

在本案中，双方口头同意将独家销售期延长60天。尽管书面协议包含“禁止口头修改”条款，但修改后的独家销售期不需要书面证明，因为没有适用的《欺诈法》（statute of frauds）条款。† 并且，由于存在对价——以额外的60天服务换取额外的60天独家销售权——双方的口头协议有效地修改了他们的书面协议（选项 A）。

修改后合同的条款部分见于原始书面协议，部分见于进行修改的口头协议。因此，如果在120天独家销售期结束后30天内，房屋出售给经纪人在此期间曾与之谈判过的买家——事实也的确如此——那么经纪人有权收取佣金。因此，经纪人很可能会胜诉。

†支付房地产经纪人佣金的合同通常不属于《欺诈法》（statute of frauds）中关于土地合同的规定。一些司法管辖区已在其《欺诈法》中增加了要求此类合同必须为书面形式的条款，但本案情况并非如此。

（选项 B） 口头证据规则（parol evidence rule）通常阻止对修改或与书面合同条款相矛盾的先前或同期协议进行证明。但该规则不阻止对双方后续协议的证明——例如，在签订书面委托销售协议后达成的口头协议。

（选项 C） 支付房地产经纪人佣金的协议不受《欺诈法》（statute of frauds）的约束。然而，只有当口头修改协议也不受《欺诈法》约束时，经纪人才能胜诉。

教学目的： 普通法（common law）忽略“禁止口头修改”条款，并允许书面合同通过后续的口头协议进行修改，除非修改后的合同属于《欺诈法》（statute of frauds）的管辖范围。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 149 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (oral modifications).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

正确答案：D

是的，因为双方的口头协议是对其书面协议的有效修改。

核心考点：禁止口头修改条款 (NOM Clause)

本题考察的是合同法中关于合同修改 (Modification) 的规则，特别是当合同中包含“禁止口头修改”（No Oral Modification, NOM）条款时的处理方式。

在 MBE 考试中，首先要区分适用法律：

法律体系 适用范围 NOM 条款效力
普通法
(Common Law)		 服务、房地产
(本题情况)		 通常无效。即使合同写了必须书面修改，双方仍可口头修改。
统一商法典
(UCC Article 2)		 货物买卖
(Sale of Goods)		 通常有效。如果合同规定必须书面修改，则口头修改无效。
深度解析：为什么选 D？

1. 适用普通法 (Common Law)：
本案涉及房地产经纪人服务合同，属于服务类合同，适用普通法，而非 UCC。

2. NOM 条款的不可执行性：
普通法有一个著名的原则：合同双方不能剥夺自己未来修改合同的权力。因此，即使书面合同中明确规定“任何修改必须书面”（NOM Clause），双方随后的口头协议依然可以有效地修改原合同。这被视为双方通过行动“放弃”了书面要求。

3. 对价 (Consideration) 的要求：
在普通法下，合同修改通常需要新的对价。
在本案中：

  • 经纪人付出的对价：承诺多提供60天的服务。
  • 房主付出的对价：承诺多给60天的独家销售权。
双方都承担了新的义务，因此存在有效的对价。

结论：
口头延期有效。房屋在延期后的保护期内售出，经纪人有权获得佣金。

干扰项排除

❌ 选项 A（错误）：
虽然普通法修改合同确实需要对价，但本案中已经存在新对价（双方互换了延长的权利和义务）。选项 A 错误地暗示没有对价。

❌ 选项 B（错误）：
口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule) 仅禁止引入合同签订前或签订时的口头协议来反驳书面合同。它绝不阻止证明合同签订后的修改（Subsequent Modification）。这是一个经典的 MBE 陷阱。

❌ 选项 C（错误）：
虽然房地产经纪合同通常不受《欺诈法》(Statute of Frauds) 管辖（除非特定州法规定），但这并不是经纪人胜诉的直接原因。胜诉的关键在于口头修改是有效的，而不是原合同的形式。

🎓 MBE 提分技巧：

看到“禁止口头修改条款”时，立即判断合同类型：
1. 卖服务/房子？ → 条款无效，口头修改行得通（只要有对价）。
2. 卖货物 (UCC)？ → 条款有效，口头修改行不通（除非有弃权 Waiver）。

此外，永远记住：Parol Evidence Rule 向后看（过去），不向前看（未来）。它永远不会阻止对“后来发生的事情”的证明。

questions.question:
A husband lost his job and decided to borrow money against his marital home. Each time he applied for a mortgage, his wife contacted the lender and withdrew the mortgage application. One Saturday evening, the husband forced the wife to sit at the kitchen table and placed a mortgage application in front of her. As he waved a large pair of scissors in front of the wife's face, he demanded that she promise to sign the application by the end of the week. The wife, frightened by her husband, agreed to do so. On Monday morning, the wife went to a notary public's office alone and signed the application. The notary asked the wife if she signed the application of her own free will, and the wife replied, "It is what it is." Several months later, the mortgage went into default.
Does the lender have a breach-of-contract claim against the wife?

choices.a: No, because the husband physically compelled the wife to sign the mortgage application.
choices.b: No, because the husband threatened the wife with serious bodily harm.
choices.c: Yes, because the wife never voided the contract.
choices.d: Yes, because the wife was no longer under duress when she signed the mortgage application.

一位丈夫失业后，决定用其婚内住宅作抵押借款。每当他申请抵押贷款时，他的妻子都会联系贷款人并撤回抵押贷款申请。一个周六的晚上，丈夫强迫妻子坐在厨房的餐桌旁，并将一份抵押贷款申请书放在她面前。他一边在妻子面前挥舞着一把大剪刀，一边要求她承诺在本周末前签署该申请书。妻子因受丈夫惊吓，同意了这一要求。周一早上，妻子独自前往公证处签署了该申请书。公证员问妻子是否是出于自愿签署该申请书，妻子回答说：“事已至此，就这样吧。”几个月后，该抵押贷款出现违约。

贷款人是否可以对妻子提起违约之诉？
options:
A. No, because the husband physically compelled the wife to sign the mortgage application.
不可以，因为丈夫以物理胁迫的方式强迫妻子签署抵押贷款申请书。

B. No, because the husband threatened the wife with serious bodily harm.
不可以，因为丈夫以严重的身体伤害威胁妻子。

C. Yes, because the wife never voided the contract.
可以，因为妻子从未宣告该合同无效。

D. Yes, because the wife was no longer under duress when she signed the mortgage application.
可以，因为当妻子签署抵押贷款申请书时，她已不再处于胁迫之下。
data.explanation:
Duress is a defense to contract enforceability when a party was induced to assent by any of the following:

  • Physical compulsion - rendering the contract void if the party's assent was compelled by physical force OR imminent threat of death or serious bodily harm
  • Improper threat by contracting party - rendering the contract voidable by the threatened party if he/she had no reasonable alternative but to succumb to the improper threat
  • Improper threat by third party - rendering the contract voidable by the threatened party if he/she had no choice but to succumb to the third party's improper threat (not seen here), unless the other contracting party did not know of the duress AND relied on the contract in good faith

Here, the wife manifested her assent to the contract by signing the mortgage application. The husband did not physically compel her to do so - eg, by grabbing her hand and using it to sign (Choice A). And though waving scissors in front of the wife's face on Saturday may have threatened serious bodily harm, that threat was no longer imminent when she signed the application on Monday (Choice B). Therefore, duress is no defense, and the lender has a breach-of-contract claim against the wife.

(Choice C) A contract may be voidable in certain situations, none of which are seen here. Therefore, the wife could not have voided the contract after willingly signing it.

Educational objective: Duress occurs when a party's assent to a contract is compelled by physical force or imminent threat of death or serious bodily harm. Duress also occurs when a party receives an improper threat and has no reasonable alternative but to succumb.



选项正确率统计：A选项 7%，B选项 30%，C选项 8%，D选项 52%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

胁迫 (Duress) 是一种合同可执行性的抗辩理由，当一方当事人的同意是由于以下任何一种情况引起的：

  • 物理胁迫 - 如果一方当事人的同意是由于物理暴力或即刻的死亡或严重身体伤害的威胁所强迫，则该合同无效
  • 缔约方的不当威胁 - 如果受威胁方没有合理的替代选择，只能屈服于该不当威胁，则该合同可由受威胁方撤销
  • 第三方的不当威胁 - 如果受威胁方别无选择，只能屈服于第三方的不当威胁（本案未见此情况），则该合同可由受威胁方撤销，除非另一缔约方不知晓该胁迫行为并且善意地信赖了该合同

在本案中，妻子通过签署抵押贷款申请书表明了她对合同的同意。丈夫并没有对她进行物理胁迫——例如，抓住她的手用以签名（选项A）。而且，尽管周六在妻子面前挥舞剪刀可能构成了严重身体伤害的威胁，但当她在周一签署申请书时，该威胁已不再是即刻的（选项B）。因此，胁迫不能作为抗辩理由，贷款人可以对妻子提起违约之诉。

（选项C）合同在某些情况下可能是可撤销的，但本案中并未出现这些情况。因此，妻子在自愿签署合同后，不能宣告该合同无效。

教学目的：当一方当事人对合同的同意是由于物理暴力或即刻的死亡或严重身体伤害的威胁所强迫时，即构成胁迫 (Duress)。当一方当事人受到不当威胁且没有合理的替代选择只能屈服时，也构成胁迫。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 174 - 176 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (discussing duress caused by physical compulsion and improper threat).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Defenses to Enforceability
核心考点：胁迫 (Duress)

在合同法中，如果一方因受到胁迫而签署合同，该合同的可执行性会受到影响。MBE常考两种类型的胁迫：

  1. 物理强制 (Physical Compulsion)
    Void
    如果一方是被物理力量强迫签署（例如：抓住手强行签字），合同自始无效。
  2. 不当威胁 (Improper Threat)
    Voidable
    如果一方受到不当威胁（如死亡、重伤威胁），且没有合理的替代选择只能屈服，合同可撤销。

关键要素：威胁必须在缔约时 (at the time of contracting) 实际诱导了当事人的同意。

案情时间线分析
周六 (Saturday)
丈夫挥舞剪刀威胁妻子，要求她承诺在周末前签字。
⚠️ 此时存在严重的身体伤害威胁。
周一 (Monday)
妻子独自 (alone) 前往公证处。
公证员询问意愿，她签署了文件。
✅ 此时丈夫不在场，直接的物理威胁已消失。
答案解析
正确答案 D 可以，因为当妻子签署抵押贷款申请书时，她已不再处于胁迫之下。

虽然周六发生了严重的威胁，但合同是在周一签署的。此时妻子独自一人，丈夫不在场，剪刀也不在眼前。法律上认为，当她前往公证处时，即刻的威胁 (imminent threat) 已经移除，她有机会寻求帮助或拒绝签署（即有了“合理的替代选择”）。因此，她在签署那一刻的主观意愿被视为未受法律意义上的“胁迫”控制。

选项 A 错误 物理强制 (Physical Compulsion)

这仅适用于极端的物理控制（如抓住手签字）。本案中丈夫是进行口头恐吓和挥舞剪刀，属于“威胁”而非“物理强制”。

选项 B 错误 威胁的即刻性 (Imminence)

虽然丈夫确实威胁了身体伤害，但该威胁必须在签署合同的那一刻是即刻且有效的。周一签署时，威胁已不再紧迫。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理 Duress (胁迫) 考题时，请务必检查时间差和因果关系：

  • 如果威胁发生在 T1，签字发生在 T2，且中间受害人有逃脱或寻求法律保护的机会，通常不构成足以抗辩合同执行的胁迫。
  • 区分 Void (无效) 和 Voidable (可撤销)：只有极端的物理强制才导致合同直接无效；大多数威胁导致合同可撤销。

questions.question:
During negotiations to purchase a used car, a buyer asked a dealer whether the car had ever been in an accident. The dealer replied: "It is a fine car and has been thoroughly inspected and comes with a certificate of assured quality. Feel free to have the car inspected by your own mechanic." In actuality, the car had been in a major accident, and the dealer had repaired and repainted the car, successfully concealing evidence of the accident. The buyer declined to have the car inspected by his own mechanic, explaining that he would rely on the dealer's certificate of assured quality. At no time did the dealer disclose that the car had previously been in an accident. The parties then signed a contract of sale. After the car was delivered and paid for, the buyer learned that the car had been in a major accident.
If the buyer sues the dealer to rescind the transaction, is the buyer likely to succeed?

choices.a: No, because the buyer had the opportunity to have the car inspected by his own mechanic and declined to do so.
choices.b: No, because the dealer did not affirmatively assert that the car had not been in an accident.
choices.c: Yes, because the contract was unconscionable.
choices.d: Yes, because the dealer's statement was intentionally misleading and the dealer concealed evidence of the accident.

data.questionStem:
Q81028

During negotiations to purchase a used car, a buyer asked a dealer whether the car had ever been in an accident. The dealer replied: "It is a fine car and has been thoroughly inspected and comes with a certificate of assured quality. Feel free to have the car inspected by your own mechanic." In actuality, the car had been in a major accident, and the dealer had repaired and repainted the car, successfully concealing evidence of the accident. The buyer declined to have the car inspected by his own mechanic, explaining that he would rely on the dealer's certificate of assured quality. At no time did the dealer disclose that the car had previously been in an accident. The parties then signed a contract of sale. After the car was delivered and paid for, the buyer learned that the car had been in a major accident.

If the buyer sues the dealer to rescind the transaction, is the buyer likely to succeed?

在一场二手车购买谈判中，一名买家询问经销商该车是否曾发生过事故。经销商回答说：“这是一辆好车，已经过全面检查，并附有质量保证证书。您可以随时请您自己的技师检查这辆车。”实际上，该车曾发生过一次重大事故，经销商修理并重新喷漆，成功地掩盖了事故的证据。买家拒绝让自己的技师检查该车，并解释说他将信赖经销商的质量保证证书。经销商自始至终没有披露该车曾发生过事故。随后，双方签署了一份销售合同。车辆交付并付款后，买家得知该车曾发生过重大事故。

如果买家起诉经销商要求撤销该交易，买家是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the buyer had the opportunity to have the car inspected by his own mechanic and declined to do so.
不会，因为买家有机会让自己的技师检查车辆，但他拒绝了。

B. No, because the dealer did not affirmatively assert that the car had not been in an accident.
不会，因为经销商并未明确断言该车没有发生过事故。

C. Yes, because the contract was unconscionable.
会，因为该合同不合情理。

D. Yes, because the dealer's statement was intentionally misleading and the dealer concealed evidence of the accident.
会，因为经销商的陈述具有故意误导性，并且经销商隐瞒了事故的证据。
data.explanation:
Misrepresentation is an untrue assertion of fact often made in an affirmative statement. It can also be asserted through conduct - ie, an act of concealment intended to prevent discovery of facts or nondisclosure (Choice B). When either form of misrepresentation occurs, a contract is voidable and can be rescinded by the adversely affected party if:
  • the misrepresentation was fraudulent (ie, made knowingly or recklessly with intent to induce the other party's assent to the contract) OR material (ie, likely to induce a reasonable person's assent)
  • the misrepresentation induced assent to the contract and the adversely affected party justifiably relied† on the misrepresentation.


Here, the dealer repaired and repainted the car to conceal accident damage. This fraudulent misrepresentation, along with the dealer's misleading statements about the car's history, induced the buyer to purchase the car. And since the dealer's misrepresentations were not obviously false (eg, had the accident damage been visible) or known by the buyer to be false, he justifiably relied on them. Therefore, his action to rescind the contract is likely to succeed.

†This element is met unless the misrepresentation was patently and obviously false or the adversely affected party knew that it was false.

(Choice A) The buyer's failure to have the car inspected by his own mechanic does not make his reliance on the dealer's misrepresentations unjustified or prevent him from rescinding the contract.

(Choice C) A contract is unconscionable when (1) the contract terms are one-sided or create unfair surprise or (2) the bargaining process provides no meaningful choice to a party (neither of which is seen here).

Educational objective: A contract is voidable for misrepresentation if (1) the misrepresentation was fraudulent or material, (2) it induced assent to the contract, and (3) the adversely affected party justifiably relied on it.



选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 5%，C选项 1%，D选项 83%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

虚假陈述(Misrepresentation)是指对事实的不实断言，通常以肯定性陈述的形式作出。它也可以通过行为来主张——即，旨在阻止他人发现事实的隐瞒行为或未予披露的行为（选项B）。当任何一种形式的虚假陈述发生时，如果符合以下条件，合同是可撤销的(voidable)，并可由利益受损方撤销(rescinded)：
  • 该虚假陈述是欺诈性的（即，明知或鲁莽地(recklessly)作出，意图诱使对方同意合同）或重大的（即，可能诱使一个通情达理的人同意）
  • 该虚假陈述诱使了合同的同意并且利益受损方正当地信赖†了该虚假陈述。


在本案中，经销商修理并重新喷漆以掩盖事故损坏。这种欺诈性的虚假陈述，加上经销商关于车辆历史的误导性言论，诱使买家购买了该车。而且，由于经销商的虚假陈述并非明显虚假（例如，如果事故损坏是可见的），买家也不知道其为虚假，因此他对这些陈述的信赖是正当的。因此，他要求撤销合同的诉讼很可能成功。

†除非虚假陈述是显而易见的虚假，或者利益受损方知道其为虚假，否则此要素即告满足。

（选项A）买家未能让自己的技师检查车辆，并不会使其对经销商虚假陈述的信赖变得不正当，也不会阻止他撤销合同。

（选项C）当（1）合同条款过于偏向一方或造成不公平的意外，或（2）谈判过程未给一方提供有意义的选择时，合同才是不合情理的(unconscionable)（本案中均未出现这些情况）。

教学目的：如果（1）虚假陈述是欺诈性的或重大的，（2）它诱使了对合同的同意，并且（3）利益受损方正当地信赖了该虚假陈述，则该合同因虚假陈述而是可撤销的。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 164 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when misrepresentation makes a contract voidable).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 168 - 72 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when reliance on assertions of fact or opinion is justified).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：虚假陈述与隐瞒

⚖️核心法律规则

本题考察的是合同法中的虚假陈述 (Misrepresentation) 和 隐瞒 (Concealment)。

根据《合同法重述（第二版）》(Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 164)，如果一方的同意是基于对方的欺诈性虚假陈述 (Fraudulent Misrepresentation) 作出的，且受害方的信赖是正当的 (Justified)，则合同可撤销 (Voidable)。

虚假陈述不仅包括口头谎言，还包括：

  • 积极隐瞒 (Active Concealment)：采取行动掩盖事实，阻止对方发现真相。
  • 半真半假 (Half-truths)：陈述部分事实，但隐瞒了关键信息，导致整体印象具有误导性。

✅正确答案分析 (选项 D)

结论：买家很可能胜诉，因为经销商的行为构成了欺诈。

逻辑推演：

  1. 积极隐瞒：经销商不仅没有披露事故，还重新喷漆并修理以“成功掩盖证据”。这种行为等同于对事实的否定断言 (Assertion that the fact does not exist)。
  2. 误导性陈述：当被问及事故时，经销商回答“这是一辆好车……经过全面检查”，这是一种故意误导的回答。
  3. 正当信赖 (Justifiable Reliance)：买家信赖了经销商的“质量保证证书”和口头陈述。虽然买家有机会检查，但在面对故意欺诈时，受害方通常有权信赖对方的陈述，除非虚假事实是显而易见 (Obvious/Patent) 的。

⚠️常见陷阱 (选项 A & B)

选项 A (关于检查机会)： 这是最大的干扰项。

很多考生认为“买家自己放弃检查”就不能起诉。但在故意欺诈 (Intentional Fraud) 的情况下，买家自身的疏忽（未检查）通常不是欺诈方的抗辩理由。只要损坏不是肉眼可见的（经销商已掩盖），买家的信赖就是正当的。

选项 B (关于未明确断言)：

虽然经销商没有直接说“没出过事故”，但法律规定行为 (Conduct) 也可以构成断言。掩盖证据的行为本身就是一种虚假陈述。此外，对于特定询问的闪烁其词也构成了误导。

🎓MBE 考试技巧

  • 区分“沉默”与“隐瞒”：单纯的沉默 (Nondisclosure) 在没有披露义务时可能不构成欺诈，但积极的掩盖行为 (Active Concealment) 总是构成欺诈。
  • 信赖原则：在 MBE 考试中，如果一方故意撒谎或隐瞒，不要因为受害方“本可以发现真相”而轻易剥夺其救济权。欺诈者不能利用受害者的信任作为挡箭牌。
  • 关键词识别：看到 "Concealed evidence" (隐瞒证据) 或 "Painted over" (喷漆覆盖)，通常指向欺诈性虚假陈述。

questions.question:
A professional race car driver decided to retire and sell his drag racing car. An amateur driver approached him about buying the car. The amateur driver explained that she needed a car that could complete a quarter-mile race in less than nine seconds, and the professional driver boasted that his car could do so in eight to nine seconds. Unbeknownst to the professional driver, there was a calibration error in his timing equipment, and the car had never completed a quarter-mile race in less than 10 seconds.
The two drivers settled on a price and signed a fully integrated, written contract. The amateur driver paid the sales price, took delivery of the car, and entered the next drag race. The car was unable to complete a quarter-mile race in less than 10 seconds, so the amateur driver contacted the professional driver and demanded her money back.
Is the professional driver obligated to return the amateur driver's money?

choices.a: No, because the professional driver's assertion was an unintentional misrepresentation.
choices.b: No, because the sales contract was memorialized in a fully integrated writing.
choices.c: Yes, because the professional driver's assertion was a fraudulent misrepresentation.
choices.d: Yes, because the professional driver's assertion was a material misrepresentation.

data.questionStem:
Q81024

A professional race car driver decided to retire and sell his drag racing car. An amateur driver approached him about buying the car. The amateur driver explained that she needed a car that could complete a quarter-mile race in less than nine seconds, and the professional driver boasted that his car could do so in eight to nine seconds. Unbeknownst to the professional driver, there was a calibration error in his timing equipment, and the car had never completed a quarter-mile race in less than 10 seconds.

The two drivers settled on a price and signed a fully integrated, written contract. The amateur driver paid the sales price, took delivery of the car, and entered the next drag race. The car was unable to complete a quarter-mile race in less than 10 seconds, so the amateur driver contacted the professional driver and demanded her money back.

Is the professional driver obligated to return the amateur driver's money?

一名职业赛车手决定退役并出售其直线加速赛车。一位业余车手找到他商谈购车事宜。该业余车手解释说，她需要一辆能在九秒内完成四分之一英里赛的赛车，而职业赛车手则声称他的车能在八到九秒内完成。职业赛车手并不知道，他的计时设备存在校准错误，该车从未在十秒内完成过四分之一英里赛。

两名车手谈妥了价格并签订了一份完全一体化的书面合同。业余车手支付了售价，接收了车辆，并参加了下一场直线加速赛。该车无法在十秒内完成四分之一英里赛，于是业余车手联系了职业赛车手，要求退还款项。

职业赛车手是否有义务退还业余车手的钱款？
options:
A. No, because the professional driver's assertion was an unintentional misrepresentation.
否，因为职业赛车手的陈述是无意的虚假陈述。

B. No, because the sales contract was memorialized in a fully integrated writing.
否，因为该销售合同已由一份完全一体化的书面文件正式记录。

C. Yes, because the professional driver's assertion was a fraudulent misrepresentation.
是，因为职业赛车手的陈述是欺诈性虚假陈述。

D. Yes, because the professional driver's assertion was a material misrepresentation.
是，因为职业赛车手的陈述是重大虚假陈述。
data.explanation:
A misrepresentation is an untrue assertion of fact made during contract negotiations. This renders the contract voidable by the adversely affected party if:
  • the misrepresentation was fraudulent or material
  • the misrepresentation induced assent to the contract (presumed for material misrepresentations) and the adversely affected party justifiably relied on the misrepresentation.
The justifiable-reliance element is essentially always met unless the misrepresentation was obviously false or known by the adversely affected party to be false.

Here, the professional driver falsely stated that his car could complete a quarter-mile race in eight to nine seconds. This misrepresentation was material and presumably induced the amateur driver to enter the contract since she had told the professional driver that she was looking for a car with that capability. The amateur driver's reliance on the misrepresentation was justifiable since it was not obviously false or known by her to be false. Therefore, the contract is voidable, and the professional driver is obligated to return the amateur driver's money.

(Choices A & C) A misrepresentation is fraudulent when it is made knowingly or recklessly, with intent to induce assent to the contract. Here, the professional driver's misrepresentation was nonfraudulent since he had timed his car and knew nothing about the calibration error in his timing equipment. But even an unintentional, nonfraudulent misrepresentation may be grounds to avoid a contract when, as here, the misrepresentation was material.

(Choice B) The parol evidence rule generally bars evidence of prior or contemporaneous agreements to modify or contradict the terms of an integrated writing. But such evidence is excepted from this rule and is admissible when it is offered to prove defenses to enforcement (eg, misrepresentation - as seen here).

Educational objective: A misrepresentation renders a contract voidable by the adversely affected party if:
  • the misrepresentation was fraudulent or material,
  • it induced assent to the contract, and
  • the adversely affected party justifiably relied on it.




选项正确率统计：A选项 27%，B选项 3%，C选项 1%，D选项 67%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

虚假陈述 (misrepresentation) 是指在合同协商过程中所作出的不真实的事实陈述。如果满足以下条件，它将使合同可被撤销 (contract voidable)：
  • 该虚假陈述是欺诈性 (fraudulent) 或重大性 (material) 的
  • 该虚假陈述诱使了（另一方）对合同的同意 (induced assent)（对于重大虚假陈述，此项被推定成立）并且受不利影响的一方正当地依赖 (justifiably relied) 了该虚假陈述。
除非虚假陈述明显是虚假的，或受不利影响的一方已知其为虚假，否则正当依赖的要素基本上总是被满足。

在本案中，职业赛车手虚假地陈述其赛车能在八到九秒内完成四分之一英里赛。这一虚假陈述是重大的，并且可以推定诱使了业余车手签订合同，因为她已告知职业赛车手她正在寻找一辆具备该性能的赛车。业余车手对该虚假陈述的依赖是正当的，因为它并非明显虚假，她也不知道其为虚假。因此，该合同是可撤销的，职业赛车手有义务退还业余车手的钱款。

(选项 A & C) 当虚假陈述是明知或鲁莽地做出，并意图诱使对方同意合同时，该陈述即为欺诈性。在本案中，职业赛车手的虚假陈述是非欺诈性的，因为他曾对自己的赛车进行计时，且对计时设备的校准错误一无所知。但是，即使是无意的、非欺诈性的虚假陈述，当其为重大虚假陈述时（如本案），也可能构成撤销合同的理由。

(选项 B) 口头证据规则 (The parol evidence rule) 通常禁止使用先前或同期的协议证据来修改或反驳一体化书面文件的条款。但此类证据在该规则中属于例外情况，当其用于证明履行的抗辩理由（例如，本案中的虚假陈述）时，是可采纳的。

教学目标：如果满足以下条件，虚假陈述将使合同可由受不利影响的一方撤销：
  • 该虚假陈述是欺诈性或重大性的，
  • 它诱使了对合同的同意，并且
  • 受不利影响的一方正当地依赖了它。


References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 159, 162, 164 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (defining material misrepresentation and explaining when it makes a contract voidable).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Defenses to Enforceability
⚖️ 核心法则：虚假陈述 (Misrepresentation)

如果一方在缔约过程中做出了不真实的陈述，受损方可以撤销合同 (Voidable)，前提是满足以下条件：

  1. 该陈述是欺诈性的 (Fraudulent)
    或者
    该陈述是重大的 (Material)；
  2. 该陈述诱使 (Induced) 对方同意缔约；
  3. 受损方的信赖是正当的 (Justified)。
🏎️ 本案关键事实分析
1 陈述是否虚假？
是。卖家说车能在8-9秒跑完，实际上需要10秒以上。
2 是欺诈 (Fraud) 吗？
不是。卖家是因为设备校准错误而不知情，属于无意 (Innocent) 的虚假陈述。
3 是重大 (Material) 吗？
是的，非常关键！
买家明确表示她买车的目的是为了参加比赛（需要9秒以内）。对于赛车买卖来说，速度是核心要素。

✅ 正确答案：D

理由：因为职业赛车手的陈述是重大虚假陈述 (Material Misrepresentation)。

即使卖家是无意/非欺诈的 (Innocent/Non-fraudulent)，只要该虚假陈述是重大的 (Material)，买家依然有权撤销合同。

在本案中，速度直接决定了买家能否达成购买目的，因此构成重大虚假陈述。

🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (无意陈述)：
错误。虽然确实是无意的，但这不能作为抗辩理由。法律规定：Material Misrepresentation 即使是无意的，也足以让合同可撤销。
选项 B (口头证据规则 Parol Evidence Rule)：
这是常见的陷阱！
虽然合同是“完全一体化”的 (Fully Integrated)，通常禁止引入外部证据来改变条款。但是，PER 有一个重要例外：当证据是用来证明合同因欺诈、虚假陈述或胁迫而无效或可撤销时，该证据是可采纳的 (Admissible)。
选项 C (欺诈性)：
错误。题目明确指出卖家“不知道”设备错误。欺诈需要这就要求有故意 (Intent/Scienter)。虽然结果一样（合同可撤销），但理由归类错误。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

看到 Misrepresentation 题目时，请按此逻辑检查：

  • 如果是故意骗人 ➡️ Fraudulent ➡️ 合同可撤销。
  • 如果是无意说错 ➡️ 检查是否 Material (对交易至关重要) ➡️ 如果是，合同可撤销。
  • Parol Evidence Rule 挡不住证明合同无效的证据 (Defenses to formation/enforcement)。
Reference: Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 162, 164

questions.question:
A doctor was employed at a hospital when she applied for a personal loan from a bank. She accurately disclosed her income in the loan application. Before the bank had reached a decision regarding the loan application, the doctor was fired from the hospital. The doctor decided not to inform the bank of this fact because she feared that the bank would refuse to give her the loan.
A few days later, a bank representative called the doctor and informed her that her loan application was approved. The doctor accepted the terms of the loan and signed the loan agreement. Before disbursing the funds, the bank learned of the doctor's firing and refused to honor the loan agreement.
If the doctor sues the bank for breach of contract, will she be likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the doctor's ability to repay the loan was a condition precedent to the disbursement of the funds.
choices.b: No, because the doctor's nondisclosure of her firing was a fraudulent misrepresentation.
choices.c: Yes, because the bank's reliance on the doctor's disclosure of her income in the loan application was unjustifiable.
choices.d: Yes, because the loan agreement was memorialized in a signed writing.

data.questionStem:
Q81041

A doctor was employed at a hospital when she applied for a personal loan from a bank. She accurately disclosed her income in the loan application. Before the bank had reached a decision regarding the loan application, the doctor was fired from the hospital. The doctor decided not to inform the bank of this fact because she feared that the bank would refuse to give her the loan.

A few days later, a bank representative called the doctor and informed her that her loan application was approved. The doctor accepted the terms of the loan and signed the loan agreement. Before disbursing the funds, the bank learned of the doctor's firing and refused to honor the loan agreement.

If the doctor sues the bank for breach of contract, will she be likely to prevail?

一名医生在医院工作时，向一家银行申请个人贷款。她在贷款申请中如实披露了其收入。在银行就其贷款申请做出决定之前，该医生被医院解雇。该医生决定不将此事告知银行，因为她担心银行会因此拒绝向她发放贷款。

几天后，一名银行代表致电该医生，通知她其贷款申请已获批准。该医生接受了贷款条款并签署了贷款协议。在发放资金前，银行得知了该医生被解雇一事，并拒绝履行贷款协议。

如果该医生以违约为由起诉银行，她是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the doctor's ability to repay the loan was a condition precedent to the disbursement of the funds.
不会，因为医生的还款能力是银行发放贷款的一项先决条件。

B. No, because the doctor's nondisclosure of her firing was a fraudulent misrepresentation.
不会，因为医生未披露其被解雇一事构成了欺诈性虚假陈述。

C. Yes, because the bank's reliance on the doctor's disclosure of her income in the loan application was unjustifiable.
会，因为银行对医生在贷款申请中披露其收入的信赖是不正当的。

D. Yes, because the loan agreement was memorialized in a signed writing.
会，因为贷款协议已通过一份签署的书面文件予以确定。
data.explanation:
When disclosure is required to avoid misrepresentation


Previous assertionDisclosure would prevent previous assertion from being a misrepresentation or fraudulent or material
Mistake about basic assumptionDisclosure would correct other party's mistake about basic assumption of contract AND Failure to disclose would constitute lack of good faith & fair dealing
Fiduciary relationshipOther party is entitled to know fact because of confidential/fiduciary relationship
Mistake about writingDisclosure would correct other party's mistake about contents or effect of writing that embodies agreement
A misrepresentation is an untrue assertion of fact that makes a contract voidable by the adversely affected party when all of the following elements are met:
  • The misrepresentation was fraudulent (ie, made knowingly or recklessly with the intent to induce the other party's assent to the contract) OR material (ie, likely to induce a reasonable person's assent).†
  • The misrepresentation induced assent to the contract.
  • The adversely affected party justifiably relied on the misrepresentation.
Nondisclosure of a known fact is treated as an untrue assertion if, among other things, the nondisclosing party knows that disclosure is necessary to prevent a previous assertion from being fraudulent. Here, the doctor accurately disclosed her income in the loan application but was then fired. She knew that she needed to disclose this fact to the bank to prevent her previous disclosure from being fraudulent but failed to do so. Since the bank was unaware of her firing, it justifiably agreed to give her a loan. Therefore, the contract is voidable by the bank, and the doctor is unlikely to prevail in her breach-of-contract suit.

†A misrepresentation is also material if the maker knows that it will likely induce this particular party's assent - even if a reasonable person would not be induced.

(Choice A) A condition precedent is an explicit contract term requiring a future event to occur before a party becomes obligated to perform. But here, there is no indication that the bank's obligation to disburse the funds was explicitly conditioned on the doctor's ability to repay the loan.

(Choice C) Reliance is almost always justified unless the misrepresentation was obviously false or known by the adversely affected party to be false. Here, the doctor's disclosure was accurate (not obviously false) when it was made and the bank was unaware of her firing when it approved the loan, so the bank's reliance was justified.

(Choice D) The fact that the loan agreement was memorialized in a signed writing does not prevent it from being voidable on the basis of the doctor's fraudulent misrepresentation.

Educational objective: Nondisclosure of a known fact is treated as an untrue assertion of fact (ie, misrepresentation) if the nondisclosing party knows that disclosure is necessary to prevent a previous assertion from being fraudulent.

选项正确率统计：A选项 18%，B选项 72%（正确选项），C选项 1%，D选项 8%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

为避免虚假陈述而需要披露信息的情形


先前的陈述披露信息将可防止先前的陈述构成虚假陈述，或具有欺诈性或重要性
对基本假设的误解披露信息将可纠正另一方对合同基本假设的误解，并且不披露将构成缺乏善意和公平交易原则
信托关系基于保密/信托关系，另一方有权知晓该事实
对书面文件的误解披露信息将可纠正另一方对体现协议的书面文件内容或效力的误解
虚假陈述是对事实的不实断言，当满足以下所有要素时，它将使合同可由受不利影响的一方撤销：
  • 该虚假陈述具有欺诈性（即，明知或鲁莽地作出，意图引诱另一方同意合同）或重要性（即，可能引诱一个通情达理的人同意合同）。†
  • 该虚假陈述引诱了对合同的同意。
  • 受不利影响的一方正当地信赖了该虚假陈述。
如果不披露方知道有必要进行披露以防止其先前的陈述构成欺诈，那么不披露已知事实将被视为不实断言。在本案中，该医生在贷款申请中准确披露了她的收入，但随后被解雇。她知道需要向银行披露这一事实，以防止她先前的披露构成欺诈，但她没有这样做。由于银行不知道她被解雇，因此正当地同意向她提供贷款。因此，该合同可由银行撤销，医生在她的违约诉讼中不大可能胜诉。

†如果作出陈述者知道该陈述可能会引诱特定一方同意，即使一个通情达理的人不会被引诱，该虚假陈述也具有重要性。

（选项A）先决条件是一个明确的合同条款，要求在一方有义务履行之前必须发生某个未来事件。但在本案中，没有迹象表明银行发放资金的义务明确以医生的还款能力为条件。

（选项C）除非虚假陈述明显是虚假的或受不利影响的一方已知其为虚假，否则信赖几乎总是正当的。在本案中，医生在作出披露时其内容是准确的（并非明显虚假），且银行在批准贷款时并不知道她已被解雇，因此银行的信赖是正当的。

（选项D）贷款协议已通过一份签署的书面文件予以确定这一事实，并不能阻止其因医生的欺诈性虚假陈述而变为可撤销的合同。

教学目标：如果不披露方知道有必要进行披露以防止其先前的陈述构成欺诈，那么不披露已知事实将被视为对事实的不实断言（即虚假陈述）。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 161 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when nondisclosure is a misrepresentation).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 164 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when misrepresentation makes a contract voidable).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Defenses to Enforceability

核心考点：不披露何时构成欺诈？

通常情况下，合同一方没有义务披露所有事实。但在以下情况中，不披露 (Nondisclosure) 等同于虚假陈述 (Misrepresentation)：

  • 当需要披露以防止先前的陈述变为欺诈或实质性误导时。
  • 存在信托关系 (Fiduciary Relationship) 时。
  • 为了纠正对方对基本假设 (Basic Assumption) 的错误时。

Reference: Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 161

案情逻辑链分析

步骤 1：申请贷款
医生如实披露收入。此时陈述是真实的 (True Assertion)。
步骤 2：情况变更 (Change of Circumstances)
医生被解雇。之前的收入陈述虽然当时为真，但现在已不再准确。
步骤 3：故意隐瞒 (Intentional Nondisclosure)
医生为了获得贷款，决定不告知银行。这构成了欺诈意图 (Scienter)。
步骤 4：银行信赖并批准
银行基于过时的信息批准贷款。
✅ 正确答案：B

理由：医生未披露其被解雇一事构成了欺诈性虚假陈述 (Fraudulent Misrepresentation)。

虽然医生最初的陈述是真实的，但随后的事件（被解雇）使得之前的陈述产生了误导性。根据法律规定，如果一方知道披露事实是必要的，以防止其先前的陈述 (Previous Assertion) 变得具有欺诈性或误导性，那么未能披露就被视为虚假陈述。

因为这种虚假陈述诱导了银行签订合同，所以合同对银行来说是可撤销的 (Voidable)。

为什么其他选项是错的？

❌ 选项 A (Condition Precedent)
先决条件 除非合同中有明确条款规定（例如“以借款人受雇为条件”），否则一般的还款能力不是法律上的“先决条件”。银行的义务是基于合同成立，而不是基于医生的财务健康状况，除非合同另有规定。

❌ 选项 C (Unjustifiable Reliance)
信赖 银行的信赖是正当的。医生最初的披露是准确的，银行没有理由怀疑其真实性发生了变化。只有当虚假陈述显而易见时，信赖才是不正当的。

❌ 选项 D (Signed Writing)
书面形式 即使合同符合《反欺诈法》(Statute of Frauds) 并已签署，欺诈 (Fraud) 始终是合同可撤销的抗辩理由。书面形式不能保护欺诈方。

💡 MBE 考试技巧 遇到“沉默/不披露” (Silence/Nondisclosure) 的题目时，首先默认为“无披露义务”。然后寻找例外情况：
  1. 是否为了纠正之前的陈述？（本题考点）
  2. 是否为了纠正对方的重大误解？
  3. 是否有特殊信任关系？
如果符合上述任一情况，沉默即构成欺诈。

questions.question:
A film star moved to the West Coast to further his acting career. He agreed to work for a motion picture studio for the next five years, leased a high-rise condominium for nine months, entered an agreement to purchase an exotic sports car for $250,000, and agreed to transfer ownership of his beach house to his girlfriend if she married him.
Which of these transactions is most likely to be enforceable without a signed writing?

choices.a: The employment agreement with the motion picture studio.
choices.b: The lease agreement with the luxury condominium corporation.
choices.c: The purchase agreement for the sports car.
choices.d: The agreement to transfer the beach house to the girlfriend.

data.questionStem:
Q81053

A film star moved to the West Coast to further his acting career. He agreed to work for a motion picture studio for the next five years, leased a high-rise condominium for nine months, entered an agreement to purchase an exotic sports car for $250,000, and agreed to transfer ownership of his beach house to his girlfriend if she married him.

Which of these transactions is most likely to be enforceable without a signed writing?

一位电影明星为了发展其演艺事业，搬到了西海岸。他同意为一家电影制片厂工作五年，租用了一套高层公寓九个月，签订了一份以25万美元购买一辆珍奇跑车的协议，并同意如果女友与他结婚，就将海滨别墅的所有权转让给她。

在这些交易中，哪一项最有可能在没有书面签署的情况下具有强制执行力？
options:
A. The employment agreement with the motion picture studio.
与电影制片厂签订的雇佣协议。

B. The lease agreement with the luxury condominium corporation.
与豪华公寓公司签订的租赁协议。

C. The purchase agreement for the sports car.
跑车的购买协议。

D. The agreement to transfer the beach house to the girlfriend.
将海滨别墅转让给女友的协议。
data.explanation:
The statute of frauds requires the following contracts to be evidenced by a writing that contains all essential terms and is signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought ( MY LEGS ):
Marriagea contract made in consideration of marriage
Yeara contract that cannot be completed within one year
Landa contract for the sale or transfer of an interest in real property
Executora contract to pay an estate's debt out of the executor's personal funds
Goodsa contract for the sale of goods for $500 or more
Suretyshipa contract to answer for the debt or duty of another
Therefore, in this scenario, the following transactions must be evidenced by a signed writing to be enforceable:

  • The five-year employment agreement with the motion picture studio because it cannot be completed in less than one year (Choice A)
  • The purchase agreement for the sports car (a good) because the $250,000 sales price exceeds $500 (Choice C)
  • The agreement to transfer ownership of the beach house to the girlfriend because it (1) involves an interest in real property and (2) was made in consideration of her marriage to the film star (Choice D)


However, the nine-month lease agreement with the luxury condominium corporation does not fall under the statute of frauds - even though it involves an interest in real property. The reason is that leases and easements for less than one year are usually excluded from the statute.† Therefore, this transaction is most likely to be enforceable without a signed writing.

†Licenses and assignments of mortgages are also excluded from the statute of frauds.

Educational objective: Contracts that fall under the statute of frauds (MY LEGS) must be contained in a signed writing to be enforceable. Although this generally includes contracts involving an interest in real property, leases and easements for less than one year do not fall under the statute.



选项正确率统计：A选项 10%，B选项 75%（正确选项），C选项 3%，D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

statute of frauds（反欺诈法）要求以下合同必须以书面形式为证，该书面文件需包含所有基本条款，并由被要求强制执行的一方签署（MY LEGS）：
Marriage (婚姻)以婚姻为对价订立的合同
Year (一年)无法在一年内完成的合同
Land (土地)关于不动产权益出售或转让的合同
Executor (遗嘱执行人)遗嘱执行人以其个人资金偿还遗产债务的合同
Goods (货物)价值500美元或以上的货物买卖合同
Suretyship (保证)为他人债务或义务作保的合同
因此，在本案中，以下交易必须有经签署的书面文件为证才具有强制执行力：

  • 与电影制片厂签订的五年期雇佣协议，因为它无法在一年内完成（选项A）
  • 跑车（一种货物）的购买协议，因为其25万美元的售价超过了500美元（选项C）
  • 将海滨别墅所有权转让给女友的协议，因为它 (1) 涉及不动产权益，并且 (2) 是以她与该电影明星结婚为对价而订立的（选项D）


然而，与豪华公寓公司签订的为期九个月的租赁协议不属于 statute of frauds 的管辖范围——尽管它涉及不动产权益。原因是，期限少于一年的租赁和地役权通常被排除在该法规的适用范围之外。† 因此，这项交易最有可能在没有书面签署的情况下具有强制执行力。

†许可和抵押权的转让也被排除在 statute of frauds 的适用范围之外。

教学目标： 属于 statute of frauds (MY LEGS) 管辖范围的合同，必须以经签署的书面形式存在才具有强制执行力。尽管这通常包括涉及不动产权益的合同，但期限少于一年的租赁和地役权不属于该法规的管辖范围。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 127 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (interests in land subject to the statute of frauds).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Statute of Frauds

核心考点：反欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds)

一般原则下，口头合同是有效的。但 Statute of Frauds (SOF) 规定，某些特定类型的合同必须有经签署的书面文件 (Signed Writing) 才能强制执行。

记忆口诀：MY LEGS

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 B)

案情：与豪华公寓公司签订的为期九个月的租赁协议。

法律依据：虽然租赁 (Lease) 属于土地权益 (Interest in Land) 的转让，通常受 SOF 管辖。但是，大多数司法管辖区（以及 MBE 考试规则）都有一个重要的例外：

短期租赁例外 (Short-term Lease Exception)：
期限在一年或一年以下的租赁合同，不需要书面形式即可强制执行。

结论：因为租期仅为 9 个月（< 1年），所以该口头协议有效，无需书面签署。

❌ 为什么其他选项需要书面形式？

选项 A 雇佣协议 (Employment)

原因：合同期限为 5 年。根据 One-Year Rule，凡是根据合同条款不可能在一年内履行完毕的合同，必须书面化。

选项 C 跑车购买 (Sale of Goods)

原因：跑车属于货物 (Goods)。根据 UCC § 2-201，价格在 $500 或以上的货物买卖合同必须书面化。$250,000 远超此限额。

选项 D 海滨别墅转让 (Land & Marriage)

原因：这里有两个触发 SOF 的点：

  • Land：涉及不动产所有权的永久转让。
  • Marriage：以结婚为对价 (In consideration of marriage) 的承诺。
因此必须书面化。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

看到涉及“土地”或“租赁”的题目时，不要条件反射地认为一定需要书面合同。

一定要检查时间跨度！
  • 如果是租赁 (Lease) 且 ≤ 1年 ➡️ 通常不需要书面。
  • 如果是服务合同 (Service) 且 > 1年 ➡️ 必须要书面。

A woman owned a large ranch, which she orally offered to sell to her stable manager for $250,000. The stable manager eagerly accepted her offer, and the woman wrote and gave him an unsigned note that read, "I agree to sell you my ranch for $250,000."
The stable manager gave the woman a small down payment to seal the deal and then took possession of the ranch with the woman's permission. Shortly thereafter, the stable manager received a letter from the woman stating that another buyer had offered to buy the ranch for $425,000 and that she would not sell it to the stable manager unless he buys it for that price.
If the stable manager sues the woman for specific performance, which of the following concepts would best support his claim?

choices.a: Anticipatory breach.
choices.b: Good faith and fair dealing.
choices.c: Part performance.
choices.d: Quantum meruit.

data.questionStem:
Q81051

A woman owned a large ranch, which she orally offered to sell to her stable manager for $250,000. The stable manager eagerly accepted her offer, and the woman wrote and gave him an unsigned note that read, "I agree to sell you my ranch for $250,000."

The stable manager gave the woman a small down payment to seal the deal and then took possession of the ranch with the woman's permission. Shortly thereafter, the stable manager received a letter from the woman stating that another buyer had offered to buy the ranch for $425,000 and that she would not sell it to the stable manager unless he buys it for that price.

If the stable manager sues the woman for specific performance, which of the following concepts would best support his claim?

一名女士拥有一座大牧场，她口头要约以25万美元的价格将其出售给她的马厩经理。马厩经理欣然接受了她的要约，该女士写了一张未签署的便条交给他，内容是：“我同意以25万美元的价格将我的牧场卖给你。”

为了达成交易，马厩经理向该女士支付了一小笔首付款，然后在该女士的许可下占有了该牧场。此后不久，马厩经理收到了该女士的一封信，信中称另一位买家已要约以42.5万美元的价格购买该牧场，除非马厩经理以该价格购买，否则她不会将牧场出售给他。

如果马厩经理就特定履行起诉该女士，以下哪个概念最能支持他的主张？
options:
A. Anticipatory breach.
预期违约。

B. Good faith and fair dealing.
诚信与公平交易原则。

C. Part performance.
部分履行。

D. Quantum meruit.
Quantum meruit.
data.explanation:
The statute of frauds applies to contracts for the sale of land (eg, the ranch). It requires that the contract (1) be in writing, (2) be signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought, and (3) contain all essential terms. Therefore, the woman and stable manager's oral agreement and the woman's unsigned note each violated this statute.

However, a contract for the sale of land that violates this statute may still be enforceable if the part-performance exception applies. This requires proof that the buyer has done at least two of the following:
  • Taken possession of the property (as the stable manager did here)
  • Made substantial improvements to the property (not seen here)
  • Paid some or all of the purchase price (here, the stable manager made a small down payment)

The buyer can then bring an action in equity for specific performance. However, part performance will not support an ordinary action at law for money damages.

(Choice A) Anticipatory breach† occurs when one party communicates to the other party that it will not perform under the contract. The other party can treat this as a breach and sue immediately or demand performance. Here, although the woman told the stable manager that she would not sell him the ranch for the agreed-upon price, this would not overcome the statute of frauds.

†This is also called anticipatory repudiation.

(Choice B) The duty of good faith and fair dealing implied in every contract requires that neither party interfere with the other party's performance of the contract or right to receive the benefits thereof. But the stable manager cannot assert a breach of this duty without first proving that an enforceable contract exists.

(Choice D) Quantum meruit entitles a party who has conferred a benefit on another in a quasi-contractual relationship to damages for the reasonable value of the benefit, but not specific performance.

Educational objective: A contract involving land that violates the statute of frauds is enforceable on part-performance grounds if the buyer has done at least two of the following: taken possession of the property, substantially improved it, and/or paid any portion of the purchase price.



选项正确率统计：A选项 7%，B选项 9%，C选项 79%（正确选项），D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

statute of frauds适用于土地（例如，该牧场）的买卖合同。它要求合同（1）必须是书面形式，（2）必须由被要求强制执行的一方签署，以及（3）包含所有基本条款。因此，该女士和马厩经理的口头协议以及该女士的未签署的便条都违反了该法规。

然而，违反该法规的土地买卖合同，如果适用部分履行例外，则仍可强制执行。这需要证明买方已完成以下至少两项：
  • 占有了该财产（如本案中马厩经理所为）
  • 对财产进行了重大改良（本案未见）
  • 支付了部分或全部购买价款（本案中，马厩经理支付了一小笔首付款）

然后，买方可以提起衡平法诉讼，要求特定履行。然而，部分履行不支持要求金钱损害赔偿的普通法诉讼。

(选项A) 预期违约†发生于一方告知另一方其将不履行合同。另一方可将此视为违约并立即起诉或要求履行。在本案中，尽管该女士告诉马厩经理她不会以约定价格将牧场出售给他，但这并不能克服statute of frauds的障碍。

†这也被称为预期毁约。

(选项B) 每份合同中都暗含的诚信与公平交易义务要求任何一方都不得干涉另一方履行合同或获得合同利益的权利。但是，马厩经理必须首先证明存在一份可强制执行的合同，才能主张对方违反此项义务。

(选项D) Quantum meruit赋予在准合同关系中向另一方提供了利益的一方，就该利益的合理价值获得损害赔偿的权利，而非特定履行。

教学目标： 涉及土地的合同若违反了statute of frauds，但在买方已完成以下至少两项行为时，即：占有该财产、对其进行重大改良、和/或支付了任何部分的购买价款，则该合同可基于部分履行的理由而强制执行。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 129 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (action in reliance; specific performance).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Statute of Frauds

✅ 正确答案：C (Part Performance) 本题考查的是土地买卖合同中，如何通过部分履行 (Part Performance) 来克服反欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds) 的抗辩。
⚖️ 法律依据与推理
1. 初始障碍：反欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds)

土地买卖合同属于 SOF 管辖范围，必须满足以下条件才能强制执行：

  • 必须是书面形式 (In writing)。
  • 必须由被执行方签署 (Signed by the party to be charged)。

在本案中，虽然有便条，但没有签名 (unsigned)，且最初是口头协议。因此，根据一般规则，该合同不可强制执行。

2. 衡平法例外：部分履行 (Part Performance)

为了防止卖方利用 SOF 进行欺诈，衡平法 (Equity) 允许在买方已经开始履行合同的情况下强制执行口头土地合同。通常需要满足以下三个要素中的至少两个：

  • 💰 支付价款 (Payment)：全部或部分支付。
  • 🔑 占有 (Possession)：买方实际占有土地。
  • 🔨 改良 (Improvements)：买方对土地进行了实质性改良。
3. 案情涵摄 (Application)

马厩经理完成了以下行为：

  • 支付了首付款 (Payment)。
  • 在许可下占有了牧场 (Possession)。

这满足了“三选二”的标准。因此，法院可以适用部分履行原则，判决特定履行 (Specific Performance)，强制卖方过户土地。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
A Anticipatory Breach (预期违约)
虽然卖方确实表示不卖了，但在确立合同有效性之前，谈论违约没有意义。如果不能克服 SOF，合同本身就不可执行，也就无所谓违约。
B Good Faith (诚信原则)
诚信原则是现有合同中的隐含条款。同样地，必须先通过部分履行证明合同存在并可执行，才能讨论是否违反了诚信义务。
D Quantum Meruit (按劳计酬/不当得利)
这是一个准合同 (Quasi-contract) 概念，用于追回已提供服务的价值 (Money Damages)，以防止不当得利。但本题中买方寻求的是特定履行 (Specific Performance)（即要地，不要钱），因此部分履行是支持该诉求的正确理论。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

当看到口头土地合同 (Oral Land Contract) 时，第一反应是 SOF 导致合同无效。

紧接着看买方是否“给钱、入住、装修”。如果有其中两项，立刻寻找 Part Performance 选项。注意：部分履行通常只支持特定履行 (Specific Performance) 的诉求，而不支持普通法上的损害赔偿。

questions.question:
An elderly woman underwent major surgery and spent two weeks in the hospital. The woman continued to take powerful pain medication for several weeks after she returned home. During her recovery, she offered to sell her car for $450 to her neighbor, who owned a house-cleaning service. The neighbor said, "That's great! I need a car to transport all the people who work for me to their job sites."
In fact, the woman's car was worth $3,000, and the neighbor knew this. He was also aware that the woman had undergone surgery and noted that she seemed "out of it" because of the medication she was taking.
Several days later, the woman's son found out about the deal and contacted the neighbor, telling him that the woman would sell him the car, but for $3,450. The next day, when the neighbor tendered $450 and demanded that the woman give him the car, she refused.
If the neighbor sues the woman for breach of contract, will he be likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the contract was voidable due to the woman's apparent incapacity.
choices.b: No, because the woman put nothing in writing.
choices.c: Yes, because the neighbor's reliance on the otherwise voidable contract made it enforceable.
choices.d: Yes, because the woman's offer and the neighbor's acceptance created an enforceable contract.

Q81815 An elderly woman underwent major surgery and spent two weeks in the hospital. The woman continued to take powerful pain medication for several weeks after she returned home. During her recovery, she offered to sell her car for $450 to her neighbor, who owned a house-cleaning service. The neighbor said, "That's great! I need a car to transport all the people who work for me to their job sites."

In fact, the woman's car was worth $3,000, and the neighbor knew this. He was also aware that the woman had undergone surgery and noted that she seemed "out of it" because of the medication she was taking.

Several days later, the woman's son found out about the deal and contacted the neighbor, telling him that the woman would sell him the car, but for $3,450. The next day, when the neighbor tendered $450 and demanded that the woman give him the car, she refused.

If the neighbor sues the woman for breach of contract, will he be likely to prevail? 一位老妇人接受了一次大手术，并在医院住了两周。回家后，这位妇人继续服用了几周的强效止痛药。在康复期间，她向她拥有一家房屋清洁公司的邻居提出以450美元的价格出售她的汽车。邻居说：“太好了！我需要一辆车来运送为我工作的所有人去他们的工作地点。”

事实上，这位妇人的汽车价值3000美元，邻居也知道这一点。他还知道这位妇人做过手术，并注意到由于她正在服用的药物，她看起来“精神恍惚”。

几天后，这位妇人的儿子发现了这笔交易，并联系了邻居，告诉他妇人愿意卖车给他，但价格是3450美元。第二天，当邻居支付了450美元并要求妇人把车给他时，她拒绝了。

如果邻居以违约为由起诉这位妇人，他是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the contract was voidable due to the woman's apparent incapacity.
不会，因为由于该妇人明显的行为能力欠缺，该合同是可撤销的。

B. No, because the woman put nothing in writing.
不会，因为该妇人没有订立任何书面协议。

C. Yes, because the neighbor's reliance on the otherwise voidable contract made it enforceable.
会，因为邻居对本可撤销的合同的信赖使其变得可强制执行。

D. Yes, because the woman's offer and the neighbor's acceptance created an enforceable contract.
会，因为该妇人的要约和邻居的承诺创造了一份可强制执行的合同。
data.explanation:
Incapacity to form contract


Infancy
  • Person under 18 enters contract
  • Voidable if disaffirmed by minor before or soon after turning 18
  • Minor must return any still-existing benefit received under contract
Mental illness
  • Mental capacity so deficient that party cannot reasonably understand (or act in relation to) nature or consequences of contract AND other party had reason to know
  • Voidable if disaffirmed by incapacitated party when lucid or by legal representative
Intoxication
  • Party too intoxicated to reasonably understand (or act in relation to) nature or consequences of contract AND other party had reason to know
  • Voidable if promptly disaffirmed by intoxicated party upon becoming sober
  • Intoxicated party must offer to return any consideration received & may be liable for fair value of goods or services provided
A valid contract is generally formed when a mutual agreement is supported by adequate consideration—eg, when the woman offered to sell her car and the neighbor accepted. That contract is enforceable unless the breaching party establishes a defense (Choice D). Incapacity due to intoxication is a defense when:

  • an intoxicated party could not reasonably understand or act in relation to the nature or consequences of the contract (eg, selling a car worth $3,000 for only $450) and
  • the other party had reason to know of the intoxication (eg, noticing that the intoxicated party was "out of it" when the contract was formed).
This renders a contract voidable, so it can be set aside if the intoxicated party acts promptly (ie, within a reasonable time) to disaffirm it upon becoming sober. And here, the woman likely was still under medication when she disaffirmed the contract by refusing to give the neighbor the car, so the neighbor is unlikely to prevail.

(Choice B) A contract need only be in writing and signed by the party to be charged if it falls within the statute of frauds. This rule applies to contracts for the sale of goods for $500 or more, but it does not apply to this contract to sell the car for only $450.

(Choice C) Under the doctrine of promissory estoppel, a party can enforce a promise on which it relied when no valid contract was formed. But the doctrine only allows recovery if the party's reliance was reasonable and caused substantial detriment—neither of which is seen here.

缔结合同的行为能力欠缺


未成年
  • 未满18岁的人签订合同
  • 如果未成年人在年满18岁之前或之后不久否认合同，则合同可撤销
  • 未成年人必须归还根据合同获得的任何仍然存在的利益
精神疾病
  • 精神能力欠缺，以致当事人无法合理理解合同的性质或后果（或就此采取行动）并且另一方有理由知道
  • 如果无行为能力一方在清醒时或由其法定代表人否认合同，则合同可撤销
醉态
  • 当事人醉酒程度严重，以致无法合理理解合同的性质或后果（或就此采取行动）并且另一方有理由知道
  • 如果醉酒一方在清醒后立即否认合同，则合同可撤销
  • 醉酒一方必须提出归还收到的任何对价，并可能对所提供的商品或服务的公允价值承担责任
当双方合意得到充分对价支持时，一份有效的合同通常即告成立——例如，当该妇人要约出售其汽车且邻居承诺购买时。该合同是可强制执行的，除非违约方能确立一项抗辩理由（选项D）。因醉态导致的行为能力欠缺在以下情况下构成一项抗辩理由：

  • 醉酒一方无法合理理解合同的性质或后果或就此采取行动（例如，以仅450美元的价格出售价值3000美元的汽车）并且
  • 另一方有理由知道其醉态（例如，在合同成立时注意到醉酒一方“精神恍惚”）。
这使得合同变为可撤销的，因此，如果醉酒一方在清醒后迅速采取行动（即在合理时间内）否认合同，该合同即可被撤销。在本案中，该妇人在通过拒绝将汽车交给邻居来否认合同时，很可能仍处于药物影响下，因此邻居不太可能胜诉。

（选项B） 只有当合同属于《欺诈法》管辖范围时，才需要采用书面形式并由被诉方签署。该规则适用于价格为500美元或以上的货物买卖合同，但不适用于本案中仅以450美元出售汽车的合同。

（选项C） 根据禁止反言原则，当没有有效合同成立时，一方可以强制执行其所信赖的承诺。但该原则仅在一方的信赖是合理的且造成了重大损害时才允许获得补偿——本案中这两种情况均未出现。

Educational objective:
Incapacity due to intoxication renders a contract voidable if the intoxicated party could not reasonably understand the nature or consequences of the contract AND the other party had reason to know of the intoxication. The contract can then be set aside if the intoxicated party promptly disaffirms it upon becoming sober.

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 12–16 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (incapacity to contract).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts · Capacity Defense
✅ 正确答案：A
邻居不会胜诉，因为合同因妇人行为能力欠缺（Incapacity）而可撤销（Voidable）。
⚖️ 核心法律规则 (The Rule)

在合同法中，如果一方因醉态或药物影响 (Intoxication) 而导致行为能力欠缺，合同是可撤销的 (Voidable)，但必须同时满足以下两个条件：

  1. 受影响方无法合理理解合同的性质或后果，或无法就此采取合理行动；
    (Unable to understand nature/consequences or act reasonably)
  2. 另一方有理由知道受影响方的这种状态。
    (The other party had reason to know)
🔍 案情逻辑分析
1
药物导致的“醉态”：
题目明确指出妇人正在服用“强效止痛药”(Powerful pain medication)，并且看起来“精神恍惚”(Out of it)。这在法律上等同于 Intoxication。
2
无法合理行事：
她以 $450 出售价值 $3,000 的汽车，巨大的价格差异暗示她无法理解交易后果或无法合理行事。
3
关键点：邻居的知情 (Reason to Know)：
这是本题最关键的考点。邻居知道她刚做完手术、正在服药，并且观察到她“精神恍惚”。因此，邻居不能主张自己是善意不知情的。
4
后果：
合同并非自始无效 (Void)，而是可撤销 (Voidable)。妇人有权选择执行或撤销。当她拒绝交付汽车时，她行使了撤销权 (Disaffirmance)。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 B (欺诈法 Statute of Frauds)：
错误。虽然这是货物买卖，但《统一商法典》(UCC) 规定只有价值 $500 或以上 的合同才必须书面形式。本案金额为 $450，口头合同在形式上是有效的，只是因为行为能力问题可被撤销。
选项 C (信赖 Reliance/Promissory Estoppel)：
错误。邻居仅仅是说“太好了”，并没有表现出发生了实质性的、合理的信赖损害 (Detrimental Reliance)。此外，当存在有效（尽管可撤销）的合同时，通常优先分析合同抗辩，而非禁止反言。
选项 D (合同成立 Formation)：
错误。虽然有要约 (Offer) 和承诺 (Acceptance)，表面上成立了合同，但“行为能力欠缺”是一个有效的抗辩理由 (Defense)，阻碍了合同的强制执行 (Enforceability)。
MBE 考试技巧：
遇到“醉酒/服药”题型，务必寻找“另一方是否知情”的事实描述。如果另一方不知道且交易公平，合同通常不可撤销；如果另一方知情（趁人之危），合同可撤销。

questions.question:
A cattle rancher operates a large ranch with many employees. State law requires all employees within the state to pay a state income tax, and all employers are required to accurately report their employees' incomes. Enforcement of the state law is a civil matter. There are no criminal penalties for failure to pay or failure to accurately report.
The rancher entered a written employment contract with a veterinarian, who agreed to manage the health of the rancher's cattle for six months. Both parties knew about the state income tax, and the veterinarian wanted to avoid paying it. The rancher therefore agreed to compensate the veterinarian by paying the veterinarian's monthly mortgage directly to the bank without reporting the payments to the state. The rancher paid the veterinarian's mortgage for the first three months of the contract and then stopped making payments even though the veterinarian continued to work.
If the veterinarian sues the rancher, what will he likely recover?

choices.a: Expectation damages, because the rancher breached the contract and it did not involve any criminal conduct.
choices.b: Restitution damages, because the rancher withdrew from the agreement by failing to make additional mortgage payments.
choices.c: Restitution damages, because the veterinarian was less culpable than the rancher.
choices.d: Nothing, because the contract had an illegal purpose.
