一个牧场主经营着一个拥有众多雇员的大型牧场。州法律要求州内所有雇员缴纳州所得税，并要求所有雇主准确申报其雇员的收入。该州法律的执行属于民事事宜。未缴税或未准确申报并无刑事处罚。

该牧场主与一名兽医签订了书面雇佣合同，兽医同意在六个月内管理牧场牛群的健康。双方都知道州所得税的存在，且兽医想逃避缴纳该税款。因此，牧场主同意通过直接向银行支付兽医的月度按揭贷款来补偿兽医，而不向州政府申报这些款项。牧场主在合同的前三个月支付了兽医的按揭贷款，但随后尽管兽医继续工作，牧场主却停止了支付。

如果兽医起诉牧场主，他可能获得什么赔偿？
options:
A. Expectation damages, because the rancher breached the contract and it did not involve any criminal conduct.
预期损害赔偿金，因为牧场主违反了合同，且合同不涉及任何犯罪行为。

B. Restitution damages, because the rancher withdrew from the agreement by failing to make additional mortgage payments.
返还性损害赔偿金，因为牧场主未能支付后续的按揭贷款，从而退出了协议。

C. Restitution damages, because the veterinarian was less culpable than the rancher.
返还性损害赔偿金，因为兽医的过错程度低于牧场主。

D. Nothing, because the contract had an illegal purpose.
无法获得任何赔偿，因为该合同具有非法目的。
data.explanation:
An illegal contract arises when one or both parties' purpose, formation, or performance is against the law - such as the rancher's agreement not to report the veterinarian's income as required by state law. Such contracts generally are void and there is no remedy for breach. However, an illegal contract is enforceable for the full amount of the nonbreaching party's expectation damages if:
  • the nonbreaching party was justifiably ignorant of the facts that made the contract illegal†
  • the nonbreaching party substantially performed and lacked an illegal purpose
  • the contract can be easily separated into legal and illegal parts or
  • the contract is illegal due to a violation of a licensing requirement designed only to raise revenue.


None of these exceptions apply here. The veterinarian knew about the state income tax and purposely contracted to evade it. The agreed method of compensation is entirely illegal and cannot be separated from any legal part. Additionally, the illegality does not stem from a licensing violation. As a result, the veterinarian cannot recover expectation damages (Choice A).

However, restitution damages may be an alternative form of recovery. A party to an illegal contract can recover such damages if that party conferred a benefit on the other party and:
  • was justifiably ignorant of the facts that made the contract illegal†
  • was less culpable than the other party or
  • withdrew before the contract's illegal purpose was achieved and did not engage in serious misconduct.


Here, both parties knew about the law, so they were equally culpable in agreeing to violate it (Choice C). And only after the contract's illegal purpose was achieved through the first few payments did the rancher (not the veterinarian) withdraw by failing to make additional payments (Choice B). Therefore, the veterinarian also cannot recover restitution damages.

†However, recovery on this basis will be barred if the other party also was justifiably ignorant.

Educational objective: An illegal contract generally is void and there is no remedy for a breach. However, in limited situations, a party to an illegal contract can recover either expectation damages (eg, if the party was justifiably ignorant of the illegality) OR restitution damages (eg, if the party was less culpable than the other party).



选项正确率统计：A选项 22%，B选项 13%，C选项 2%，D选项 61%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当一方或双方当事人的目的、订立过程或履行行为违法时，便构成了非法合同——例如本案中牧场主同意不按州法律要求申报兽医的收入。此类合同通常是无效的，并且对于违约行为没有救济。但是，在以下情况下，非法合同可以强制执行，未违约方可获得全额的预期损害赔偿金：
  • 未违约方对导致合同非法的事实有正当理由不知情†
  • 未违约方已实质性履行合同且不具有非法目的
  • 合同可以轻易地分割为合法与非法两部分 或
  • 合同的非法性是由于违反了仅为增加财政收入而设的许可要求。


以上例外情况均不适用于本案。兽医知道州所得税的存在，并故意签订合同以逃避该税款。约定的补偿方式完全非法，无法与任何合法部分相分割。此外，该非法性并非源于违反许可规定。因此，兽医不能获得预期损害赔偿金（选项A）。

但是，返还性损害赔偿金可能是一种替代的救济方式。如果非法合同的一方当事人给予了另一方当事人利益，并且满足以下条件之一，则可以获得此类损害赔偿：
  • 对导致合同非法的事实有正当理由不知情†
  • 其过错程度低于另一方当事人 或
  • 在合同的非法目的实现之前退出，并且没有从事严重的不当行为。


在本案中，双方当事人都知道该法律，因此他们在同意违反法律方面的过错程度是相同的（选项C）。并且，只有在通过前几次付款实现了合同的非法目的之后，牧场主（而非兽医）才因未能支付后续款项而退出（选项B）。因此，兽医也无法获得返还性损害赔偿金。

†但是，如果另一方当事人也同样有正当理由不知情，则基于此理由的赔偿请求将被禁止。

教学目的：非法合同通常是无效的，对于违约行为没有救济。然而，在有限的情况下，非法合同的一方当事人可以获得预期损害赔偿金（例如，该方当事人对非法性有正当理由不知情）或返还性损害赔偿金（例如，该方当事人的过错程度低于另一方）。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 178 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining when promises are unenforceable on public-policy grounds).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 197 - 199 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (availability of restitution).

data.htmlContent:
合同法：非法性抗辩

Defenses to Enforceability: Illegality
⚖️ 核心法律原则

本题考察的是非法合同 (Illegal Contracts) 的可执行性。基本规则是：

如果合同的目的、订立或履行违反了法律（包括行政法规或公共政策），该合同通常是无效的 (Void)，法院不会协助任何一方。

这就是著名的“撒手不管政策” (Hands-off Policy)。法院通常会将当事人留在他们所处的境地，既不强制执行合同，也不责令返还利益。

🔍 案情关键点分析
  • 非法目的： 双方约定不申报收入以逃避州税。
  • 共同过错 (In Pari Delicto)： 牧场主和兽医都知晓法律并故意合谋违规。
  • 不可分割： 这种非法的支付方式是合同的核心条款，无法将“合法服务”与“非法支付”剥离。

虽然题目提到违规仅涉及“民事处罚”而非刑事，但这并不改变合同目的违法的本质。违反公共政策或行政法规同样会导致合同无效。

✅ 正确答案：D

兽医无法获得任何赔偿。

由于合同具有非法目的（逃税），且双方均知情并参与其中，法院认定该合同自始无效。法院不会介入这种“肮脏”的交易来帮助任何一方，即使牧场主违约在先。

❌ 干扰项排除

选项 A (预期赔偿 Expectation Damages)：
错误。只有合法有效的合同才能主张预期利益。虽然没有刑事责任，但逃税违反了公共政策，导致合同不可执行。

选项 B & C (返还性赔偿 Restitution)：
错误。通常情况下，如果一方过错较小 (Not in pari delicto) 或在非法目的达成前及时退出，可能获得返还利益。

但在本案中：

  • 双方过错程度相同（都知情且合谋）。
  • 非法目的已经部分实现（前三个月已通过非法方式支付）。
  • 退出的是违约方（牧场主），而不是原告（兽医）。
因此，不适用返还性赔偿的例外情况。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到“非法合同”题目时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 确认非法性： 是否违反法律或公共政策？（注意：民事/刑事区别通常不影响合同无效的结论）。
  2. 检查过错： 原告是否知情？是否参与了非法设计？
  3. 判断结果： 如果原告与被告同等过错 (In pari delicto)，法院通常判决 "Nothing" (无救济)。

questions.question:
A landowner, having suffered severe losses on bad investments, was money-poor but land-rich by inheritance, owning several thousand acres of unencumbered timberland. He had a large family, and his fixed personal expenses were high. Pressed for cash, he advertised a proposed sale of standing timber on a choice 2,000-acre tract. The only response was an offer by a logger who owned a large, integrated construction enterprise, after inspection of the advertised tract.
The logger offered to buy, sever, and remove the standing timber from the advertised tract at a cash price 70% lower than the regionally prevailing price for comparable timber rights. The landholder, by then in desperate financial straits and knowing little about timber values, signed and delivered to the logger a letter accepting the offer.
If, before the logger commences performance, the landholder's investment fortunes suddenly improve and he wishes to get out of the timber deal with the logger, which of the following legal concepts affords his best prospect of effective cancellation?

choices.a: Bad faith.
choices.b: Duress.
choices.c: Equitable estoppel.
choices.d: Unconscionability.

一位土地所有者，因不良投资遭受严重损失，继承了数千英亩无产权负担的林地，因而土地富裕但现金贫乏。他家庭人口众多，个人固定开支高昂。在现金的压力下，他刊登广告，提议出售一块2000英亩优选地块上的立木。唯一的响应来自一位拥有大型综合建筑企业的伐木工，他在视察了广告中的地块后发出了要约。

伐木工要约以比该地区可比木材权通行价格低70%的现金价格，购买、砍伐并移走广告地块上的立木。土地所有者当时正处于绝望的财务困境中，且对木材价值知之甚少，他签署并向伐木工交付了一封信函，接受了该要约。

如果在伐木工开始履行合同之前，土地所有者的投资运势突然好转，并希望退出与伐木工的木材交易，那么以下哪个法律概念为他有效取消合同提供了最佳前景？
options:
A. Bad faith.
恶意。

B. Duress.
胁迫。

C. Equitable estoppel.
衡平法上的禁止反言。

D. Unconscionability.
不合情理。
data.explanation:
The defense of unconscionability is available when a contract's bargaining process and/or the contract terms were so unfair to one party that no reasonable person would have agreed to it. When this occurs, the court can modify or cancel (ie, refuse to enforce) the contract. Factors used to determine whether a contract is unconscionable include:
  • sophistication and knowledge of each party (eg, the parties' unequal knowledge of the timber industry)
  • disparity between the parties' bargaining power (eg, the landowner is money-poor and the logger is the only potential buyer)
  • disparity between the value of consideration exchanged by the parties (eg, the sale of timber rights on choice land for a price that is significantly lower than the prevailing rate) and
  • one-sidedness of contract terms (eg, the contract terms overwhelmingly favor the logger).
Therefore, unconscionability provides the landowner his best prospect of effective cancellation of the contract.

(Choice A) Good faith and fair dealing demand only actual honesty; here, there is no indication that the logger failed to meet this standard.

Therefore, bad faith is not the landowner's best argument.

(Choice B) Duress serves as a defense to contract enforceability only if a contracting party's assent was induced by an improper threat - which did not occur here.

(Choice C) Equitable estoppel is a doctrine that prevents one party from changing its position after the other party has detrimentally relied on a misrepresentation of fact made by the first party. Here, however, the logger did not make a misrepresentation of fact to the landowner, so this doctrine does not apply.

Educational objective: A party may assert the defense of unconscionability if the bargaining process and/or terms of the contract were so unfair to that party when the contract was made that no reasonable person would have agreed to it.

正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当合同的谈判过程和/或合同条款对一方当事人是如此不公，以至于任何理性人都不会同意时，可以主张不合情理的抗辩。在这种情况下，法院可以修改或撤销（即，拒绝执行）该合同。用于判断合同是否不合情理的因素包括：
  • 各方当事人的成熟度和知识水平（例如，双方对木材行业知识的不对等）
  • 双方谈判能力的差距（例如，土地所有者缺乏现金，而伐木工是唯一的潜在买家）
  • 双方交换的对价价值的差距（例如，以远低于通行费率的价格出售优选土地上的木材权）以及
  • 合同条款的单方性（例如，合同条款压倒性地有利于伐木工）。
因此，“不合情理”为土地所有者有效撤销合同提供了最佳前景。

(选项A) 善意和公平交易原则仅要求事实上的诚实；在此案中，没有迹象表明伐木工未能达到此标准。

因此，恶意并非土地所有者的最佳论点。

(选项B) 只有当一方缔约方的同意是由不正当威胁所引诱时，“胁迫”才能作为合同可执行性的抗辩——本案中并未发生这种情况。

(选项C) 衡平法上的禁止反言是一项法律原则，它禁止一方当事人在另一方因信赖其作出的事实虚假陈述而遭受不利影响后，改变其原有立场。然而，在本案中，伐木工并未向土地所有者作出事实虚假陈述，因此该原则不适用。

教学目标：如果在合同订立时，谈判过程和/或合同条款对一方当事人是如此不公，以至于任何理性人都不会同意，则该方当事人可以主张“不合情理”的抗辩。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 208 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (unconscionable contract or contract term).

data.htmlContent:
Contracts / Defenses

核心考点：显失公平
(Unconscionability)

本题的正确答案是 (D) Unconscionability。这是土地所有者想要撤销合同的最佳法律依据。

⚖️ 法律规则解析

Unconscionability (显失公平/不合情理) 是合同法中的一种抗辩理由，允许法院拒绝执行那些极其不公的合同。根据《统一商法典》(UCC § 2-302) 和《合同法重述》(Restatement § 208)，判定显失公平通常需要同时具备两个要素：

  1. 程序上的显失公平 (Procedural Unconscionability)： 指谈判过程中的不公。例如：双方议价能力悬殊、一方缺乏专业知识、或者没有真正的选择权。
  2. 实体上的显失公平 (Substantive Unconscionability)： 指合同条款本身极其苛刻或单方面压榨。例如：价格“震惊良知 (shocks the conscience)”。

本案事实分析

为什么本案符合 Unconscionability 的标准？

  • 巨大的价格差异 (Substantive)： 伐木工的出价只有市场价的 30%（低了70%）。这种价格差异极其悬殊，属于条款本身的极度不公。
  • 议价能力与知识的不对等 (Procedural)：
    - 卖方： 现金短缺、急迫、对木材价值“知之甚少 (knowing little about timber values)”。
    - 买方： 拥有大型综合企业的专业伐木工，视察过土地，拥有专业知识。

当一个专业人士利用另一方的无知和财务困境，以极低的价格获取巨额利益时，法院极有可能认定该合同因“显失公平”而不可执行。

🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？
  • (A) Bad Faith (恶意)： 虽然价格低，但伐木工并没有违反“诚实信用”的具体义务（如撒谎或阻碍履行）。单纯的低价报价通常不构成法律上的 Bad Faith。
  • (B) Duress (胁迫)： 这是一个常见的陷阱。Economic Duress (经济胁迫) 要求困境是由对方的不当行为造成的。本案中，土地所有者的财务危机是自己投资失败造成的，并非伐木工造成的。伐木工只是利用了这一机会，而非制造了这一威胁。
  • (C) Equitable Estoppel (衡平法上的禁止反言)： 这通常用于防止一方否认其之前的陈述。本案中伐木工没有做出虚假陈述让土地所有者依赖，因此不适用。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧

在处理合同抗辩题目时，请注意区分 Duress 和 Unconscionability：

  • 如果题目强调一方受到了威胁（"Sign or I'll ruin you"），选 Duress。
  • 如果题目强调议价能力悬殊 + 条款极度不公（"Gross disparity in price"），选 Unconscionability。

questions.question:
An aircraft broker sought to purchase on behalf of its client a private jet from a fleet owned by a corporation. In a telephone conversation between the broker and the corporation's finance manager, the broker offered $9 million for the jet. The manager agreed on the condition that the broker give the corporation a $250,000 deposit toward the jet's purchase price and a copy of the broker's agreement with the client. The broker complied with the manager's request.
Subsequently, the broker and the corporation exchanged written drafts of a contract memorializing their agreement. None of the drafts were signed by the parties. Two months later, the corporation notified the broker that the jet was not for sale and disputed the existence of an enforceable contract.
Is there an enforceable contract between the broker and the corporation?

choices.a: No, because partial payment of the jet's purchase price did not take the contract out of the statute of frauds.
choices.b: No, because the broker never signed a writing evidencing a contract with the corporation.
choices.c: Yes, because the agreement was memorialized in the written drafts of the contract exchanged by the parties.
choices.d: Yes, because the broker paid $250,000 for the jet and the corporation accepted that payment.

Q81033

An aircraft broker sought to purchase on behalf of its client a private jet from a fleet owned by a corporation. In a telephone conversation between the broker and the corporation's finance manager, the broker offered $9 million for the jet. The manager agreed on the condition that the broker give the corporation a $250,000 deposit toward the jet's purchase price and a copy of the broker's agreement with the client. The broker complied with the manager's request.

Subsequently, the broker and the corporation exchanged written drafts of a contract memorializing their agreement. None of the drafts were signed by the parties. Two months later, the corporation notified the broker that the jet was not for sale and disputed the existence of an enforceable contract.

Is there an enforceable contract between the broker and the corporation?

一家飞机经纪商代表其客户，寻求从一家公司拥有的机队中购买一架私人飞机。在经纪商与该公司财务经理的电话交谈中，经纪商要约以900万美元购买该飞机。经理同意了，条件是经纪商向公司支付25万美元的定金作为飞机购买价款的一部分，并提供一份经纪商与其客户之间的协议副本。经纪商遵守了经理的要求。

随后，经纪商和公司交换了书面合同草案以记录他们的协议。双方均未签署任何草案。两个月后，该公司通知经纪商，该飞机不再出售，并对是否存在可强制执行的合同提出异议。

经纪商与公司之间是否存在可强制执行的合同？
options:
A. No, because partial payment of the jet's purchase price did not take the contract out of the statute of frauds.
否，因为部分支付飞机购买价款并未使合同免于欺诈法的规定。

B. No, because the broker never signed a writing evidencing a contract with the corporation.
否，因为经纪商从未签署任何证明与公司存在合同的书面文件。

C. Yes, because the agreement was memorialized in the written drafts of the contract exchanged by the parties.
是，因为协议已记录在双方交换的合同书面草案中。

D. Yes, because the broker paid $250,000 for the jet and the corporation accepted that payment.
是，因为经纪商为该飞机支付了25万美元，且公司接受了该笔付款。
data.explanation:
The UCC statute of frauds applies to contracts for the sale of goods for $500 or more (eg, private jet sold for $9 million). These contracts generally must be in writing and signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought to be enforceable. However, one exception applies when some amount of payment was made and accepted.† The effect of a partial payment turns on whether the contract is for:

Effect of Partial Payment


separable goodsthe contract is enforceable up to the quantity of goods paid for in full
an indivisible goodthe entire contract is enforceable
Here, the broker - corporation contract violated the statute of frauds because none of the written drafts exchanged by the parties were signed (Choice C). However, the broker paid $250,000 (partial payment) toward the jet (indivisible good) and the corporation presumably accepted that payment. Therefore, the contract is excepted from the statute of frauds and is enforceable in its entirety (Choice A).

†The exception also applies when some amount of goods have been received and accepted.

(Choice B) The fact that the broker never signed a writing evidencing a contract with the corporation is irrelevant. That is because the corporation is the party against whom enforcement is sought and the one whose signature was therefore needed to satisfy the statute of frauds.

Educational objective: A contract is excepted from the UCC statute of frauds when some amount of payment was made and accepted. A partial payment for separable goods renders the contract enforceable only up to the quantity paid for in full, while a partial payment for an indivisible good renders the entire contract enforceable.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.



选项正确率统计：A选项 11%，B选项 11%，C选项 17%，D选项 60%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

UCC 欺诈法适用于价值500美元或以上的货物销售合同（例如，以900万美元出售的私人飞机）。通常，这些合同必须是书面形式，并由被请求强制执行的一方签署，方可强制执行。然而，当支付并接受了部分款项时，存在一个例外。† 部分支付的效力取决于合同是针对：

部分支付的效力


可分割货物合同在已全额付款的货物数量范围内可强制执行
不可分割货物整个合同可强制执行
在本案中，经纪商与公司之间的合同违反了欺诈法，因为双方交换的书面草案均未签署（选项 C）。然而，经纪商为该飞机（不可分割货物）支付了25万美元（部分支付），且公司据推定接受了该笔付款。因此，该合同属于欺诈法的例外情况，并且整个合同均可强制执行（选项 A）。

†当部分货物已被接收和接受时，该例外同样适用。

（选项 B）经纪商从未签署证明与公司存在合同的书面文件这一事实是无关紧要的。这是因为公司是被请求强制执行的一方，因此需要其签名才能满足欺诈法的要求。

教学目标：当部分款项被支付和接受时，合同可免于 UCC 欺诈法的规定。对可分割货物的部分支付仅使合同在已全额付款的数量范围内可强制执行，而对不可分割货物的部分支付则使整个合同可强制执行。

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

References

U.C.C. § 2-201 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (statute of frauds formal requirements).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Statute of Frauds & Exceptions
UCC Article 2
案情摘要：
买方（经纪商）口头同意以900万美元购买卖方（公司）的一架私人飞机，并支付了25万美元定金。双方交换了书面草案但均未签字。卖方随后反悔。
核心考点：UCC 欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds)

根据 UCC § 2-201，价值 $500 或以上的货物销售合同通常必须有书面形式并由被执行方签字才能生效。

例外情况 (Exceptions)：
如果买方已付款且卖方已接受 (Payment Made and Accepted)，合同在一定范围内可强制执行。

关键区分：部分付款的效力

当只支付了部分款项（Partial Payment）时，合同的可执行范围取决于货物是否可分割：

货物类型 部分付款的法律后果
可分割货物
(Divisible Goods)
例：100台电脑 		仅在已付款的数量范围内可强制执行。
❌ 不能强制执行整个合同。
不可分割货物
(Indivisible Goods)
例：1架飞机、1辆车 		整个合同均可强制执行。
✅ 因为无法将飞机切开交付。
正确答案 D

是的，因为经纪商为该飞机支付了25万美元，且公司接受了该笔付款。

推理逻辑：
1. 本案涉及货物销售（飞机），适用 UCC。
2. 虽然没有签字的书面合同（违反欺诈法一般原则），但买方支付了定金且卖方接受了。
3. 飞机是不可分割物 (Indivisible Good)。
4. 因此，部分付款使得整个合同免于欺诈法的限制，变得完全可强制执行。

为什么其他选项是错误的？
  • 选项 A (错)： 认为部分付款无效。这是错误的，因为对于不可分割物，部分付款足以验证整个合同。
  • 选项 B (错)： 关注经纪商没签字。但在本案中，经纪商试图起诉公司，我们需要的是被起诉方（公司）的签名，或者适用例外情形（如付款）。
  • 选项 C (错)： 仅交换未签字的草案通常不足以满足欺诈法的书面要求（除非符合特定商户确认备忘录规则，但本题强调未签字且未提及备忘录规则的适用细节，付款例外是更直接的依据）。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 考试中遇到口头合同 (Oral Contract) + 部分履行 (Partial Performance) 的题目时：

  1. 首先判断是服务（Common Law）还是货物（UCC）。
  2. 如果是货物，判断是单个大件物品还是多个小件物品。
  3. 单个大件（不可分割）+ 部分付款 = 全同有效。
  4. 多个小件（可分割）+ 部分付款 = 仅付款部分有效。

questions.question:
A commercial baker and an ingredient supplier orally agreed that the baker would purchase 1,000 pounds of flour from the supplier for a price between 50 and 75 cents per pound. The parties agreed that they would determine the final price upon delivery. The supplier promised to deliver the flour in two weeks.
Later that day, the baker sent the supplier a signed note reminding the supplier about the terms of their agreement, including the quantity of flour. The supplier received the note, read it, and took no further action. When the supplier failed to deliver the flour, the baker sued the supplier for breach of contract.
Can the baker enforce the contract against the supplier?

choices.a: No, because the parties did not agree to a definitive price term.
choices.b: No, because the supplier did not sign the note.
choices.c: Yes, because the baker sent the supplier a signed confirmation.
choices.d: Yes, because the parties' oral agreement is enforceable.

一位商业面包师和一位原料供应商口头约定，面包师将以每磅50至75美分的价格向供应商购买1000磅面粉。双方同意在交货时确定最终价格。供应商承诺在两周内交货。

当天晚些时候，面包师向供应商发送了一份签名的便条，提醒供应商他们协议的条款，包括面粉的数量。供应商收到了这张便条，阅读后未采取任何进一步行动。当供应商未能交付面粉时，面包师以违约为由起诉了供应商。

面包师能否对供应商强制执行该合同？
options:
A. No, because the parties did not agree to a definitive price term.
不能，因为双方未就明确的价格条款达成一致。

B. No, because the supplier did not sign the note.
不能，因为供应商没有在该便条上签名。

C. Yes, because the baker sent the supplier a signed confirmation.
能，因为面包师向供应商发送了一份签名的确认函。

D. Yes, because the parties' oral agreement is enforceable.
能，因为双方的口头协议是可强制执行的。
data.explanation:
Statute of frauds requirements

Physical or electronic document(s) containing reasonable basis to believe contract was formed (eg, receipt, check, emails) AND
Writingat common law - identifies parties, subject matter, consideration, time & nature of performance under UCC - lists quantity of goods (contract enforceable only up to written quantity)
SignatureGeneral rule - handwritten signature from, or other mark identifying, party to be charged (eg, letterhead, electronic signature, initials)

Merchant exception - between merchants, written confirmation that satisfies statute of frauds as to sender will bind both parties if no written objection within 10 days
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

The UCC statute of frauds applies to contracts for the sale of goods valued at $500 or more. To be enforceable, these agreements must be evidenced by a writing that:

provides a reasonable basis to believe a contract was formed (eg, the baker's note) lists the quantity of goods sold or the means to determine quantity (eg, 1,000 pounds of flour) and is signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought (here, the supplier) (Choice B).

However, the UCC relaxes the signature requirement in agreements between merchants - ie, regular dealers of the goods involved in the transaction. Under the merchant exception , a written confirmation need only be signed by one merchant and sent to the other merchant. If the recipient has reason to know the confirmation's contents and does not object within 10 days, then it is enforceable against both merchants.

Here, the baker and the supplier are both merchants - regular dealers in flour. The baker's signed note was a sufficient writing because it confirmed that a contract was formed and listed the quantity of goods sold. Additionally, the supplier had reason to know the contents of the note (received and read it) and did not object within 10 days. Therefore, the contract was enforceable against both parties.

(Choice A) Although the parties did not agree to a definitive price term, they did agree to determine the final price at delivery. And even if they are unable to do so, the contract is enforceable since UCC gap-fillers will supply the price term at the time of delivery.

(Choice D) An oral agreement is unenforceable when, as here, it is subject to the statute of frauds. However, the parties' oral agreement was memorialized in a written confirmation that satisfied the merchant exception to this statute and can therefore be enforced.

Educational objective: Under the merchant exception to the UCC statute of frauds, a confirmation signed and sent by one merchant to another binds both parties if the recipient has reason to know its contents and does not object within 10 days.

选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 16%，C选项 69%（正确选项），D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

反欺诈法要求

实体或电子文件，包含合理依据以相信合同已成立（例如，收据、支票、电子邮件）并且
书面文件在普通法中 - 识别当事人、标的物、对价、履行的时间和性质
根据 UCC - 列明货物数量（合同仅在书面数量范围内可强制执行）
签名一般规则 - 来自被请求执行方的手写签名或其他识别性标记（例如，信头、电子签名、姓名首字母缩写）

商人例外规则 - 在商人之间，一份对发送方而言满足反欺诈法的书面确认函，如果在10天内没有书面异议，将对双方均具有约束力
UCC = 《统一商法典》(Uniform Commercial Code)

UCC 反欺诈法适用于价值500美元或以上的货物销售合同。为使其可强制执行，这些协议必须由一份书面文件证明，该文件：

提供合理依据以相信合同已成立（例如，面包师的便条），列明所售货物的数量或确定数量的方法（例如，1000磅面粉）并且由被请求强制执行的一方（此处为供应商）签署 (选项B)。

然而，UCC 放宽了商人之间协议的签名要求——即，交易中所涉货物的常规经销商。根据商人例外规则，书面确认函只需由一名商人签署并发送给另一名商人。如果接收方有理由知道确认函的内容，并且在10天内没有提出异议，那么该确认函对双方商人均可强制执行。

在本案中，面包师和供应商都是商人——即面粉的常规经销商。面包师签名的便条是一份充分的书面文件，因为它确认了合同的成立并列明了所售货物的数量。此外，供应商有理由知道该便条的内容（已收到并阅读），且未在10天内提出异议。因此，该合同对双方均可强制执行。

(选项A) 尽管双方未就明确的价格条款达成一致，但他们确实同意在交货时确定最终价格。并且，即使他们无法做到这一点，合同仍然是可强制执行的，因为 UCC 的“填补条款”(gap-fillers) 将提供交货时的价格条款。

(选项D) 当口头协议受反欺诈法管辖时，如此案所示，该协议是不可强制执行的。然而，双方的口头协议已通过一份书面确认函加以记载，该确认函满足了该法规的商人例外规则，因此可以被强制执行。

教学目标：根据 UCC 反欺诈法的商人例外规则，由一名商人签署并发送给另一名商人的确认函，如果接收方有理由知道其内容并且在10天内没有提出异议，则对双方均具有约束力。

References

  • U.C.C. § 2-201 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (describing the UCC statute of frauds).
  • U.C.C. § 2-305(1)(b) (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (describing open price terms).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / UCC Article 2
✅ 正确答案：C

面包师可以强制执行合同，因为他向供应商发送了签名的确认函，且供应商未在规定时间内提出异议。

核心考点：商人确认函例外

本题考察的是《统一商法典》(UCC) 下的反欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds) 及其重要的例外情况。

基础规则 (General Rule)

根据 UCC § 2-201，价值 $500 或以上的货物销售合同，必须有被请求履行方 (party to be charged) 签署的书面文件才能强制执行。

在本案中，供应商是被告，但他没有签字。按一般规则，合同本应无法执行。

商人例外 (Merchant's Confirmatory Memo)

但在两个商人 (Merchants) 之间，如果满足以下条件，未签字的一方也要受合同约束：

  • 一方发送了书面确认函 (Written confirmation)；
  • 该确认函对发送方有约束力（已签名）；
  • 接收方收到并有理由知道其内容；
  • 接收方在收到后 10天内 未提出书面异议。
案情分析

让我们将规则应用到本题事实中：

  1. 商人身份：面包师和原料供应商都是各自领域的商人。
  2. 确认函：面包师发送了“签名的便条”(signed note)，确认了条款和数量。
  3. 知情与沉默：供应商收到并阅读了便条，但“未采取任何进一步行动”（即未在10天内反对）。

因此，尽管供应商没有亲笔签名，但他通过沉默 (Silence) 接受了该书面确认函作为反欺诈法的满足条件。

为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ 选项 A (价格条款)：
UCC 对合同条款非常宽容。只要确定了数量 (Quantity)，即使没有明确的价格（Open Price Term），合同依然有效。法院会根据 UCC § 2-305 填补合理的市场价格。
❌ 选项 B (无签名)：
这是反欺诈法的一般抗辩理由，但本题恰恰考察的是针对此规则的“商人例外”。
❌ 选项 D (口头协议)：
虽然口头协议存在，但因为涉及金额超过 $500（1000磅 × 最低$0.50 = $500），必须满足反欺诈法才能强制执行 (Enforceable)。选项 D 忽略了必须有书面证据这一法律要求。
💡 MBE 提分技巧 当你在题目中看到： 1. 双方都是商人 (Merchants)； 2. 口头协议后紧接着发了邮件/信件/发票； 3. 接收方没有回复或保持沉默；

请立即联想 UCC § 2-201(2) 商人确认函例外。这是 Contract Law 中极高频的考点！

questions.question:
An insurance company issued an insurance policy to a homeowner. The policy failed to contain certain coverage terms required by a state insurance statute. When the homeowner suffered a loss due to a theft that was within the policy's terms, the insurance company refused to pay, claiming that the policy was unenforceable because it violated the statute.
Will the homeowner likely succeed in an action against the insurance company to recover for the loss?

choices.a: No, because the insurance policy is not a divisible contract.
choices.b: No, because the insurance policy violated the statute.
choices.c: Yes, because the homeowner belongs to the class of persons intended to be protected by the statute.
choices.d: Yes, because the insurance policy will be strictly construed against the insurance company as the drafter.

房主针对保险公司提起的旨在弥补其损失的诉讼，是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the insurance policy is not a divisible contract.
不会，因为该保险单不是一份可分割的合同。

B. No, because the insurance policy violated the statute.
不会，因为该保险单违反了法规。

C. Yes, because the homeowner belongs to the class of persons intended to be protected by the statute.
会，因为房主属于该法规意图保护的人群类别。

D. Yes, because the insurance policy will be strictly construed against the insurance company as the drafter.
会，因为作为起草方，该保险单的解释将严格遵循不利于保险公司的原则。
data.explanation:
Contracts unenforceable on public-policy grounds Common examples:
  • Contracts unreasonably restraining trade
  • Contracts discouraging or restraining marriage
  • Contracts for sexual intercourse
  • Contracts for committing a tort
  • Contracts encouraging breach of a fiduciary duty
  • Contracts excusing liability for intentional, knowing, or reckless misconduct
A contract that violates the law is often unenforceable on public-policy grounds. But there is an exception to this rule when the contract violates a law designed to protect the party seeking to enforce the contract. In that case, the contract is enforceable so as to avoid frustrating the public policy behind the statute.

Here, the homeowner's insurance policy violated the state insurance statute by failing to contain certain coverage terms. That statute was intended to protect insureds like the homeowner, and the public policy behind the statute will be frustrated if the insurance company is allowed to escape liability for the homeowner's loss. Therefore, the insurance policy is enforceable, and the homeowner will likely succeed (Choice B).

(Choice A) Some contracts are divisible, meaning that they can easily be separated into legal and illegal parts so that recovery is available on the legal part(s) only. But a contract entered into in violation of a statute need not be divisible for a court to enforce it.

(Choice D) Although contracts are generally construed against the drafter, this rule matters only when there is a dispute involving the interpretation of ambiguous contract language (not seen here).

Educational objective: When a contract violates a law that was designed to protect the party seeking to enforce the contract, the contract can be enforced to avoid frustrating the public policy behind the statute.

选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 5%，C选项 47%（正确选项），D选项 46%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

基于公共政策理由而不可强制执行的合同 常见示例：
  • 不合理限制贸易的合同
  • 阻碍或限制婚姻的合同
  • 为性交而订立的合同
  • 为实施侵权行为而订立的合同
  • 鼓励违反信托责任的合同
  • 免除因故意、明知或鲁莽的不当行为所产生之责任的合同
违反法律的合同通常因公共政策理由而不可强制执行。但当合同违反了一项旨在保护寻求强制执行合同一方的法律时，此规则存在例外。在这种情况下，为避免与该法规背后的公共政策相抵触，该合同是可强制执行的。

在本案中，房主的保险单因未能包含某些承保条款而违反了州保险法规。该法规旨在保护像房主这样的被保险人，如果允许保险公司逃避对房主损失的赔偿责任，那么该法规背后的公共政策将会受挫。因此，该保险单是可强制执行的，房主可能会胜诉（选项 C）。

（选项 A）有些合同是可分割的，意味着它们可以轻易地分离为合法与非法部分，从而仅能就合法部分获得赔偿。但是，对于违反法规而订立的合同，法院强制执行它并不要求其必须是可分割的。

（选项 D）尽管合同解释通常遵循不利于起草方的原则，但该规则仅在涉及解释模糊合同语言（本案中未出现）的争议中才有意义。

教学目的：当一份合同违反了旨在保护寻求强制执行该合同之一方的法律时，为避免与该法规背后的公共政策相抵触，该合同可以被强制执行。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 178 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when a contract is unenforceable on public policy grounds).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 179 cmt. c (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when refusal to enforce frustrates public policy).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Illegality & Public Policy
核心考点：违法合同的例外

通常情况下，违反法律的合同是不可强制执行的（Unenforceable）。但是，如果该法律的制定目的是为了保护特定群体，那么该群体的成员可以强制执行该合同。

The "Protected Class" Exception
When a statute is designed to protect a certain class of persons, a member of that class may enforce a contract that violates the statute.
本案逻辑链条
保险公司 (Insurer)
⬇️ 签发违规保单
违反州保险法规 (Violates Statute)
⬇️ 意图保护谁？
房主 (Homeowner)
✅ 房主属于“受保护阶层”
(Protected Class)
正确答案 C

理由：房主属于该法规意图保护的人群类别。

如果允许保险公司利用“保单违法”作为抗辩理由来拒绝赔付，实际上是让违法者（保险公司）从自己的错误中获利，这违背了公共政策（Public Policy）。因此，法院会允许受保护方（房主）强制执行合同。

为什么其他选项是错的？

🚫 选项 A (Divisibility)：
虽然有些合同可以分割（Severability），但在本案中，合同是否可分割并不重要。因为整个合同是基于“受保护群体例外”而有效的，不需要通过分割条款来救济。
🚫 选项 B (Illegality)：
这是通常原则（General Rule），但忽略了本案的关键例外。如果仅仅因为违反法规就判无效，反而损害了法规想要保护的人。
🚫 选项 D (Contra Proferentem)：
“不利于起草方解释”原则（Strict Construction against Drafter）通常用于解决合同条款模棱两可（Ambiguity）的情况。本案的问题是条款缺失/违法，而不是含义不清。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到“违法合同”（Illegal Contracts）题目时，先区分违法的性质：

1. Malum in se (本身邪恶)：如雇凶杀人。合同绝对无效。
2. Malum prohibitum (法规禁止)：如未取得特定执照、违反行政规定。此时要看法规是为了增加财政收入还是保护公众。如果是为了保护公众（如本题），受保护方通常可以强制执行。
